Common/Prayers.txt:[Deus in adjutorium].english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

Common/Prayers.txt:[Deus in adjutorium].english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:66:no-gloria.latin: Deus misereátur nostri, et benedícat nobis: * illúminet vultum suum super nos, et misereátur nostri.
psalm:66:no-gloria.english: May God have mercy on us, and bless us: * may he cause the light of his countenance to shine upon us, and may he have mercy on us.

psalm:66:no-gloria.latin: Ut cognoscámus in terra viam tuam, * in ómnibus géntibus salutáre tuum.
psalm:66:no-gloria.english: That we may know thy way upon earth: * thy salvation in all nations.

psalm:66:no-gloria.latin: Confiteántur tibi pópuli, Deus: * confiteántur tibi pópuli omnes.
psalm:66:no-gloria.english: Let people confess to thee, O God: * let all people give praise to thee.

psalm:66:no-gloria.latin: Læténtur et exsúltent gentes: * quóniam júdicas pópulos in æquitáte, et gentes in terra dírigis.
psalm:66:no-gloria.english: Let the nations be glad and rejoice: * for thou judgest the people with justice, and directest the nations upon earth.

psalm:66:no-gloria.latin: Confiteántur tibi pópuli, Deus, confiteántur tibi pópuli omnes: * (7a) terra dedit fructum suum.
psalm:66:no-gloria.english: Let the people, O God, confess to thee: * (7a) let all the people give praise to thee: the earth hath yielded her fruit.

psalm:66:no-gloria.latin: Benedícat nos Deus, Deus noster, (8) benedícat nos Deus: * et métuant eum omnes fines terræ.
psalm:66:no-gloria.english: May God, our God bless us, (8) may God bless us: * and all the ends of the earth fear him.

psalm:50:gloria.english: Psalm 50

psalm:50:gloria.latin: Miserére mei, Deus, * secúndum magnam misericórdiam tuam.
psalm:50:gloria.english: Have mercy on me, O God, * according to thy great mercy.

psalm:50:gloria.latin: Et secúndum multitúdinem miseratiónum tuárum, * dele iniquitátem meam.
psalm:50:gloria.english: And according to the multitude of thy tender mercies * blot out my iniquity.

psalm:50:gloria.latin: Ámplius lava me ab iniquitáte mea: * et a peccáto meo munda me.
psalm:50:gloria.english: Wash me yet more from my iniquity, * and cleanse me from my sin.

psalm:50:gloria.latin: Quóniam iniquitátem meam ego cognósco: * et peccátum meum contra me est semper.
psalm:50:gloria.english: For I know my iniquity, * and my sin is always before me.

psalm:50:gloria.latin: Tibi soli peccávi, et malum coram te feci: * ut justificéris in sermónibus tuis, et vincas cum judicáris.
psalm:50:gloria.english: To thee only have I sinned, and have done evil before thee: * that thou mayst be justified in thy words, and mayst overcome when thou art judged.

psalm:50:gloria.latin: Ecce enim, in iniquitátibus concéptus sum: * et in peccátis concépit me mater mea.
psalm:50:gloria.english: For behold I was conceived in iniquities; * and in sins did my mother conceive me.

psalm:50:gloria.latin: Ecce enim, veritátem dilexísti: * incérta et occúlta sapiéntiæ tuæ manifestásti mihi.
psalm:50:gloria.english: For behold thou hast loved truth: * the uncertain and hidden things of thy wisdom thou hast made manifest to me.

psalm:50:gloria.latin: Aspérges me hyssópo, et mundábor: * lavábis me, et super nivem dealbábor.
psalm:50:gloria.english: Thou shalt sprinkle me with hyssop, and I shall be cleansed: * thou shalt wash me, and I shall be made whiter than snow.

psalm:50:gloria.latin: Audítui meo dabis gáudium et lætítiam: * et exsultábunt ossa humiliáta.
psalm:50:gloria.english: To my hearing thou shalt give joy and gladness: * and the bones that have been humbled shall rejoice.

psalm:50:gloria.latin: Avérte fáciem tuam a peccátis meis: * et omnes iniquitátes meas dele.
psalm:50:gloria.english: Turn away thy face from my sins, * and blot out all my iniquities.

psalm:50:gloria.latin: Cor mundum crea in me, Deus: * et spíritum rectum ínnova in viscéribus meis.
psalm:50:gloria.english: Create a clean heart in me, O God: * and renew a right spirit within my bowels.

psalm:50:gloria.latin: Ne proícias me a fácie tua: * et spíritum sanctum tuum ne áuferas a me.
psalm:50:gloria.english: Cast me not away from thy face; * and take not thy holy spirit from me.

psalm:50:gloria.latin: Redde mihi lætítiam salutáris tui: * et spíritu principáli confírma me.
psalm:50:gloria.english: Restore unto me the joy of thy salvation, * and strengthen me with a perfect spirit.

psalm:50:gloria.latin: Docébo iníquos vias tuas: * et ímpii ad te converténtur.
psalm:50:gloria.english: I will teach the unjust thy ways: * and the wicked shall be converted to thee.

psalm:50:gloria.latin: Líbera me de sanguínibus, Deus, Deus salútis meæ: * et exsultábit lingua mea justítiam tuam.
psalm:50:gloria.english: Deliver me from blood, O God, thou God of my salvation: * and my tongue shall extol thy justice.

psalm:50:gloria.latin: Dómine, lábia mea apéries: * et os meum annuntiábit laudem tuam.
psalm:50:gloria.english: O Lord, thou wilt open my lips: * and my mouth shall declare thy praise.

psalm:50:gloria.latin: Quóniam si voluísses sacrifícium, dedíssem útique: * holocáustis non delectáberis.
psalm:50:gloria.english: For if thou hadst desired sacrifice, I would indeed have given it: * with burnt offerings thou wilt not be delighted.

psalm:50:gloria.latin: Sacrifícium Deo spíritus contribulátus: * cor contrítum, et humiliátum, Deus, non despícies.
psalm:50:gloria.english: A sacrifice to God is an afflicted spirit: * a contrite and humbled heart, O God, thou wilt not despise.

psalm:50:gloria.latin: Benígne fac, Dómine, in bona voluntáte tua Sion: * ut ædificéntur muri Jerúsalem.
psalm:50:gloria.english: Deal favourably, O Lord, in thy good will with Sion; * that the walls of Jerusalem may be built up.

psalm:50:gloria.latin: Tunc acceptábis sacrifícium justítiæ, oblatiónes, et holocáusta: * tunc impónent super altáre tuum vítulos.
psalm:50:gloria.english: Then shalt thou accept the sacrifice of justice, oblations and whole burnt offerings: * then shall they lay calves upon thy altar.

psalm:50:gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:50:gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:50:gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:50:gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:117:gloria.english: Psalm 117

psalm:117:gloria.latin: Confitémini Dómino quóniam bonus: * quóniam in sǽculum misericórdia ejus.
psalm:117:gloria.english: Give praise to the Lord, for he is good: * for his mercy endureth for ever.

psalm:117:gloria.latin: Dicat nunc Israël quóniam bonus: * quóniam in sǽculum misericórdia ejus.
psalm:117:gloria.english: Let Israel now say, that he is good: * that his mercy endureth for ever.

psalm:117:gloria.latin: Dicat nunc domus Aaron: * quóniam in sǽculum misericórdia ejus.
psalm:117:gloria.english: Let the house of Aaron now say, * that his mercy endureth for ever.

psalm:117:gloria.latin: Dicant nunc qui timent Dóminum: * quóniam in sǽculum misericórdia ejus.
psalm:117:gloria.english: Let them that fear the Lord now say, * that his mercy endureth for ever.

psalm:117:gloria.latin: De tribulatióne invocávi Dóminum: * et exaudívit me in latitúdine Dóminus.
psalm:117:gloria.english: In my trouble I called upon the Lord: * and the Lord heard me, and enlarged me.

psalm:117:gloria.latin: Dóminus mihi adjútor: * non timébo quid fáciat mihi homo.
psalm:117:gloria.english: The Lord is my helper: * I will not fear what man can do unto me.

psalm:117:gloria.latin: Dóminus mihi adjútor: * et ego despíciam inimícos meos.
psalm:117:gloria.english: The Lord is my helper: * and I will look over my enemies.

psalm:117:gloria.latin: Bonum est confídere in Dómino, * quam confídere in hómine:
psalm:117:gloria.english: It is good to confide in the Lord, * rather than to have confidence in man.

psalm:117:gloria.latin: Bonum est speráre in Dómino, * quam speráre in princípibus.
psalm:117:gloria.english: It is good to trust in the Lord, * rather than to trust in princes.

psalm:117:gloria.latin: Omnes gentes circuiérunt me: * et in nómine Dómini quia ultus sum in eos.
psalm:117:gloria.english: All nations compassed me about; * and in the name of the Lord I have been revenged on them.

psalm:117:gloria.latin: Circumdántes circumdedérunt me: * et in nómine Dómini quia ultus sum in eos.
psalm:117:gloria.english: Surrounding me they compassed me about: * and in the name of the Lord I have been revenged on them.

psalm:117:gloria.latin: Circumdedérunt me sicut apes, † et exarsérunt sicut ignis in spinis: * et in nómine Dómini quia ultus sum in eos.
psalm:117:gloria.english: They surrounded me like bees, † and they burned like fire among thorns: * and in the name of the Lord I was revenged on them.

psalm:117:gloria.latin: Impúlsus evérsus sum ut cáderem: * et Dóminus suscépit me.
psalm:117:gloria.english: Being pushed I was overturned that I might fall: * but the Lord supported me.

psalm:117:gloria.latin: Fortitúdo mea, et laus mea Dóminus: * et factus est mihi in salútem.
psalm:117:gloria.english: The Lord is my strength and my praise: * and he is become my salvation.

psalm:117:gloria.latin: Vox exsultatiónis, et salútis * in tabernáculis justórum.
psalm:117:gloria.english: The voice of rejoicing and of salvation * is in the tabernacles of the just.

psalm:117:gloria.latin: Déxtera Dómini fecit virtútem: † déxtera Dómini exaltávit me, * déxtera Dómini fecit virtútem.
psalm:117:gloria.english: The right hand of the Lord hath wrought strength: † the right hand of the Lord hath exalted me: * the right hand of the Lord hath wrought strength.

psalm:117:gloria.latin: Non móriar, sed vivam: * et narrábo ópera Dómini.
psalm:117:gloria.english: I shall not die, but live: * and shall declare the works of the Lord.

psalm:117:gloria.latin: Castígans castigávit me Dóminus: * et morti non trádidit me.
psalm:117:gloria.english: The Lord chastising hath chastised me: * but he hath not delivered me over to death.

psalm:117:gloria.latin: Aperíte mihi portas justítiæ, † ingréssus in eas confitébor Dómino: * (20) hæc porta Dómini, justi intrábunt in eam.
psalm:117:gloria.english: Open ye to me the gates of justice: † I will go in to them, and give praise to the Lord. * (20) This is the gate of the Lord, the just shall enter into it.

psalm:117:gloria.latin: Confitébor tibi quóniam exaudísti me: * et factus es mihi in salútem.
psalm:117:gloria.english: I will give glory to thee because thou hast heard me: * and art become my salvation.

psalm:117:gloria.latin: Lápidem, quem reprobavérunt ædificántes: * hic factus est in caput ánguli.
psalm:117:gloria.english: The stone which the builders rejected; * the same is become the head of the corner.

psalm:117:gloria.latin: A Dómino factum est istud: * et est mirábile in óculis nostris.
psalm:117:gloria.english: This is the Lord’s doing: * and it is wonderful in our eyes.

psalm:117:gloria.latin: Hæc est dies, quam fecit Dóminus: * exsultémus, et lætémur in ea.
psalm:117:gloria.english: This is the day which the Lord hath made: * let us be glad and rejoice therein.

psalm:117:gloria.latin: O Dómine, salvum me fac, † o Dómine, bene prosperáre: * (26a) benedíctus qui venit in nómine Dómini.
psalm:117:gloria.english: O Lord, save me: † O Lord, give good success: * (26a) Blessed be he that cometh in the name of the Lord.

psalm:117:gloria.latin: Benedíximus vobis de domo Dómini: * (27a) Deus Dóminus, et illúxit nobis.
psalm:117:gloria.english: We have blessed you out of the house of the Lord: * (27a) The Lord is God, and he hath shone upon us.

psalm:117:gloria.latin: Constitúite diem solémnem in condénsis, * usque ad cornu altáris.
psalm:117:gloria.english: Appoint a solemn day, with shady boughs, * even to the horn of the altar.

psalm:117:gloria.latin: Deus meus es tu, et confitébor tibi: * Deus meus es tu, et exaltábo te.
psalm:117:gloria.english: Thou art my God, and I will praise thee: * thou art my God, and I will exalt thee.

psalm:117:gloria.latin: Confitébor tibi quóniam exaudísti me * et factus es mihi in salútem.
psalm:117:gloria.english: I will praise thee, because thou hast heard me, * and art become my salvation.

psalm:117:gloria.latin: Confitémini Dómino quóniam bonus: * quóniam in sǽculum misericórdia ejus.
psalm:117:gloria.english: O praise ye the Lord, for he is good: * for his mercy endureth for ever.

psalm:117:gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:117:gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:117:gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:117:gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:62:gloria.latin: Deus, Deus meus, * ad te de luce vígilo.
psalm:62:gloria.english: O God, my God, * to thee do I watch at break of day.

psalm:62:gloria.latin: Sitívit in te ánima mea, * quam multiplíciter tibi caro mea.
psalm:62:gloria.english: For thee my soul hath thirsted; * for thee my flesh, O how many ways!

psalm:62:gloria.latin: In terra desérta, et ínvia, et inaquósa: ‡ sic in sancto appárui tibi, * ut vidérem virtútem tuam, et glóriam tuam.
psalm:62:gloria.english: In a desert land, and where there is no way, and no water: ‡ so in the sanctuary have I come before thee, * to see thy power and thy glory.

psalm:62:gloria.latin: Quóniam mélior est misericórdia tua super vitas: * lábia mea laudábunt te.
psalm:62:gloria.english: For thy mercy is better than lives: * thee my lips shall praise.

psalm:62:gloria.latin: Sic benedícam te in vita mea: * et in nómine tuo levábo manus meas.
psalm:62:gloria.english: Thus will I bless thee all my life long: * and in thy name I will lift up my hands.

psalm:62:gloria.latin: Sicut ádipe et pinguédine repleátur ánima mea: * et lábiis exsultatiónis laudábit os meum.
psalm:62:gloria.english: Let my soul be filled as with marrow and fatness: * and my mouth shall praise thee with joyful lips.

psalm:62:gloria.latin: Si memor fui tui super stratum meum, † in matutínis meditábor in te: * (8a) quia fuísti adjútor meus.
psalm:62:gloria.english: If I have remembered thee upon my bed, † I will meditate on thee in the morning: * (8a) because thou hast been my helper.

psalm:62:gloria.latin: Et in velaménto alárum tuárum exsultábo, † (9) adhǽsit ánima mea post te: * me suscépit déxtera tua.
psalm:62:gloria.english: And I will rejoice under the covert of thy wings: † my soul hath stuck close to thee: * (9) thy right hand hath received me.

psalm:62:gloria.latin: Ipsi vero in vanum quæsiérunt ánimam meam, † introíbunt in inferióra terræ: * (11) tradéntur in manus gládii, partes vúlpium erunt.
psalm:62:gloria.english: But they have sought my soul in vain, † they shall go into the lower parts of the earth: * (11) they shall be delivered into the hands of the sword, they shall be the portions of foxes.

psalm:62:gloria.latin: Rex vero lætábitur in Deo, † laudabúntur omnes qui jurant in eo: * quia obstrúctum est os loquéntium iníqua.
psalm:62:gloria.english: But the king shall rejoice in God, all they shall be praised that swear by him: * because the mouth is stopped of them that speak wicked things.

psalm:62:gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:62:gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:62:gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:62:gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:210:gloria.english: Canticle 210

psalm:210:gloria.latin: Benedícite, ómnia ópera Dómini, Dómino: * laudáte et superexaltáte eum in sǽcula.
psalm:210:gloria.english: All ye works of the Lord, bless the Lord: * praise and exalt him above all for ever.

psalm:210:gloria.latin: Benedícite, Ángeli Dómini, Dómino: * benedícite, cæli, Dómino.
psalm:210:gloria.english: O ye angels of the Lord, bless the Lord: * O ye heavens, bless the Lord:

psalm:210:gloria.latin: Benedícite, aquæ omnes, quæ super cælos sunt, Dómino: * benedícite, omnes virtútes Dómini, Dómino.
psalm:210:gloria.english: O all ye waters that are above the heavens, bless the Lord: * O all ye powers of the Lord, bless the Lord.

psalm:210:gloria.latin: Benedícite, sol et luna, Dómino: * benedícite, stellæ cæli, Dómino.
psalm:210:gloria.english: O ye sun and moon, bless the Lord: * O ye stars of heaven, bless the Lord.

psalm:210:gloria.latin: Benedícite, omnis imber et ros, Dómino: * benedícite, omnes spíritus Dei, Dómino.
psalm:210:gloria.english: O every shower and dew, bless ye the Lord: * O all ye spirits of God, bless the Lord.

psalm:210:gloria.latin: Benedícite, ignis et æstus, Dómino: * benedícite, frigus et æstus, Dómino.
psalm:210:gloria.english: O ye fire and heat, bless the Lord: * O ye cold and heat, bless the Lord.

psalm:210:gloria.latin: Benedícite, rores et pruína, Dómino: * benedícite, gelu et frigus, Dómino.
psalm:210:gloria.english: O ye dews and hoar frosts, bless the Lord: * O ye frost and cold, bless the Lord.

psalm:210:gloria.latin: Benedícite, glácies et nives, Dómino: * benedícite, noctes et dies, Dómino.
psalm:210:gloria.english: O ye ice and snow, bless the Lord: * O ye nights and days, bless the Lord.

psalm:210:gloria.latin: Benedícite, lux et ténebræ, Dómino: * benedícite, fúlgura et nubes, Dómino.
psalm:210:gloria.english: O ye light and darkness, bless the Lord: * O ye lightnings and clouds, bless the Lord.

psalm:210:gloria.latin: Benedícat terra Dóminum: * laudet et superexáltet eum in sǽcula.
psalm:210:gloria.english: O let the earth bless the Lord: * let it praise and exalt him above all for ever.

psalm:210:gloria.latin: Benedícite, montes et colles, Dómino: * benedícite, univérsa germinántia in terra, Dómino.
psalm:210:gloria.english: O ye mountains and hills, bless the Lord: * O all ye things that spring up in the earth, bless the Lord.

psalm:210:gloria.latin: Benedícite, fontes, Dómino: * benedícite, mária et flúmina, Dómino.
psalm:210:gloria.english: O ye fountains, bless the Lord: * O ye seas and rivers, bless the Lord.

psalm:210:gloria.latin: Benedícite, cete, et ómnia, quæ movéntur in aquis, Dómino: * benedícite, omnes vólucres cæli, Dómino.
psalm:210:gloria.english: O ye whales, and all that move in the waters, bless the Lord: * O all ye fowls of the air, bless the Lord.

psalm:210:gloria.latin: Benedícite, omnes béstiæ et pécora, Dómino: * benedícite, fílii hóminum, Dómino.
psalm:210:gloria.english: O all ye beasts and cattle, bless the Lord: * O ye sons of men, bless the Lord.

psalm:210:gloria.latin: Benedícat Israël Dóminum: * laudet et superexáltet eum in sǽcula.
psalm:210:gloria.english: O let Israel bless the Lord: * let them praise and exalt him above all for ever.

psalm:210:gloria.latin: Benedícite, sacerdótes Dómini, Dómino: * benedícite, servi Dómini, Dómino.
psalm:210:gloria.english: O ye priests of the Lord, bless the Lord: * O ye servants of the Lord, bless the Lord.

psalm:210:gloria.latin: Benedícite, spíritus, et ánimæ justórum, Dómino: * benedícite, sancti, et húmiles corde, Dómino.
psalm:210:gloria.english: O ye spirits and souls of the just, bless the Lord: * O ye holy and humble of heart, bless the Lord.

psalm:210:gloria.latin: Benedícite, Ananía, Azaría, Mísaël, Dómino: * laudáte et superexaltáte eum in sǽcula.
psalm:210:gloria.english: O Ananias, Azarias, and Misael, bless ye the Lord: * praise and exalt him above all for ever.

psalm:210:gloria.latin: (Fit reverentia:) Benedicámus Patrem et Fílium cum Sancto Spíritu: * laudémus et superexaltémus eum in sǽcula.
psalm:210:gloria.english: (Bow head) Let us bless the Father and the Son, with the Holy Ghost; * let us praise and exalt him above all for ever.

psalm:210:gloria.latin: Benedíctus es, Dómine, in firmaménto cæli: * et laudábilis, et gloriósus, et superexaltátus in sǽcula.
psalm:210:gloria.english: Blessed art thou, O Lord, in the firmament of heaven: * and worthy of praise, and glorious for ever.

psalm:210:gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:210:gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:210:gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:210:gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:148:no-gloria.latin: Laudáte Dóminum de cælis: * laudáte eum in excélsis.
psalm:148:no-gloria.english: Praise ye the Lord from the heavens * praise ye him in the high places.

psalm:148:no-gloria.latin: Laudáte eum, omnes Ángeli ejus: * laudáte eum, omnes virtútes ejus.
psalm:148:no-gloria.english: Praise ye him, all his angels: * praise ye him, all his hosts.

psalm:148:no-gloria.latin: Laudáte eum, sol et luna: * laudáte eum, omnes stellæ et lumen.
psalm:148:no-gloria.english: Praise ye him, O sun and moon: * praise him, all ye stars and light.

psalm:148:no-gloria.latin: Laudáte eum, cæli cælórum: * et aquæ omnes, quæ super cælos sunt, laudent nomen Dómini.
psalm:148:no-gloria.english: Praise him, ye heavens of heavens: * and let all the waters that are above the heavens, praise the name of the Lord.

psalm:148:no-gloria.latin: Quia ipse dixit, et facta sunt: * ipse mandávit, et creáta sunt.
psalm:148:no-gloria.english: For he spoke, and they were made: * he commanded, and they were created.

psalm:148:no-gloria.latin: Státuit ea in ætérnum, et in sǽculum sǽculi: * præcéptum pósuit, et non præteríbit.
psalm:148:no-gloria.english: He hath established them for ever, and for ages of ages: * he hath made a decree, and it shall not pass away.

psalm:148:no-gloria.latin: Laudáte Dóminum de terra, * dracónes, et omnes abýssi.
psalm:148:no-gloria.english: Praise the Lord from the earth, * ye dragons, and all ye deeps:

psalm:148:no-gloria.latin: Ignis, grando, nix, glácies, spíritus procellárum: * quæ fáciunt verbum ejus:
psalm:148:no-gloria.english: Fire, hail, snow, ice, stormy winds * which fulfill his word:

psalm:148:no-gloria.latin: Montes, et omnes colles: * ligna fructífera, et omnes cedri.
psalm:148:no-gloria.english: Mountains and all hills, * fruitful trees and all cedars:

psalm:148:no-gloria.latin: Béstiæ, et univérsa pécora: * serpéntes, et vólucres pennátæ:
psalm:148:no-gloria.english: Beasts and all cattle: * serpents and feathered fowls:

psalm:148:no-gloria.latin: Reges terræ, et omnes pópuli: * príncipes, et omnes júdices terræ.
psalm:148:no-gloria.english: Kings of the earth and all people: * princes and all judges of the earth:

psalm:148:no-gloria.latin: Júvenes, et vírgines: † senes cum junióribus laudent nomen Dómini: * (13) quia exaltátum est nomen ejus solíus.
psalm:148:no-gloria.english: Young men and maidens: † let the old with the younger, praise the name of the Lord: * (13) For his name alone is exalted.

psalm:148:no-gloria.latin: Conféssio ejus super cælum et terram: * et exaltávit cornu pópuli sui.
psalm:148:no-gloria.english: The praise of him is above heaven and earth: * and he hath exalted the horn of his people.

psalm:148:no-gloria.latin: Hymnus ómnibus sanctis ejus: * fíliis Israël, pópulo appropinquánti sibi.
psalm:148:no-gloria.english: A hymn to all his saints: to the children of Israel, a people approaching him.

psalm:149:no-gloria.latin: Cantáte Dómino cánticum novum: * laus ejus in ecclésia sanctórum.
psalm:149:no-gloria.english: Sing ye to the Lord a new canticle: * let his praise be in the church of the saints.

psalm:149:no-gloria.latin: Lætétur Israël in eo, qui fecit eum: * et fílii Sion exsúltent in rege suo.
psalm:149:no-gloria.english: Let Israel rejoice in him that made him: * and let the children of Sion be joyful in their king.

psalm:149:no-gloria.latin: Laudent nomen ejus in choro: * in týmpano, et psaltério psallant ei:
psalm:149:no-gloria.english: Let them praise his name in choir: * let them sing to him with the timbrel and the psaltery.

psalm:149:no-gloria.latin: Quia beneplácitum est Dómino in pópulo suo: * et exaltábit mansuétos in salútem.
psalm:149:no-gloria.english: For the Lord is well pleased with his people: * and he will exalt the meek unto salvation.

psalm:149:no-gloria.latin: Exsultábunt sancti in glória: * lætabúntur in cubílibus suis.
psalm:149:no-gloria.english: The saints shall rejoice in glory: * they shall be joyful in their beds.

psalm:149:no-gloria.latin: Exaltatiónes Dei in gútture eórum: * et gládii ancípites in mánibus eórum.
psalm:149:no-gloria.english: The high praises of God shall be in their mouth: * and two-edged swords in their hands:

psalm:149:no-gloria.latin: Ad faciéndam vindíctam in natiónibus: * increpatiónes in pópulis.
psalm:149:no-gloria.english: To execute vengeance upon the nations, * chastisements among the people:

psalm:149:no-gloria.latin: Ad alligándos reges eórum in compédibus: * et nóbiles eórum in mánicis férreis.
psalm:149:no-gloria.english: To bind their kings with fetters, * and their nobles with manacles of iron.

psalm:149:no-gloria.latin: Ut fáciant in eis judícium conscríptum: * glória hæc est ómnibus sanctis ejus.
psalm:149:no-gloria.english: To execute upon them the judgment that is written: * this glory is to all his saints.

psalm:150:no-gloria.latin: Laudáte Dóminum in sanctis ejus: * laudáte eum in firmaménto virtútis ejus.
psalm:150:no-gloria.english: Praise ye the Lord in his holy places: * praise ye him in the firmament of his power.

psalm:150:no-gloria.latin: Laudáte eum in virtútibus ejus: * laudáte eum secúndum multitúdinem magnitúdinis ejus.
psalm:150:no-gloria.english: Praise ye him for his mighty acts: * praise ye him according to the multitude of his greatness.

psalm:150:no-gloria.latin: Laudáte eum in sono tubæ: * laudáte eum in psaltério, et cíthara.
psalm:150:no-gloria.english: Praise him with sound of trumpet: * praise him with psaltery and harp.

psalm:150:no-gloria.latin: Laudáte eum in týmpano, et choro: * laudáte eum in chordis, et órgano.
psalm:150:no-gloria.english: Praise him with timbrel and choir: * praise him with strings and organs.

psalm:150:no-gloria.latin: Laudáte eum in cýmbalis benesonántibus: † laudáte eum in cýmbalis jubilatiónis: * (6) omnis spíritus laudet Dóminum.
psalm:150:no-gloria.english: Praise him on high sounding cymbals: † praise him on cymbals of joy: * (6) let every spirit praise the Lord.

psalm:231:gloria.latin: Benedíctus + Dóminus, Deus Israël: * quia visitávit, et fecit redemptiónem plebis suæ:
psalm:231:gloria.english: Blessed be the Lord + God of Israel; * because he hath visited and wrought the redemption of his people:

psalm:231:gloria.latin: Et eréxit cornu salútis nobis: * in domo David, púeri sui.
psalm:231:gloria.english: And hath raised up an horn of salvation to us, * in the house of David his servant:

psalm:231:gloria.latin: Sicut locútus est per os sanctórum, * qui a sǽculo sunt, prophetárum ejus:
psalm:231:gloria.english: As he spoke by the mouth of his holy Prophets, * who are from the beginning:

psalm:231:gloria.latin: Salútem ex inimícis nostris, * et de manu ómnium, qui odérunt nos.
psalm:231:gloria.english: Salvation from our enemies, * and from the hand of all that hate us:

psalm:231:gloria.latin: Ad faciéndam misericórdiam cum pátribus nostris: * et memorári testaménti sui sancti.
psalm:231:gloria.english: To perform mercy to our fathers, * and to remember his holy testament,

psalm:231:gloria.latin: Jusjurándum, quod jurávit ad Ábraham patrem nostrum, * datúrum se nobis:
psalm:231:gloria.english: The oath, which he swore to Abraham our father, * that he would grant to us,

psalm:231:gloria.latin: Ut sine timóre, de manu inimicórum nostrórum liberáti, * serviámus illi.
psalm:231:gloria.english: That being delivered from the hand of our enemies, * we may serve him without fear,

psalm:231:gloria.latin: In sanctitáte, et justítia coram ipso, * ómnibus diébus nostris.
psalm:231:gloria.english: In holiness and justice before him, * all our days.

psalm:231:gloria.latin: Et tu, puer, Prophéta Altíssimi vocáberis: * præíbis enim ante fáciem Dómini, paráre vias ejus:
psalm:231:gloria.english: And thou, child, shalt be called the prophet of the Highest: * for thou shalt go before the face of the Lord to prepare his ways:

psalm:231:gloria.latin: Ad dandam sciéntiam salútis plebi ejus: * in remissiónem peccatórum eórum:
psalm:231:gloria.english: To give knowledge of salvation to his people, * unto the remission of their sins:

psalm:231:gloria.latin: Per víscera misericórdiæ Dei nostri: * in quibus visitávit nos, óriens ex alto:
psalm:231:gloria.english: Through the bowels of the mercy of our God, * in which the Orient from on high hath visited us:

psalm:231:gloria.latin: Illumináre his, qui in ténebris, et in umbra mortis sedent: * ad dirigéndos pedes nostros in viam pacis.
psalm:231:gloria.english: To enlighten them that sit in darkness, and in the shadow of death: * to direct our feet into the way of peace.

psalm:231:gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:231:gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:231:gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:231:gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

Common/Prayers.txt:[Kyrie].latin: Kýrie, eléison. Christe, eléison. Kýrie, eléison.
Common/Prayers.txt:[Kyrie].english: Lord have mercy upon us, Christ have mercy upon us, Lord have mercy upon us.

Common/Prayers.txt:[Pater noster Et].latin: Pater noster, qui es in cælis, sanctificétur nomen tuum: advéniat regnum tuum: fiat volúntas tua, sicut in cælo et in terra. Panem nostrum cotidiánum da nobis hódie: et dimítte nobis débita nostra, sicut et nos dimíttimus debitóribus nostris:
Common/Prayers.txt:[Pater noster Et].english: Our Father, who art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done on earth as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread. And forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us.

Common/Prayers.txt:[Pater noster Et].latin: Et ne nos indúcas in tentatiónem:
Common/Prayers.txt:[Pater noster Et].english: And lead us not into temptation:

Common/Prayers.txt:[Fidelium animae].latin: Fidélium ánimæ per misericórdiam Dei requiéscant in pace.
Common/Prayers.txt:[Fidelium animae].english: May the souls of the faithful, through the mercy of God, rest in peace.

Special/Prima Special.txt:[Hymnus Prima].english: Now in the sun's new dawning ray,
Lowly of heart, our God we pray
That he from harm may keep us free
In all the deeds this day shall see.
May fear of him our tongues restrain,
Lest strife unguarded speech should stain:
His favouring care our guardian be,
Lest our eyes feed on vanity.
May every heart be pure from sin
And folly find no place therein:
Scant need of food, excess denied,
Wear down in us the body's pride.
That when the light of day is gone,
And night in course shall follow on.
We, free from cares the world affords,
May chant the praise that is our Lord's.
* All laud to God the Father be,
All praise, Eternal Son, to thee:
All glory, as is ever meet,
To God the holy Paraclete.
Amen.

hymn:monastic:Prima.latin:
Jam lucis orto sídere,
Deum precémur súpplices,
Ut in diúrnis áctibus
Nos servet a nocéntibus.
hymn:monastic:Prima.english:
Now in the sun's new dawning ray,
Lowly of heart, our God we pray
That he from harm may keep us free
In all the deeds this day shall see.

hymn:monastic:Prima.latin:
Linguam refrénans témperet,
Ne litis horror ínsonet:
Visum fovéndo cóntegat,
Ne vanitátes háuriat.
hymn:monastic:Prima.english:
May fear of him our tongues restrain,
Lest strife unguarded speech should stain:
His favouring care our guardian be,
Lest our eyes feed on vanity.

hymn:monastic:Prima.latin:
Sint pura cordis íntima,
Absístat et vecórdia;
Carnis terat supérbiam
Potus cibíque párcitas.
hymn:monastic:Prima.english:
May every heart be pure from sin
And folly find no place therein:
Scant need of food, excess denied,
Wear down in us the body's pride.

hymn:monastic:Prima.latin:
Ut, cum dies abscésserit,
Noctémque sors redúxerit,
Mundi per abstinéntiam
Ipsi canámus glóriam.
hymn:monastic:Prima.english:
That when the light of day is gone,
And night in course shall follow on.
We, free from cares the world affords,
May chant the praise that is our Lord's.

hymn:monastic:Prima.latin:
* Deo Patri sit glória,
Ejúsque soli Fílio,
Cum Spíritu Paráclito,
Et nunc et in perpétuum.
hymn:monastic:Prima.english:
* All laud to God the Father be,
All praise, Eternal Son, to thee:
All glory, as is ever meet,
To God the holy Paraclete.

psalm:118(1-8):gloria.latin: (Aleph) Beáti immaculáti in via: * qui ámbulant in lege Dómini.
psalm:118(1-8):gloria.english: (Aleph) Blessed are the undefiled in the way, * who walk in the law of the Lord.

psalm:118(1-8):gloria.latin: Beáti, qui scrutántur testimónia ejus: * in toto corde exquírunt eum.
psalm:118(1-8):gloria.english: Blessed are they that search his testimonies: * that seek him with their whole heart.

psalm:118(1-8):gloria.latin: Non enim qui operántur iniquitátem, * in viis ejus ambulavérunt.
psalm:118(1-8):gloria.english: For they that work iniquity, * have not walked in his ways.

psalm:118(1-8):gloria.latin: Tu mandásti * mandáta tua custodíri nimis.
psalm:118(1-8):gloria.english: Thou hast commanded * thy commandments to be kept most diligently.

psalm:118(1-8):gloria.latin: Útinam dirigántur viæ meæ, * ad custodiéndas justificatiónes tuas!
psalm:118(1-8):gloria.english: O! that my ways may be directed * to keep thy justifications.

psalm:118(1-8):gloria.latin: Tunc non confúndar, * cum perspéxero in ómnibus mandátis tuis.
psalm:118(1-8):gloria.english: Then shall I not be confounded, * when I shall look into all thy commandments.

psalm:118(1-8):gloria.latin: Confitébor tibi in directióne cordis: * in eo quod dídici judícia justítiæ tuæ.
psalm:118(1-8):gloria.english: I will praise thee with uprightness of heart, * when I shall have learned the judgments of thy justice.

psalm:118(1-8):gloria.latin: Justificatiónes tuas custódiam: * non me derelínquas usquequáque.
psalm:118(1-8):gloria.english: I will keep thy justifications: * O! do not thou utterly forsake me.

psalm:118(1-8):gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:118(1-8):gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:118(1-8):gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:118(1-8):gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:118(9-16):gloria.latin: (Beth) In quo córrigit adolescéntior viam suam? * In custodiéndo sermónes tuos.
psalm:118(9-16):gloria.english: (Béth) By what doth a young man correct his way? * By observing thy words.

psalm:118(9-16):gloria.latin: In toto corde meo exquisívi te: * ne repéllas me a mandátis tuis.
psalm:118(9-16):gloria.english: With my whole heart have I sought after thee: * let me not stray from thy commandments.

psalm:118(9-16):gloria.latin: In corde meo abscóndi elóquia tua: * ut non peccem tibi.
psalm:118(9-16):gloria.english: Thy words have I hidden in my heart, * that I may not sin against thee.

psalm:118(9-16):gloria.latin: Benedíctus es, Dómine: * doce me justificatiónes tuas.
psalm:118(9-16):gloria.english: Blessed art thou, O Lord: * teach me thy justifications.

psalm:118(9-16):gloria.latin: In lábiis meis, * pronuntiávi ómnia judícia oris tui.
psalm:118(9-16):gloria.english: With my lips * I have pronounced all the judgments of thy mouth.

psalm:118(9-16):gloria.latin: In via testimoniórum tuórum delectátus sum, * sicut in ómnibus divítiis.
psalm:118(9-16):gloria.english: I have been delighted in the way of thy testimonies, * as in all riches.

psalm:118(9-16):gloria.latin: In mandátis tuis exercébor: * et considerábo vias tuas.
psalm:118(9-16):gloria.english: I will meditate on thy commandments: * and I will consider thy ways.

psalm:118(9-16):gloria.latin: In justificatiónibus tuis meditábor: * non oblivíscar sermónes tuos.
psalm:118(9-16):gloria.english: I will think of thy justifications: * I will not forget thy words.

psalm:118(9-16):gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:118(9-16):gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:118(9-16):gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:118(9-16):gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:118(17-24):gloria.latin: (Ghimel) Retríbue servo tuo, vivífica me: * et custódiam sermónes tuos:
psalm:118(17-24):gloria.english: (Ghimel) Give bountifully to thy servant, enliven me * and I shall keep thy words.

psalm:118(17-24):gloria.latin: Revéla óculos meos: * et considerábo mirabília de lege tua.
psalm:118(17-24):gloria.english: Open thou my eyes: * and I will consider the wondrous things of thy law.

psalm:118(17-24):gloria.latin: Íncola ego sum in terra: * non abscóndas a me mandáta tua.
psalm:118(17-24):gloria.english: I am a sojourner on the earth: * hide not thy commandments from me.

psalm:118(17-24):gloria.latin: Concupívit ánima mea desideráre justificatiónes tuas, * in omni témpore.
psalm:118(17-24):gloria.english: My soul hath coveted to long for thy justifications, * at all times.

psalm:118(17-24):gloria.latin: Increpásti supérbos: * maledícti qui declínant a mandátis tuis.
psalm:118(17-24):gloria.english: Thou hast rebuked the proud: * they are cursed who decline from thy commandments.

psalm:118(17-24):gloria.latin: Aufer a me oppróbrium, et contémptum: * quia testimónia tua exquisívi.
psalm:118(17-24):gloria.english: Remove from me reproach and contempt: * because I have sought after thy testimonies.

psalm:118(17-24):gloria.latin: Étenim sedérunt príncipes, et advérsum me loquebántur: * servus autem tuus exercebátur in justificatiónibus tuis.
psalm:118(17-24):gloria.english: For princes sat, and spoke against me: * but thy servant was employed in thy justifications.

psalm:118(17-24):gloria.latin: Nam et testimónia tua meditátio mea est: * et consílium meum justificatiónes tuæ.
psalm:118(17-24):gloria.english: For thy testimonies are my meditation: * and thy justifications my counsel.

psalm:118(17-24):gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:118(17-24):gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:118(17-24):gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:118(17-24):gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:118(25-32):gloria.latin: (Daleth) Adhǽsit paviménto ánima mea: * vivífica me secúndum verbum tuum.
psalm:118(25-32):gloria.english: (Daleth) My soul hath cleaved to the pavement: * quicken thou me according to thy word.

psalm:118(25-32):gloria.latin: Vias meas enuntiávi, et exaudísti me: * doce me justificatiónes tuas.
psalm:118(25-32):gloria.english: I have declared my ways, and thou hast heard me: * teach me thy justifications.

psalm:118(25-32):gloria.latin: Viam justificatiónum tuárum ínstrue me: * et exercébor in mirabílibus tuis.
psalm:118(25-32):gloria.english: Make me to understand the way of thy justifications: * and I shall be exercised in thy wondrous works.

psalm:118(25-32):gloria.latin: Dormitávit ánima mea præ tǽdio: * confírma me in verbis tuis.
psalm:118(25-32):gloria.english: My soul hath slumbered through heaviness: * strengthen thou me in thy words.

psalm:118(25-32):gloria.latin: Viam iniquitátis ámove a me: * et de lege tua miserére mei.
psalm:118(25-32):gloria.english: Remove from me the way of iniquity: * and out of thy law have mercy on me.

psalm:118(25-32):gloria.latin: Viam veritátis elégi: * judícia tua non sum oblítus.
psalm:118(25-32):gloria.english: I have chosen the way of truth: * thy judgments I have not forgotten.

psalm:118(25-32):gloria.latin: Adhǽsi testimóniis tuis, Dómine: * noli me confúndere.
psalm:118(25-32):gloria.english: I have stuck to thy testimonies, O Lord: * put me not to shame.

psalm:118(25-32):gloria.latin: Viam mandatórum tuórum cucúrri, * cum dilatásti cor meum.
psalm:118(25-32):gloria.english: I have run the way of thy commandments, * when thou didst enlarge my heart.

psalm:118(25-32):gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:118(25-32):gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:118(25-32):gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:118(25-32):gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

Special/Prima Special.txt:[Dominica].latin: Regi sæculórum immortáli et invisíbili, soli Deo honor et glória in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
Special/Prima Special.txt:[Dominica].english: Now to the king of ages, immortal, invisible, the only God, be honour and glory for ever and ever. Amen.

Common/Prayers.txt:[oratio_Domine].latin: Dómine Deus omnípotens, qui ad princípium hujus diéi nos perveníre fecísti: tua nos hódie salva virtúte; ut in hac die ad nullum declinémus peccátum, sed semper ad tuam justítiam faciéndam nostra procédant elóquia, dirigántur cogitatiónes et ópera.
Common/Prayers.txt:[oratio_Domine].english: O Lord, our heavenly Father, Almighty and everlasting God, who has safely brought us to the beginning of this day: defend us by thy mighty power; and grant that this day we fall into no sin, but that all our doings may be ordered by thy governance, to do always what is righteous in thy sight.

Common/Prayers.txt:[Per Dominum].latin: Per Dóminum nostrum Jesum Christum, Fílium tuum: qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitáte Spíritus Sancti, Deus, per ómnia sǽcula sæculórum.
Common/Prayers.txt:[Per Dominum].english: Through Jesus Christ, thy Son our Lord, Who liveth and reigneth with thee, in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.

Special/Minor Special.txt:[Hymnus Tertia.english: Come Holy Ghost who ever One
Art with the Father and the Son,
It is the hour, our souls possess
With thy full flood of holiness.
Let flesh and heart and lips and mind
Sound forth our witness to mankind;
And love light up our mortal frame,
Till others catch the living flame.
Through Jesus Christ, our Lord most High,
Who, with the Holy Ghost and thee,

hymn:monastic:Tertia.latin:
Nunc, Sancte, nobis, Spíritus,
Unum Patri cum Fílio,
Dignáre promptus íngeri
Nostro refúsus péctori.
hymn:monastic:Tertia.english:
Come Holy Ghost who ever One
Art with the Father and the Son,
It is the hour, our souls possess
With thy full flood of holiness.

hymn:monastic:Tertia.latin:
Os, lingua, mens, sensus, vigor
Confessiónem pérsonent.
Flamméscat igne cáritas,
Accéndat ardor próximos.
hymn:monastic:Tertia.english:
Let flesh and heart and lips and mind
Sound forth our witness to mankind;
And love light up our mortal frame,
Till others catch the living flame.

hymn:monastic:Tertia.latin:
* Præsta, Pater piíssime,
Patríque compar Únice,
Cum Spíritu Paráclito
Regnans per omne sǽculum.
hymn:monastic:Tertia.english:
* Almighty Father, hear our cry,
Through Jesus Christ, our Lord most High,
Who, with the Holy Ghost and thee,
Doth live and reign eternally.

psalm:118(33-40):gloria.latin: (He) Legem pone mihi, Dómine, viam justificatiónum tuárum: * et exquíram eam semper.
psalm:118(33-40):gloria.english: (He) Set before me for a law the way of thy justifications, O Lord: * and I will always seek after it.

psalm:118(33-40):gloria.latin: Da mihi intelléctum, et scrutábor legem tuam: * et custódiam illam in toto corde meo.
psalm:118(33-40):gloria.english: Give me understanding, and I will search thy law; * and I will keep it with my whole heart.

psalm:118(33-40):gloria.latin: Deduc me in sémitam mandatórum tuórum: * quia ipsam vólui.
psalm:118(33-40):gloria.english: Lead me into the path of thy commandments; * for this same I have desired.

psalm:118(33-40):gloria.latin: Inclína cor meum in testimónia tua: * et non in avarítiam.
psalm:118(33-40):gloria.english: Incline my heart into thy testimonies * and not to covetousness.

psalm:118(33-40):gloria.latin: Avérte óculos meos ne vídeant vanitátem: * in via tua vivífica me.
psalm:118(33-40):gloria.english: Turn away my eyes that they may not behold vanity: * quicken me in thy way.

psalm:118(33-40):gloria.latin: Státue servo tuo elóquium tuum, * in timóre tuo.
psalm:118(33-40):gloria.english: Establish thy word to thy servant, * in thy fear.

psalm:118(33-40):gloria.latin: Ámputa oppróbrium meum quod suspicátus sum: * quia judícia tua jucúnda.
psalm:118(33-40):gloria.english: Turn away my reproach, which I have apprehended: * for thy judgments are delightful.

psalm:118(33-40):gloria.latin: Ecce, concupívi mandáta tua: * in æquitáte tua vivífica me.
psalm:118(33-40):gloria.english: Behold I have longed after thy precepts: * quicken me in thy justice.

psalm:118(33-40):gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:118(33-40):gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:118(33-40):gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:118(33-40):gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:118(41-48):gloria.latin: (Vav) Et véniat super me misericórdia tua, Dómine: * salutáre tuum secúndum elóquium tuum.
psalm:118(41-48):gloria.english: (Vau) Let thy mercy also come upon me, O Lord: * thy salvation according to thy word.

psalm:118(41-48):gloria.latin: Et respondébo exprobrántibus mihi verbum: * quia sperávi in sermónibus tuis.
psalm:118(41-48):gloria.english: So shall I answer them that reproach me in any thing; * that I have trusted in thy words.

psalm:118(41-48):gloria.latin: Et ne áuferas de ore meo verbum veritátis usquequáque: * quia in judíciis tuis supersperávi.
psalm:118(41-48):gloria.english: And take not thou the word of truth utterly out of my mouth: * for in thy words, I have hoped exceedingly.

psalm:118(41-48):gloria.latin: Et custódiam legem tuam semper: * in sǽculum et in sǽculum sǽculi.
psalm:118(41-48):gloria.english: So shall I always keep thy law, * for ever and ever.

psalm:118(41-48):gloria.latin: Et ambulábam in latitúdine: * quia mandáta tua exquisívi.
psalm:118(41-48):gloria.english: And I walked at large: * because I have sought after thy commandments.

psalm:118(41-48):gloria.latin: Et loquébar in testimóniis tuis in conspéctu regum: * et non confundébar.
psalm:118(41-48):gloria.english: And I spoke of thy testimonies before kings: * and I was not ashamed.

psalm:118(41-48):gloria.latin: Et meditábar in mandátis tuis, * quæ diléxi.
psalm:118(41-48):gloria.english: I meditated also on thy commandments, * which I loved.

psalm:118(41-48):gloria.latin: Et levávi manus meas ad mandáta tua, quæ diléxi: * et exercébar in justificatiónibus tuis.
psalm:118(41-48):gloria.english: And I lifted up my hands to thy commandments, which I loved: * and I was exercised in thy justifications.

psalm:118(41-48):gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:118(41-48):gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:118(41-48):gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:118(41-48):gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:118(49-56):gloria.latin: (Zai) Memor esto verbi tui servo tuo, * in quo mihi spem dedísti.
psalm:118(49-56):gloria.english: (Zai) Be thou mindful of thy word to thy servant, * in which thou hast given me hope.

psalm:118(49-56):gloria.latin: Hæc me consoláta est in humilitáte mea: * quia elóquium tuum vivificávit me.
psalm:118(49-56):gloria.english: This hath comforted me in my humiliation: * because thy word hath enlivened me.

psalm:118(49-56):gloria.latin: Supérbi iníque agébant usquequáque: * a lege autem tua non declinávi.
psalm:118(49-56):gloria.english: The proud did iniquitously altogether: * but I declined not from thy law.

psalm:118(49-56):gloria.latin: Memor fui judiciórum tuórum a sǽculo, Dómine: * et consolátus sum.
psalm:118(49-56):gloria.english: I remembered, O Lord, thy judgments of old: * and I was comforted.

psalm:118(49-56):gloria.latin: Deféctio ténuit me, * pro peccatóribus derelinquéntibus legem tuam.
psalm:118(49-56):gloria.english: A fainting hath taken hold of me, * because of the wicked that forsake thy law.

psalm:118(49-56):gloria.latin: Cantábiles mihi erant justificatiónes tuæ, * in loco peregrinatiónis meæ.
psalm:118(49-56):gloria.english: Thy justifications were the subject of my song, * in the place of my pilgrimage.

psalm:118(49-56):gloria.latin: Memor fui nocte nóminis tui, Dómine: * et custodívi legem tuam.
psalm:118(49-56):gloria.english: In the night I have remembered thy name, O Lord: * and have kept thy law.

psalm:118(49-56):gloria.latin: Hæc facta est mihi: * quia justificatiónes tuas exquisívi.
psalm:118(49-56):gloria.english: This happened to me: * because I sought after thy justifications.

psalm:118(49-56):gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:118(49-56):gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:118(49-56):gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:118(49-56):gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

Special/Minor Special.txt:[Hymnus Sexta].english: O God of truth, O Lord of might,
Who orderest time and change aright,
Who send’st the early morning ray,
And light’st the glow of perfect day:
And while thou keep’st the body whole,
Shed forth thy peace upon the soul.
Through Jesus Christ, our Lord most High,
Who, with the Holy Ghost and thee,

hymn:monastic:Sexta.latin:
Rector potens, verax Deus,
Qui témperas rerum vices,
Splendóre mane ínstruis,
Et ígnibus merídiem:
hymn:monastic:Sexta.english:
O God of truth, O Lord of might,
Who orderest time and change aright,
Who send’st the early morning ray,
And light’st the glow of perfect day:

hymn:monastic:Sexta.latin:
Exstíngue flammas lítium,
Aufer calórem nóxium,
Confer salútem córporum,
Verámque pacem córdium.
hymn:monastic:Sexta.english:
Extinguish thou each sinful fire,
And banish every ill desire;
And while thou keep’st the body whole,
Shed forth thy peace upon the soul.

hymn:monastic:Sexta.latin:
* Præsta, Pater piíssime,
Patríque compar Únice,
Cum Spíritu Paráclito
Regnans per omne sǽculum.
hymn:monastic:Sexta.english:
* Almighty Father, hear our cry,
Through Jesus Christ, our Lord most High,
Who, with the Holy Ghost and thee,
Doth live and reign eternally.

psalm:118(57-64):gloria.latin: (Heth) Pórtio mea, Dómine, * dixi custodíre legem tuam.
psalm:118(57-64):gloria.english: (Heth) O Lord, my portion, * I have said, I would keep thy law.

psalm:118(57-64):gloria.latin: Deprecátus sum fáciem tuam in toto corde meo: * miserére mei secúndum elóquium tuum.
psalm:118(57-64):gloria.english: I entreated thy face with all my heart: * have mercy on me according to thy word.

psalm:118(57-64):gloria.latin: Cogitávi vias meas: * et convérti pedes meos in testimónia tua.
psalm:118(57-64):gloria.english: I have thought on my ways: * and turned my feet unto thy testimonies.

psalm:118(57-64):gloria.latin: Parátus sum, et non sum turbátus: * ut custódiam mandáta tua.
psalm:118(57-64):gloria.english: I am ready, and am not troubled: * that I may keep thy commandments.

psalm:118(57-64):gloria.latin: Funes peccatórum circumpléxi sunt me: * et legem tuam non sum oblítus.
psalm:118(57-64):gloria.english: The cords of the wicked have encompassed me: * but I have not forgotten thy law.

psalm:118(57-64):gloria.latin: Média nocte surgébam ad confiténdum tibi, * super judícia justificatiónis tuæ.
psalm:118(57-64):gloria.english: I rose at midnight to give praise to thee; * for the judgments of thy justification.

psalm:118(57-64):gloria.latin: Párticeps ego sum ómnium timéntium te: * et custodiéntium mandáta tua.
psalm:118(57-64):gloria.english: I am a partaker with all them that fear thee, * and that keep thy commandments.

psalm:118(57-64):gloria.latin: Misericórdia tua, Dómine, plena est terra: * justificatiónes tuas doce me.
psalm:118(57-64):gloria.english: The earth, O Lord, is full of thy mercy: * teach me thy justifications.

psalm:118(57-64):gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:118(57-64):gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:118(57-64):gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:118(57-64):gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:118(65-72):gloria.latin: (Teth) Bonitátem fecísti cum servo tuo, Dómine, * secúndum verbum tuum.
psalm:118(65-72):gloria.english: (Teth) Thou hast done well with thy servant, O Lord, * according to thy word.

psalm:118(65-72):gloria.latin: Bonitátem, et disciplínam, et sciéntiam doce me: * quia mandátis tuis crédidi.
psalm:118(65-72):gloria.english: Teach me goodness and discipline and knowledge; * for I have believed thy commandments.

psalm:118(65-72):gloria.latin: Priúsquam humiliárer ego delíqui: * proptérea elóquium tuum custodívi.
psalm:118(65-72):gloria.english: Before I was humbled I offended; * therefore have I kept thy word.

psalm:118(65-72):gloria.latin: Bonus es tu: * et in bonitáte tua doce me justificatiónes tuas.
psalm:118(65-72):gloria.english: Thou art good; * and in thy goodness teach me thy justifications.

psalm:118(65-72):gloria.latin: Multiplicáta est super me iníquitas superbórum: * ego autem in toto corde meo scrutábor mandáta tua.
psalm:118(65-72):gloria.english: The iniquity of the proud hath been multiplied over me: * but I will seek thy commandments with my whole heart.

psalm:118(65-72):gloria.latin: Coagulátum est sicut lac cor eórum: * ego vero legem tuam meditátus sum.
psalm:118(65-72):gloria.english: Their heart is curdled like milk: * but I have meditated on thy law.

psalm:118(65-72):gloria.latin: Bonum mihi quia humiliásti me: * ut discam justificatiónes tuas.
psalm:118(65-72):gloria.english: It is good for me that thou hast humbled me, * that I may learn thy justifications.

psalm:118(65-72):gloria.latin: Bonum mihi lex oris tui, * super míllia auri et argénti.
psalm:118(65-72):gloria.english: The law of thy mouth is good to me, * above thousands of gold and silver.

psalm:118(65-72):gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:118(65-72):gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:118(65-72):gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:118(65-72):gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:118(73-80):gloria.latin: (Joth) Manus tuæ fecérunt me, et plasmavérunt me: * da mihi intelléctum, et discam mandáta tua.
psalm:118(73-80):gloria.english: (Jod) Thy hands have made me and formed me: * give me understanding, and I will learn thy commandments.

psalm:118(73-80):gloria.latin: Qui timent te vidébunt me, et lætabúntur: * quia in verba tua supersperávi.
psalm:118(73-80):gloria.english: They that fear thee shall see me, and shall be glad: * because I have greatly hoped in thy words.

psalm:118(73-80):gloria.latin: Cognóvi, Dómine, quia ǽquitas judícia tua: * et in veritáte tua humiliásti me.
psalm:118(73-80):gloria.english: I know, O Lord, that thy judgments are equity: * and in thy truth thou hast humbled me.

psalm:118(73-80):gloria.latin: Fiat misericórdia tua ut consolétur me, * secúndum elóquium tuum servo tuo.
psalm:118(73-80):gloria.english: O! let thy mercy be for my comfort, * according to thy word unto thy servant.

psalm:118(73-80):gloria.latin: Véniant mihi miseratiónes tuæ, et vivam: * quia lex tua meditátio mea est.
psalm:118(73-80):gloria.english: Let thy tender mercies come unto me, and I shall live: * for thy law is my meditation.

psalm:118(73-80):gloria.latin: Confundántur supérbi, quia injúste iniquitátem fecérunt in me: * ego autem exercébor in mandátis tuis.
psalm:118(73-80):gloria.english: Let the proud be ashamed, because they have done unjustly towards me: * but I will be employed in thy commandments.

psalm:118(73-80):gloria.latin: Convertántur mihi timéntes te: * et qui novérunt testimónia tua.
psalm:118(73-80):gloria.english: Let them that fear thee turn to me: * and they that know thy testimonies.

psalm:118(73-80):gloria.latin: Fiat cor meum immaculátum in justificatiónibus tuis, * ut non confúndar.
psalm:118(73-80):gloria.english: Let my heart be undefiled in thy justifications, * that I may not be confounded.

psalm:118(73-80):gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:118(73-80):gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:118(73-80):gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:118(73-80):gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

Special/Minor Special.txt:[Hymnus Nona].english: O strength and stay upholding all creation,
Who ever dost thyself unmoved abide,
Yet day by day the light in due gradation
From hour to hour through all its changes guide:
Grant to life’s day a calm unclouded ending,
An eve untouched by shadows of decay,
The brightness of a holy death-bed blending
With dawning glories of th’ eternal day.
* Hear us, O Father, gracious and forgiving,
And thou, O Christ, the co-eternal Word,
Who, with the Holy Ghost, by all things living
Now and to endless ages art adored.

hymn:monastic:Nona.latin:
Rerum, Deus, tenax vigor,
Immótus in te pérmanens,
Lucis diúrnæ témpora
Succéssibus detérminans:
hymn:monastic:Nona.english:
O strength and stay upholding all creation,
Who ever dost thyself unmoved abide,
Yet day by day the light in due gradation
From hour to hour through all its changes guide:

hymn:monastic:Nona.latin:
Largíre clarum véspere,
Quo vita nusquam décidat,
Sed prǽmium mortis sacræ
Perénnis instet glória.
hymn:monastic:Nona.english:
Grant to life’s day a calm unclouded ending,
An eve untouched by shadows of decay,
The brightness of a holy death-bed blending
With dawning glories of th’ eternal day.

hymn:monastic:Nona.latin:
* Præsta, Pater piíssime,
Patríque compar Únice,
Cum Spíritu Paráclito
Regnans per omne sǽculum.
hymn:monastic:Nona.english:
* Hear us, O Father, gracious and forgiving,
And thou, O Christ, the co-eternal Word,
Who, with the Holy Ghost, by all things living
Now and to endless ages art adored.

psalm:118(81-88):gloria.latin: (Caph) Defécit in salutáre tuum ánima mea: * et in verbum tuum supersperávi.
psalm:118(81-88):gloria.english: (Caph) My soul hath fainted after thy salvation: * and in thy word I have very much hoped.

psalm:118(81-88):gloria.latin: Defecérunt óculi mei in elóquium tuum, * dicéntes: Quando consoláberis me?
psalm:118(81-88):gloria.english: My eyes have failed for thy word, * saying: When wilt thou comfort me?

psalm:118(81-88):gloria.latin: Quia factus sum sicut uter in pruína: * justificatiónes tuas non sum oblítus.
psalm:118(81-88):gloria.english: For I am become like a bottle in the frost: * I have not forgotten thy justifications.

psalm:118(81-88):gloria.latin: Quot sunt dies servi tui? * quando fácies de persequéntibus me judícium?
psalm:118(81-88):gloria.english: How many are the days of thy servant: * when wilt thou execute judgment on them that persecute me?

psalm:118(81-88):gloria.latin: Narravérunt mihi iníqui fabulatiónes: * sed non ut lex tua.
psalm:118(81-88):gloria.english: The wicked have told me fables: * but not as thy law.

psalm:118(81-88):gloria.latin: Ómnia mandáta tua véritas: * iníque persecúti sunt me, ádjuva me.
psalm:118(81-88):gloria.english: All thy statutes are truth: * they have persecuted me unjustly, do thou help me.

psalm:118(81-88):gloria.latin: Paulo minus consummavérunt me in terra: * ego autem non derelíqui mandáta tua.
psalm:118(81-88):gloria.english: They had almost made an end of me upon earth: * but I have not forsaken thy commandments.

psalm:118(81-88):gloria.latin: Secúndum misericórdiam tuam vivífica me: * et custódiam testimónia oris tui.
psalm:118(81-88):gloria.english: Quicken thou me according to thy mercy: * and I shall keep the testimonies of thy mouth.

psalm:118(81-88):gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:118(81-88):gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:118(81-88):gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:118(81-88):gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:118(89-96):gloria.latin: (Lamed) In ætérnum, Dómine, * verbum tuum pérmanet in cælo.
psalm:118(89-96):gloria.english: (Lamed) For ever, O Lord, * thy word standeth firm in heaven.

psalm:118(89-96):gloria.latin: In generatiónem et generatiónem véritas tua: * fundásti terram, et pérmanet.
psalm:118(89-96):gloria.english: Thy truth unto all generations: * thou hast founded the earth, and it continueth.

psalm:118(89-96):gloria.latin: Ordinatióne tua persevérat dies: * quóniam ómnia sérviunt tibi.
psalm:118(89-96):gloria.english: By thy ordinance the day goeth on: * for all things serve thee.

psalm:118(89-96):gloria.latin: Nisi quod lex tua meditátio mea est: * tunc forte periíssem in humilitáte mea.
psalm:118(89-96):gloria.english: Unless thy law had been my meditation, * I had then perhaps perished in my abjection.

psalm:118(89-96):gloria.latin: In ætérnum non oblivíscar justificatiónes tuas: * quia in ipsis vivificásti me.
psalm:118(89-96):gloria.english: Thy justifications I will never forget: * for by them thou hast given me life.

psalm:118(89-96):gloria.latin: Tuus sum ego, salvum me fac: * quóniam justificatiónes tuas exquisívi.
psalm:118(89-96):gloria.english: I am thine, save thou me: * for I have sought thy justifications.

psalm:118(89-96):gloria.latin: Me exspectavérunt peccatóres ut pérderent me: * testimónia tua intelléxi.
psalm:118(89-96):gloria.english: The wicked have waited for me to destroy me: * but I have understood thy testimonies.

psalm:118(89-96):gloria.latin: Omnis consummatiónis vidi finem: * latum mandátum tuum nimis.
psalm:118(89-96):gloria.english: I have seen an end of all perfection: * thy commandment is exceeding broad.

psalm:118(89-96):gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:118(89-96):gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:118(89-96):gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:118(89-96):gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:118(97-104):gloria.latin: (Mem) Quómodo diléxi legem tuam, Dómine? * tota die meditátio mea est.
psalm:118(97-104):gloria.english: (Mem) How have I loved thy law, O Lord! * it is my meditation all the day.

psalm:118(97-104):gloria.latin: Super inimícos meos prudéntem me fecísti mandáto tuo: * quia in ætérnum mihi est.
psalm:118(97-104):gloria.english: Through thy commandment, thou hast made me wiser than my enemies: * for it is ever with me.

psalm:118(97-104):gloria.latin: Super omnes docéntes me intelléxi: * quia testimónia tua meditátio mea est.
psalm:118(97-104):gloria.english: I have understood more than all my teachers: * because thy testimonies are my meditation.

psalm:118(97-104):gloria.latin: Super senes intelléxi: * quia mandáta tua quæsívi.
psalm:118(97-104):gloria.english: I have had understanding above ancients: * because I have sought thy commandments.

psalm:118(97-104):gloria.latin: Ab omni via mala prohíbui pedes meos: * ut custódiam verba tua.
psalm:118(97-104):gloria.english: I have restrained my feet from every evil way: * that I may keep thy words.

psalm:118(97-104):gloria.latin: A judíciis tuis non declinávi: * quia tu legem posuísti mihi.
psalm:118(97-104):gloria.english: I have not declined from thy judgments, * because thou hast set me a law.

psalm:118(97-104):gloria.latin: Quam dúlcia fáucibus meis elóquia tua, * super mel ori meo!
psalm:118(97-104):gloria.english: How sweet are thy words to my palate! * more than honey to my mouth.

psalm:118(97-104):gloria.latin: A mandátis tuis intelléxi: * proptérea odívi omnem viam iniquitátis.
psalm:118(97-104):gloria.english: By thy commandments I have had understanding: * therefore have I hated every way of iniquity.

psalm:118(97-104):gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:118(97-104):gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:118(97-104):gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:118(97-104):gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:109:gloria.latin: Dixit Dóminus Dómino meo: * Sede a dextris meis:
psalm:109:gloria.english: The Lord said to my Lord: * Sit thou at my right hand:

psalm:109:gloria.latin: Donec ponam inimícos tuos, * scabéllum pedum tuórum.
psalm:109:gloria.english: Until I make thy enemies * thy footstool.

psalm:109:gloria.latin: Virgam virtútis tuæ emíttet Dóminus ex Sion: * domináre in médio inimicórum tuórum.
psalm:109:gloria.english: The Lord will send forth the sceptre of thy power out of Sion: * rule thou in the midst of thy enemies.

psalm:109:gloria.latin: Tecum princípium in die virtútis tuæ in splendóribus sanctórum: * ex útero ante lucíferum génui te.
psalm:109:gloria.english: With thee is the principality in the day of thy strength: in the brightness of the saints: * from the womb before the day star I begot thee.

psalm:109:gloria.latin: Jurávit Dóminus, et non pœnitébit eum: * Tu es sacérdos in ætérnum secúndum órdinem Melchísedech.
psalm:109:gloria.english: The Lord hath sworn, and he will not repent: * Thou art a priest for ever according to the order of Melchisedech.

psalm:109:gloria.latin: Dóminus a dextris tuis, * confrégit in die iræ suæ reges.
psalm:109:gloria.english: The Lord at thy right hand * hath broken kings in the day of his wrath.

psalm:109:gloria.latin: Judicábit in natiónibus, implébit ruínas: * conquassábit cápita in terra multórum.
psalm:109:gloria.english: He shall judge among nations, he shall fill ruins: * he shall crush the heads in the land of many.

psalm:109:gloria.latin: De torrénte in via bibet: * proptérea exaltábit caput.
psalm:109:gloria.english: He shall drink of the torrent in the way: * therefore shall he lift up the head.

psalm:109:gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:109:gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:109:gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:109:gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:110:gloria.latin: Confitébor tibi, Dómine, in toto corde meo: * in consílio justórum, et congregatióne.
psalm:110:gloria.english: I will praise thee, O Lord, with my whole heart; * in the council of the just, and in the congregation.

psalm:110:gloria.latin: Magna ópera Dómini: * exquisíta in omnes voluntátes ejus.
psalm:110:gloria.english: Great are the works of the Lord: * sought out according to all his wills.

psalm:110:gloria.latin: Conféssio et magnificéntia opus ejus: * et justítia ejus manet in sǽculum sǽculi.
psalm:110:gloria.english: His work is praise and magnificence: * and his justice continueth for ever and ever.

psalm:110:gloria.latin: Memóriam fecit mirabílium suórum, † miséricors et miserátor Dóminus: * (5a) escam dedit timéntibus se.
psalm:110:gloria.english: He hath made a remembrance of his wonderful works, † being a merciful and gracious Lord: * (5a) he hath given food to them that fear him.

psalm:110:gloria.latin: Memor erit in sǽculum testaménti sui: * (6) virtútem óperum suórum annuntiábit pópulo suo:
psalm:110:gloria.english: He will be mindful for ever of his covenant: * (6) he will shew forth to his people the power of his works.

psalm:110:gloria.latin: Ut det illis hereditátem géntium: * ópera mánuum ejus véritas, et judícium.
psalm:110:gloria.english: That he may give them the inheritance of the Gentiles: * the works of his hands are truth and judgment.

psalm:110:gloria.latin: Fidélia ómnia mandáta ejus: † confirmáta in sǽculum sǽculi, * facta in veritáte et æquitáte.
psalm:110:gloria.english: All his commandments are faithful: † confirmed for ever and ever, * made in truth and equity.

psalm:110:gloria.latin: Redemptiónem misit pópulo suo: * mandávit in ætérnum testaméntum suum.
psalm:110:gloria.english: He hath sent redemption to his people: * he hath commanded his covenant for ever.

psalm:110:gloria.latin: (fit reverentia) Sanctum, et terríbile nomen ejus: * (10a) inítium sapiéntiæ timor Dómini.
psalm:110:gloria.english: (bow head) Holy and terrible is his name: * (10a) the fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom.

psalm:110:gloria.latin: Intelléctus bonus ómnibus faciéntibus eum: * laudátio ejus manet in sǽculum sǽculi.
psalm:110:gloria.english: A good understanding to all that do it: * his praise continueth for ever and ever.

psalm:110:gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:110:gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:110:gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:110:gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:111:gloria.latin: Beátus vir, qui timet Dóminum: * in mandátis ejus volet nimis.
psalm:111:gloria.english: Blessed is the man that feareth the Lord: * he shall delight exceedingly in his commandments.

psalm:111:gloria.latin: Potens in terra erit semen ejus: * generátio rectórum benedicétur.
psalm:111:gloria.english: His seed shall be mighty upon earth: * the generation of the righteous shall be blessed.

psalm:111:gloria.latin: Glória, et divítiæ in domo ejus: * et justítia ejus manet in sǽculum sǽculi.
psalm:111:gloria.english: Glory and wealth shall be in his house: * and his justice remaineth for ever and ever.

psalm:111:gloria.latin: Exórtum est in ténebris lumen rectis: * miséricors, et miserátor, et justus.
psalm:111:gloria.english: To the righteous a light is risen up in darkness: * he is merciful, and compassionate and just.

psalm:111:gloria.latin: Jucúndus homo qui miserétur et cómmodat, † dispónet sermónes suos in judício: * (6) quia in ætérnum non commovébitur.
psalm:111:gloria.english: Acceptable is the man that sheweth mercy and lendeth: † he shall order his words with judgment: * (6) because he shall not be moved for ever.

psalm:111:gloria.latin: In memória ætérna erit justus: * ab auditióne mala non timébit.
psalm:111:gloria.english: The just shall be in everlasting remembrance: * he shall not fear the evil hearing.

psalm:111:gloria.latin: Parátum cor ejus speráre in Dómino, † (8) confirmátum est cor ejus: * non commovébitur donec despíciat inimícos suos.
psalm:111:gloria.english: His heart is ready to hope in the Lord: † (8) his heart is strengthened, * he shall not be moved until he look over his enemies.

psalm:111:gloria.latin: Dispérsit, dedit paupéribus: † justítia ejus manet in sǽculum sǽculi, * cornu ejus exaltábitur in glória.
psalm:111:gloria.english: He hath distributed, he hath given to the poor: † his justice remaineth for ever and ever: * his horn shall be exalted in glory.

psalm:111:gloria.latin: Peccátor vidébit, et irascétur, † déntibus suis fremet et tabéscet: * desidérium peccatórum períbit.
psalm:111:gloria.english: The wicked shall see, and shall be angry, † he shall gnash with his teeth and pine away: * the desire of the wicked shall perish.

psalm:111:gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:111:gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:111:gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:111:gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:112:gloria.latin: Laudáte, púeri, Dóminum: * laudáte nomen Dómini.
psalm:112:gloria.english: Praise the Lord, ye children: * praise ye the name of the Lord.

psalm:112:gloria.latin: (fit reverentia) Sit nomen Dómini benedíctum, * ex hoc nunc, et usque in sǽculum.
psalm:112:gloria.english: (bow head) Blessed be the name of the Lord, * from henceforth now and for ever.

psalm:112:gloria.latin: A solis ortu usque ad occásum, * laudábile nomen Dómini.
psalm:112:gloria.english: From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same, * the name of the Lord is worthy of praise.

psalm:112:gloria.latin: Excélsus super omnes gentes Dóminus, * et super cælos glória ejus.
psalm:112:gloria.english: The Lord is high above all nations; * and his glory above the heavens.

psalm:112:gloria.latin: Quis sicut Dóminus, Deus noster, qui in altis hábitat, * (6) et humília réspicit in cælo et in terra?
psalm:112:gloria.english: Who is as the Lord our God, who dwelleth on high: * (6) and looketh down on the low things in heaven and in earth?

psalm:112:gloria.latin: Súscitans a terra ínopem, * et de stércore érigens páuperem:
psalm:112:gloria.english: Raising up the needy from the earth, * and lifting up the poor out of the dunghill:

psalm:112:gloria.latin: Ut cóllocet eum cum princípibus, * cum princípibus pópuli sui.
psalm:112:gloria.english: That he may place him with princes, * with the princes of his people.

psalm:112:gloria.latin: Qui habitáre facit stérilem in domo, * matrem filiórum lætántem.
psalm:112:gloria.english: Who maketh a barren woman to dwell in a house, * the joyful mother of children.

psalm:112:gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:112:gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:112:gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:112:gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:232:gloria.english: My soul + * doth magnify the Lord.

psalm:232:gloria.latin: Et exsultávit spíritus meus: * in Deo, salutári meo.
psalm:232:gloria.english: And my spirit hath rejoiced * in God my Saviour.

psalm:232:gloria.latin: Quia respéxit humilitátem ancíllæ suæ: * ecce enim ex hoc beátam me dicent omnes generatiónes.
psalm:232:gloria.english: Because he hath regarded the humility of his handmaid; * for behold from henceforth all generations shall call me blessed.

psalm:232:gloria.latin: Quia fecit mihi magna qui potens est: * et sanctum nomen ejus.
psalm:232:gloria.english: Because he that is mighty, hath done great things to me; * and holy is his name.

psalm:232:gloria.latin: Et misericórdia ejus, a progénie in progénies: * timéntibus eum.
psalm:232:gloria.english: And his mercy is from generation unto generations, * to them that fear him.

psalm:232:gloria.latin: Fecit poténtiam in brácchio suo: * dispérsit supérbos mente cordis sui.
psalm:232:gloria.english: He hath shewed might in his arm: * he hath scattered the proud in the conceit of their heart.

psalm:232:gloria.latin: Depósuit poténtes de sede: * et exaltávit húmiles.
psalm:232:gloria.english: He hath put down the mighty from their seat, * and hath exalted the humble.

psalm:232:gloria.latin: Esuriéntes implévit bonis: * et dívites dimísit inánes.
psalm:232:gloria.english: He hath filled the hungry with good things; * and the rich he hath sent empty away.

psalm:232:gloria.latin: Suscépit Israël púerum suum: * recordátus misericórdiæ suæ.
psalm:232:gloria.english: He hath received Israel his servant, * being mindful of his mercy:

psalm:232:gloria.latin: Sicut locútus est ad patres nostros: * Ábraham, et sémini ejus in sǽcula.
psalm:232:gloria.english: As he spoke to our fathers, * to Abraham and to his seed for ever.

psalm:232:gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:232:gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:232:gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:232:gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

Common/Prayers.txt:[Benedictio Completor.latin: Noctem quiétam et finem perféctum concédat nobis Dóminus omnípotens.
Common/Prayers.txt:[Benedictio Completor.english: May almighty God grant us a quiet night and a perfect end.

Special/Minor Special.txt:[Lectio Comple.latin: Fratres: Sóbrii estóte, et vigiláte: quia adversárius vester diábolus tamquam leo rúgiens círcuit, quærens quem dévoret: cui resístite fortes in fide.
Special/Minor Special.txt:[Lectio Comple.english: Brothers: Be sober and watch: because your adversary the devil, as a roaring lion, goeth about seeking whom he may devour. Whom resist ye, strong in faith.

Common/Prayers.txt:[Tu autem_].english: But thou, O Lord, have mercy upon us.

Common/Prayers.txt:[Adjutorium nostrum].english: Our help is + in the name of the Lord,

Common/Prayers.txt:[Pater noster].latin: Pater noster, qui es in cælis, sanctificétur nomen tuum: advéniat regnum tuum: fiat volúntas tua, sicut in cælo et in terra. Panem nostrum cotidiánum da nobis hódie: et dimítte nobis débita nostra, sicut et nos dimíttimus debitóribus nostris: et ne nos indúcas in tentatiónem: sed líbera nos a malo. Amen.
Common/Prayers.txt:[Pater noster].english: Our Father, who art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come. Thy will be done on earth as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread. And forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us. And lead us not into temptation: But deliver us from evil. Amen.

Common/Prayers.txt:[Confiteor_].latin: Confíteor Deo omnipoténti, beátæ Maríæ semper Vírgini, beáto Michaéli Archángelo, beáto Joánni Baptístæ, sanctis Apóstolis Petro et Paulo, et ómnibus Sanctis, quia peccávi nimis, cogitatióne, verbo et ópere: mea culpa, mea culpa, mea máxima culpa. Ídeo precor beátam Maríam semper Vírginem, beátum Michaélem Archángelum, beátum Joánnem Baptístam, sanctos Apóstolos Petrum et Paulum, et omnes Sanctos, oráre pro me ad Dóminum Deum nostrum.
Common/Prayers.txt:[Confiteor_].english: I confess to almighty God, to blessed Mary ever Virgin, to blessed Michael the Archangel, to blessed John the Baptist, to the holy Apostles Peter and Paul, and to all the Saints, that I have sinned exceedingly in thought, word and deed: through my fault, through my fault, through my most grievous fault. Therefore I beseech blessed Mary ever Virgin, blessed Michael the Archangel, blessed John the Baptist, the holy Apostles Peter and Paul, and all the Saints, to pray for me to the Lord our God.

confiteor:monastic-private.latin: Confíteor Deo omnipoténti, beátæ Maríæ semper Vírgini, beáto Michaéli Archángelo, beáto Joánni Baptístæ, sanctis Apóstolis Petro et Paulo, beáto Patri nostro Benedícto, et ómnibus Sanctis, quia peccávi nimis, cogitatióne, verbo et ópere: mea culpa, mea culpa, mea máxima culpa.
