Ídeo precor beátam Maríam semper Vírginem, beátum Michaélem Archángelum, beátum Joánnem Baptístam, sanctos Apóstolos Petrum et Paulum, beátum Patrem nostrum Benedíctum, et omnes Sanctos, oráre pro me ad Dóminum Deum nostrum.
confiteor:monastic-private.english: I confess to almighty God, to blessed Mary ever Virgin, to blessed Michael the Archangel, to blessed John the Baptist, to the holy Apostles Peter and Paul, our holy Father Benedict, and to all the Saints, that I have sinned exceedingly in thought, word and deed: through my fault, through my fault, through my most grievous fault. Therefore I beseech blessed Mary ever Virgin, blessed Michael the Archangel, blessed John the Baptist, the holy Apostles Peter and Paul, our holy Father Benedict, and all the Saints, to pray for me to the Lord our God.

Common/Prayers.txt:[Misereatur].latin: Misereátur nostri omnípotens Deus, et dimíssis peccátis nostris, perdúcat nos ad vitam ætérnam. Amen.
Common/Prayers.txt:[Misereatur].english: May almighty God have mercy on us, forgive us our sins, and bring us to everlasting life. Amen.

Common/Prayers.txt:[Indulgentiam].latin: Indulgéntiam, + absolutiónem et remissiónem peccatórum nostrórum tríbuat nobis omnípotens et miséricors Dóminus. Amen.
Common/Prayers.txt:[Indulgentiam].english: May the almighty + and merciful Lord grant us pardon, absolution and remission of our sins. Amen.

Common/Prayers.txt:[Converte nos].english: Turn us then, + O God, our saviour:

Common/Prayers.txt:[Converte nos].latin: Et avérte iram tuam a nobis.
Common/Prayers.txt:[Converte nos].english: And let thy anger cease from us.

psalm:4:gloria.latin: Cum invocárem exaudívit me Deus justítiæ meæ: * in tribulatióne dilatásti mihi.
psalm:4:gloria.english: When I called upon him, the God of my justice heard me: * when I was in distress, thou hast enlarged me.

psalm:4:gloria.latin: Miserére mei, * et exáudi oratiónem meam.
psalm:4:gloria.english: Have mercy on me: * and hear my prayer.

psalm:4:gloria.latin: Fílii hóminum, úsquequo gravi corde? * ut quid dilígitis vanitátem, et quǽritis mendácium?
psalm:4:gloria.english: O ye sons of men, how long will you be dull of heart? * Why do you love vanity, and seek after lying?

psalm:4:gloria.latin: Et scitóte quóniam mirificávit Dóminus sanctum suum: * Dóminus exáudiet me cum clamávero ad eum.
psalm:4:gloria.english: Know ye also that the Lord hath made his holy one wonderful: * the Lord will hear me when I shall cry unto him.

psalm:4:gloria.latin: Irascímini, et nolíte peccáre: ‡ quæ dícitis in córdibus vestris, * in cubílibus vestris compungímini.
psalm:4:gloria.english: Be ye angry, and sin not: ‡ the things you say in your hearts, * be sorry for them upon your beds.

psalm:4:gloria.latin: Sacrificáte sacrifícium justítiæ, † et speráte in Dómino. * Multi dicunt: Quis osténdit nobis bona?
psalm:4:gloria.english: Offer up the sacrifice of justice, † and trust in the Lord: * many say, Who sheweth us good things?

psalm:4:gloria.latin: Signátum est super nos lumen vultus tui, Dómine: * dedísti lætítiam in corde meo.
psalm:4:gloria.english: The light of thy countenance, O Lord, is signed upon us: * thou hast given gladness in my heart.

psalm:4:gloria.latin: A fructu fruménti, vini, et ólei sui * multiplicáti sunt.
psalm:4:gloria.english: By the fruit of their corn, their wine, and oil, * they are multiplied.

psalm:4:gloria.latin: In pace in idípsum * dórmiam, et requiéscam;
psalm:4:gloria.english: In peace in the selfsame * I will sleep, and I will rest:

psalm:4:gloria.latin: Quóniam tu, Dómine, singuláriter in spe * constituísti me.
psalm:4:gloria.english: For thou, O Lord, singularly * hast settled me in hope.

psalm:4:gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:4:gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:4:gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:4:gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:90:gloria.latin: Qui hábitat in adjutório Altíssimi, * in protectióne Dei cæli commorábitur.
psalm:90:gloria.english: He that dwelleth in the aid of the most High, * shall abide under the protection of the God of Jacob.

psalm:90:gloria.latin: Dicet Dómino: Suscéptor meus es tu, et refúgium meum: * Deus meus sperábo in eum.
psalm:90:gloria.english: He shall say to the Lord: Thou art my protector, and my refuge: * my God, in him will I trust.

psalm:90:gloria.latin: Quóniam ipse liberávit me de láqueo venántium, * et a verbo áspero.
psalm:90:gloria.english: For he hath delivered me from the snare of the hunters: * and from the sharp word.

psalm:90:gloria.latin: Scápulis suis obumbrábit tibi: * et sub pennis ejus sperábis.
psalm:90:gloria.english: He will overshadow thee with his shoulders: * and under his wings thou shalt trust.

psalm:90:gloria.latin: Scuto circúmdabit te véritas ejus: * non timébis a timóre noctúrno,
psalm:90:gloria.english: His truth shall compass thee with a shield: * thou shalt not be afraid of the terror of the night.

psalm:90:gloria.latin: A sagítta volánte in die, † a negótio perambulánte in ténebris: * ab incúrsu, et dæmónio meridiáno.
psalm:90:gloria.english: Of the arrow that flieth in the day, † of the business that walketh about in the dark: * of invasion, or of the noonday devil.

psalm:90:gloria.latin: Cadent a látere tuo mille, † et decem míllia a dextris tuis: * ad te autem non appropinquábit.
psalm:90:gloria.english: A thousand shall fall at thy side, † and ten thousand at thy right hand: * but it shall not come nigh thee.

psalm:90:gloria.latin: Verúmtamen óculis tuis considerábis: * et retributiónem peccatórum vidébis.
psalm:90:gloria.english: But thou shalt consider with thy eyes: * and shalt see the reward of the wicked.

psalm:90:gloria.latin: Quóniam tu es, Dómine, spes mea: * Altíssimum posuísti refúgium tuum.
psalm:90:gloria.english: Because thou, O Lord, art my hope: * thou hast made the most High thy refuge.

psalm:90:gloria.latin: Non accédet ad te malum: * et flagéllum non appropinquábit tabernáculo tuo.
psalm:90:gloria.english: There shall no evil come to thee: * nor shall the scourge come near thy dwelling.

psalm:90:gloria.latin: Quóniam Ángelis suis mandávit de te: * ut custódiant te in ómnibus viis tuis.
psalm:90:gloria.english: For he hath given his angels charge over thee; * to keep thee in all thy ways.

psalm:90:gloria.latin: In mánibus portábunt te: * ne forte offéndas ad lápidem pedem tuum.
psalm:90:gloria.english: In their hands they shall bear thee up: * lest thou dash thy foot against a stone.

psalm:90:gloria.latin: Super áspidem, et basilíscum ambulábis: * et conculcábis leónem et dracónem.
psalm:90:gloria.english: Thou shalt walk upon the asp and the basilisk: * and thou shalt trample under foot the lion and the dragon.

psalm:90:gloria.latin: Quóniam in me sperávit, liberábo eum: * prótegam eum, quóniam cognóvit nomen meum.
psalm:90:gloria.english: Because he hoped in me I will deliver him: * I will protect him because he hath known my name.

psalm:90:gloria.latin: Clamábit ad me, et ego exáudiam eum: ‡ cum ipso sum in tribulatióne: * erípiam eum et glorificábo eum.
psalm:90:gloria.english: He shall cry to me, and I will hear him: ‡ I am with him in tribulation, * I will deliver him, and I will glorify him.

psalm:90:gloria.latin: Longitúdine diérum replébo eum: * et osténdam illi salutáre meum.
psalm:90:gloria.english: I will fill him with length of days; * and I will shew him my salvation.

psalm:90:gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:90:gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:90:gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:90:gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:133:gloria.latin: Ecce nunc benedícite Dóminum, * omnes servi Dómini:
psalm:133:gloria.english: Behold now bless ye the Lord, * all ye servants of the Lord:

psalm:133:gloria.latin: Qui statis in domo Dómini, * in átriis domus Dei nostri.
psalm:133:gloria.english: Who stand in the house of the Lord, * in the courts of the house of our God.

psalm:133:gloria.latin: In nóctibus extóllite manus vestras in sancta, * et benedícite Dóminum.
psalm:133:gloria.english: In the nights lift up your hands to the holy places, * and bless ye the Lord.

psalm:133:gloria.latin: Benedícat te Dóminus ex Sion, * qui fecit cælum et terram.
psalm:133:gloria.english: May the Lord out of Sion bless thee, * he that made heaven and earth.

psalm:133:gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:133:gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:133:gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:133:gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

Special/Minor Special.txt:[Hymnus Comple.english: Before the ending of the day,
Creator of the world, we pray
That with thy wonted favor thou
Wouldst be our guard and keeper now.
From all ill dreams defend our eyes,
Tread under foot our ghostly foe,
That no pollution we may know.
* O Father, that we ask be done,
Through Jesus Christ, thine only Son;
Who, with the Holy Ghost and thee,

hymn:monastic:Completorium.latin:
Te lucis ante términum,
Rerum Creátor, póscimus,
Ut sólita cleméntia
Sis præsul ad custódiam.
hymn:monastic:Completorium.english:
Before the ending of the day,
Creator of the world, we pray
That with thy wonted favor thou
Wouldst be our guard and keeper now.

hymn:monastic:Completorium.latin:
Procul recédant sómnia,
Et nóctium phantásmata;
Hostémque nostrum cómprime,
Ne polluántur córpora.
hymn:monastic:Completorium.english:
From all ill dreams defend our eyes,
From nightly fears and fantasies;
Tread under foot our ghostly foe,
That no pollution we may know.

hymn:monastic:Completorium.latin:
* Præsta, Pater omnípotens,
Per Jesum Christum Dóminum,
Qui tecum in perpétuum
Regnat cum Sancto Spíritu.
hymn:monastic:Completorium.english:
* O Father, that we ask be done,
Through Jesus Christ, thine only Son;
Who, with the Holy Ghost and thee,
Doth live and reign eternally.

Special/Minor Special.txt:[Completorium_.latin: Tu autem in nobis es, Dómine, et nomen sanctum tuum invocátum est super nos: ne derelínquas nos, Dómine, Deus noster.
Special/Minor Special.txt:[Completorium_.english: But thou, O Lord, art among us, and thy name is called upon by us: forsake us not, O Lord our God.

Special/Minor Special.txt:[Versum 4].latin: Custódi nos, Dómine, ut pupíllam óculi.
Special/Minor Special.txt:[Versum 4].english: Keep us, Lord, as the apple of thine eye.

Special/Minor Special.txt:[Versum 4].latin: Sub umbra alárum tuárum prótege nos.
Special/Minor Special.txt:[Versum 4].english: Protect us under the shadow of thy wings.

Common/Prayers.txt:[Oratio Visita_].latin: Vísita, quǽsumus, Dómine, habitatiónem istam, et omnes insídias inimíci ab ea longe repélle: Ángeli tui sancti hábitent in ea, qui nos in pace custódiant; et benedíctio tua sit super nos semper.
Common/Prayers.txt:[Oratio Visita_].english: Visit, we beseech thee, O Lord, this dwelling, and drive far from it the snares of the enemy; let thy holy angels dwell herein to preserve us in peace, and let thy blessing be always upon us.

Common/Prayers.txt:[Benedictio Completor.latin: Benedícat et custódiat nos omnípotens et miséricors Dóminus, + Pater, et Fílius, et Spíritus Sanctus.
Common/Prayers.txt:[Benedictio Completor.english: The almighty and merciful Lord, + the Father, the Son and the Holy Spirit, bless us and keep us.

marker:Seasonal Marian antiphon, verse a.english: Seasonal Marian antiphon, verse and prayer
marker:Seasonal Marian antiphon, verse a.id: marker:Seasonal Marian antiphon, verse and prayer

Common/Prayers.txt:[Ave Maria].latin: Ave María, grátia plena; Dóminus tecum: benedícta tu in muliéribus, et benedíctus fructus ventris tui Jesus. Sancta María, Mater Dei, ora pro nobis peccatóribus, nunc et in hora mortis nostræ. Amen.
Common/Prayers.txt:[Ave Maria].english: Hail Mary, full of grace, the Lord is with thee; blessed art thou amongst women, and blessed is the fruit of thy womb, Jesus. Holy Mary, Mother of God, pray for us sinners, now and at the hour of our death. Amen.

Common/Prayers.txt:[Credo].latin: Credo in Deum, Patrem omnipoténtem, Creatórem cæli et terræ. Et in Jesum Christum, Fílium ejus únicum, Dóminum nostrum: qui concéptus est de Spíritu Sancto, natus ex María Vírgine, passus sub Póntio Piláto, crucifíxus, mórtuus, et sepúltus: descéndit ad ínferos; tértia die resurréxit a mórtuis; ascéndit ad cælos; sedet ad déxteram Dei Patris omnipoténtis: inde ventúrus est judicáre vivos et mórtuos. Credo in Spíritum Sanctum, sanctam Ecclésiam cathólicam, Sanctórum communiónem, remissiónem peccatórum, carnis resurrectiónem, vitam ætérnam. Amen.
Common/Prayers.txt:[Credo].english: I believe in God, the Father almighty, Creator of heaven and earth. And in Jesus Christ, his only Son, our Lord; who was conceived by the Holy Ghost, born of the Virgin Mary, suffered under Pontius Pilate, was crucified, died and was buried: he descended into hell; the third day he arose again from the dead; he ascended into heaven; sitteth at the right hand of God the Father almighty: from thence he shall come to judge the living and the dead. I believe in the Holy Ghost, the holy catholic Church, the communion of Saints, the forgiveness of sins, the resurrection of the body, and life everlasting. Amen.

psalm:5:gloria.latin: Verba mea áuribus pércipe, Dómine, * intéllege clamórem meum.
psalm:5:gloria.english: Give ear, O Lord, to my words * understand my cry.

psalm:5:gloria.latin: Inténde voci oratiónis meæ, * Rex meus et Deus meus.
psalm:5:gloria.english: Hearken to the voice of my prayer, * O my King and my God.

psalm:5:gloria.latin: Quóniam ad te orábo: * Dómine, mane exáudies vocem meam.
psalm:5:gloria.english: For to thee will I pray: * O Lord, in the morning thou shalt hear my voice.

psalm:5:gloria.latin: Mane astábo tibi et vidébo: * quóniam non Deus volens iniquitátem tu es.
psalm:5:gloria.english: In the morning I will stand before thee, and will see: * because thou art not a God that willest iniquity.

psalm:5:gloria.latin: Neque habitábit juxta te malígnus: * neque permanébunt injústi ante óculos tuos.
psalm:5:gloria.english: Neither shall the wicked dwell near thee: * nor shall the unjust abide before thy eyes.

psalm:5:gloria.latin: Odísti omnes, qui operántur iniquitátem: * perdes omnes, qui loquúntur mendácium.
psalm:5:gloria.english: Thou hatest all the workers of iniquity: * thou wilt destroy all that speak a lie.

psalm:5:gloria.latin: Virum sánguinum et dolósum abominábitur Dóminus: * (8a) ego autem in multitúdine misericórdiæ tuæ.
psalm:5:gloria.english: The bloody and the deceitful man the Lord will abhor. * (8a) But as for me in the multitude of thy mercy,

psalm:5:gloria.latin: Introíbo in domum tuam: * adorábo ad templum sanctum tuum in timóre tuo.
psalm:5:gloria.english: I will come into thy house; * I will worship towards thy holy temple, in thy fear.

psalm:5:gloria.latin: Dómine, deduc me in justítia tua: * propter inimícos meos dírige in conspéctu tuo viam meam.
psalm:5:gloria.english: Conduct me, O Lord, in thy justice: * because of my enemies, direct my way in thy sight.

psalm:5:gloria.latin: Quóniam non est in ore eórum véritas: * cor eórum vanum est.
psalm:5:gloria.english: For there is no truth in their mouth: * their heart is vain.

psalm:5:gloria.latin: Sepúlcrum patens est guttur eórum, † linguis suis dolóse agébant, * júdica illos, Deus.
psalm:5:gloria.english: Their throat is an open sepulchre: † they dealt deceitfully with their tongues: * judge them, O God.

psalm:5:gloria.latin: Décidant a cogitatiónibus suis, † secúndum multitúdinem impietátum eórum expélle eos, * quóniam irritavérunt te, Dómine.
psalm:5:gloria.english: Let them fall from their devices: † according to the multitude of their wickednesses cast them out: * for they have provoked thee, O Lord.

psalm:5:gloria.latin: Et læténtur omnes, qui sperant in te, * in ætérnum exsultábunt: et habitábis in eis.
psalm:5:gloria.english: But let all them be glad that hope in thee: * they shall rejoice for ever, and thou shalt dwell in them.

psalm:5:gloria.latin: Et gloriabúntur in te omnes, qui díligunt nomen tuum, * (13a) quóniam tu benedíces justo.
psalm:5:gloria.english: And all they that love thy name shall glory in thee: * (13a) For thou wilt bless the just.

psalm:5:gloria.latin: Dómine, ut scuto bonæ voluntátis tuæ * coronásti nos.
psalm:5:gloria.english: O Lord, thou hast crowned us, * as with a shield of thy good will.

psalm:5:gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:5:gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:5:gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:5:gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:35:gloria.latin: Dixit injústus ut delínquat in semetípso: * non est timor Dei ante óculos ejus.
psalm:35:gloria.english: The unjust hath said within himself, that he would sin: * there is no fear of God before his eyes.

psalm:35:gloria.latin: Quóniam dolóse egit in conspéctu ejus: * ut inveniátur iníquitas ejus ad ódium.
psalm:35:gloria.english: For in his sight he hath done deceitfully, * that his iniquity may be found unto hatred.

psalm:35:gloria.latin: Verba oris ejus iníquitas, et dolus: * nóluit intellégere ut bene ágeret.
psalm:35:gloria.english: The words of his mouth are iniquity and guile: * he would not understand that he might do well.

psalm:35:gloria.latin: Iniquitátem meditátus est in cubíli suo: * ástitit omni viæ non bonæ, malítiam autem non odívit.
psalm:35:gloria.english: He hath devised iniquity on his bed, * he hath set himself on every way that is not good: but evil he hath not hated.

psalm:35:gloria.latin: Dómine, in cælo misericórdia tua: * et véritas tua usque ad nubes.
psalm:35:gloria.english: O Lord, thy mercy is in heaven, * and thy truth reacheth even to the clouds.

psalm:35:gloria.latin: Justítia tua sicut montes Dei: * judícia tua abýssus multa.
psalm:35:gloria.english: Thy justice is as the mountains of God, * thy judgments are a great deep.

psalm:35:gloria.latin: Hómines, et juménta salvábis, Dómine: * quemádmodum multiplicásti misericórdiam tuam, Deus.
psalm:35:gloria.english: Men and beasts thou wilt preserve, O Lord: * O how hast thou multiplied thy mercy, O God!

psalm:35:gloria.latin: Fílii autem hóminum, * in tégmine alárum tuárum sperábunt.
psalm:35:gloria.english: But the children of men * shall put their trust under the covert of thy wings.

psalm:35:gloria.latin: Inebriabúntur ab ubertáte domus tuæ: * et torrénte voluptátis tuæ potábis eos.
psalm:35:gloria.english: They shall be inebriated with the plenty of thy house; * and thou shalt make them drink of the torrent of thy pleasure.

psalm:35:gloria.latin: Quóniam apud te est fons vitæ: * et in lúmine tuo vidébimus lumen.
psalm:35:gloria.english: For with thee is the fountain of life; * and in thy light we shall see light.

psalm:35:gloria.latin: Præténde misericórdiam tuam sciéntibus te, * et justítiam tuam his, qui recto sunt corde.
psalm:35:gloria.english: Extend thy mercy to them that know thee, * and thy justice to them that are right in heart.

psalm:35:gloria.latin: Non véniat mihi pes supérbiæ: * et manus peccatóris non móveat me.
psalm:35:gloria.english: Let not the foot of pride come to me, * and let not the hand of the sinner move me.

psalm:35:gloria.latin: Ibi cecidérunt qui operántur iniquitátem: * expúlsi sunt, nec potuérunt stare.
psalm:35:gloria.english: There the workers of iniquity are fallen, * they are cast out, and could not stand.

psalm:35:gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:35:gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:35:gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:35:gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:221:gloria.latin: Confitébor tibi, Dómine, quóniam irátus es mihi: * convérsus est furor tuus, et consolátus es me.
psalm:221:gloria.english: I will give thanks to thee, O Lord, for thou wast angry with me: * thy wrath is turned away, and thou hast comforted me.

psalm:221:gloria.latin: Ecce Deus salvátor meus, * fiduciáliter agam, et non timébo:
psalm:221:gloria.english: Behold, God is my saviour, * I will deal confidently, and will not fear:

psalm:221:gloria.latin: Quia fortitúdo mea, et laus mea Dóminus, * et factus est mihi in salútem.
psalm:221:gloria.english: Because the Lord is my strength, and my praise, * and he is become my salvation.

psalm:221:gloria.latin: Hauriétis aquas in gáudio de fóntibus Salvatóris: * et dicétis in die illa: Confitémini Dómino, et invocáte nomen ejus:
psalm:221:gloria.english: You shall draw waters with joy out of the saviour’s fountains: * And you shall say in that day: Praise ye the Lord, and call upon his name:

psalm:221:gloria.latin: Notas fácite in pópulis adinventiónes ejus: * mementóte quóniam excélsum est nomen ejus.
psalm:221:gloria.english: Make his works known among the people: * remember that his name is high.

psalm:221:gloria.latin: Cantáte Dómino quóniam magnífice fecit: * annuntiáte hoc in univérsa terra.
psalm:221:gloria.english: Sing ye to the Lord, for he hath done great things: * shew this forth in all the earth.

psalm:221:gloria.latin: Exsúlta, et lauda, habitátio Sion: * quia magnus in médio tui Sanctus Israël.
psalm:221:gloria.english: Rejoice, and praise, O thou habitation of Sion: * for great is he that is in the midst of thee the Holy One of Israel.

psalm:221:gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:221:gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:221:gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:221:gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:1:gloria.latin: Beátus vir, qui non ábiit in consílio impiórum, † et in via peccatórum non stetit, * et in cáthedra pestiléntiæ non sedit:
psalm:1:gloria.english: Blessed is the man who hath not walked in the counsel of the ungodly, † nor stood in the way of sinners, * nor sat in the chair of pestilence.

psalm:1:gloria.latin: Sed in lege Dómini volúntas ejus, * et in lege ejus meditábitur die ac nocte.
psalm:1:gloria.english: But his will is in the law of the Lord, * and on his law he shall meditate day and night.

psalm:1:gloria.latin: Et erit tamquam lignum, quod plantátum est secus decúrsus aquárum, * quod fructum suum dabit in témpore suo:
psalm:1:gloria.english: And he shall be like a tree which is planted near the running waters, * which shall bring forth its fruit, in due season.

psalm:1:gloria.latin: Et fólium ejus non défluet: * et ómnia quæcúmque fáciet, prosperabúntur.
psalm:1:gloria.english: And his leaf shall not fall off: * and all whatsoever he shall do shall prosper.

psalm:1:gloria.latin: Non sic ímpii, non sic: * sed tamquam pulvis, quem próicit ventus a fácie terræ.
psalm:1:gloria.english: Not so the wicked, not so: * but like the dust, which the wind driveth from the face of the earth.

psalm:1:gloria.latin: Ídeo non resúrgent ímpii in judício: * neque peccatóres in concílio justórum.
psalm:1:gloria.english: Therefore the wicked shall not rise again in judgment: * nor sinners in the council of the just.

psalm:1:gloria.latin: Quóniam novit Dóminus viam justórum: * et iter impiórum períbit.
psalm:1:gloria.english: For the Lord knoweth the way of the just: * and the way of the wicked shall perish.

psalm:1:gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:1:gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:1:gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:1:gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:2:gloria.latin: Quare fremuérunt gentes: * et pópuli meditáti sunt inánia?
psalm:2:gloria.english: Why have the Gentiles raged, * and the people devised vain things?

psalm:2:gloria.latin: Astitérunt reges terræ, et príncipes convenérunt in unum * advérsus Dóminum, et advérsus Christum ejus.
psalm:2:gloria.english: The kings of the earth stood up, and the princes met together, * against the Lord and against his Christ.

psalm:2:gloria.latin: Dirumpámus víncula eórum: * et proiciámus a nobis jugum ipsórum.
psalm:2:gloria.english: Let us break their bonds asunder: * and let us cast away their yoke from us.

psalm:2:gloria.latin: Qui hábitat in cælis, irridébit eos: * et Dóminus subsannábit eos.
psalm:2:gloria.english: He that dwelleth in heaven shall laugh at them: * and the Lord shall deride them.

psalm:2:gloria.latin: Tunc loquétur ad eos in ira sua, * et in furóre suo conturbábit eos.
psalm:2:gloria.english: Then shall he speak to them in his anger, * and trouble them in his rage.

psalm:2:gloria.latin: Ego autem constitútus sum Rex ab eo super Sion montem sanctum ejus, * prǽdicans præcéptum ejus.
psalm:2:gloria.english: But I am appointed king by him over Sion his holy mountain, * preaching his commandment.

psalm:2:gloria.latin: Dóminus dixit ad me: * Fílius meus es tu, ego hódie génui te.
psalm:2:gloria.english: The Lord hath said to me: * Thou art my son, this day have I begotten thee.

psalm:2:gloria.latin: Póstula a me, et dabo tibi gentes hereditátem tuam, * et possessiónem tuam términos terræ.
psalm:2:gloria.english: Ask of me, and I will give thee the Gentiles for thy inheritance, * and the utmost parts of the earth for thy possession.

psalm:2:gloria.latin: Reges eos in virga férrea, * et tamquam vas fíguli confrínges eos.
psalm:2:gloria.english: Thou shalt rule them with a rod of iron, * and shalt break them in pieces like a potter’s vessel.

psalm:2:gloria.latin: Et nunc, reges, intellégite: * erudímini, qui judicátis terram.
psalm:2:gloria.english: And now, O ye kings, understand: * receive instruction, you that judge the earth.

psalm:2:gloria.latin: Servíte Dómino in timóre: * et exsultáte ei cum tremóre.
psalm:2:gloria.english: Serve ye the Lord with fear: * and rejoice unto him with trembling.

psalm:2:gloria.latin: Apprehéndite disciplínam, nequándo irascátur Dóminus, * et pereátis de via justa.
psalm:2:gloria.english: Embrace discipline, lest at any time the Lord be angry, * and you perish from the just way.

psalm:2:gloria.latin: Cum exárserit in brevi ira ejus: * beáti omnes qui confídunt in eo.
psalm:2:gloria.english: When his wrath shall be kindled in a short time, * blessed are all they that trust in him.

psalm:2:gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:2:gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:2:gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:2:gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:6:gloria.latin: Dómine, ne in furóre tuo árguas me, * neque in ira tua corrípias me.
psalm:6:gloria.english: Lord, rebuke me not in thy indignation, * nor chastise me in thy wrath.

psalm:6:gloria.latin: Miserére mei, Dómine, quóniam infírmus sum: * sana me, Dómine, quóniam conturbáta sunt ossa mea.
psalm:6:gloria.english: Have mercy on me, O Lord, for I am weak: * heal me, O Lord, for my bones are troubled.

psalm:6:gloria.latin: Et ánima mea turbáta est valde: * sed tu, Dómine, úsquequo?
psalm:6:gloria.english: And my soul is troubled exceedingly: * but thou, O Lord, how long?

psalm:6:gloria.latin: Convértere, Dómine, et éripe ánimam meam: * salvum me fac propter misericórdiam tuam.
psalm:6:gloria.english: Turn to me, O Lord, and deliver my soul: * O save me for thy mercy’s sake.

psalm:6:gloria.latin: Quóniam non est in morte qui memor sit tui: * in inférno autem quis confitébitur tibi?
psalm:6:gloria.english: For there is no one in death, that is mindful of thee: * and who shall confess to thee in hell?

psalm:6:gloria.latin: Laborávi in gémitu meo, † lavábo per síngulas noctes lectum meum: * lácrimis meis stratum meum rigábo.
psalm:6:gloria.english: I have laboured in my groanings, † every night I will wash my bed: * I will water my couch with my tears.

psalm:6:gloria.latin: Turbátus est a furóre óculus meus: * inveterávi inter omnes inimícos meos.
psalm:6:gloria.english: My eye is troubled through indignation: * I have grown old amongst all my enemies.

psalm:6:gloria.latin: Discédite a me, omnes, qui operámini iniquitátem: * quóniam exaudívit Dóminus vocem fletus mei.
psalm:6:gloria.english: Depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity: * for the Lord hath heard the voice of my weeping.

psalm:6:gloria.latin: Exaudívit Dóminus deprecatiónem meam, * Dóminus oratiónem meam suscépit.
psalm:6:gloria.english: The Lord hath heard my supplication: * the Lord hath received my prayer.

psalm:6:gloria.latin: Erubéscant, et conturbéntur veheménter omnes inimíci mei: * convertántur et erubéscant valde velóciter.
psalm:6:gloria.english: Let all my enemies be ashamed, and be very much troubled: * let them be turned back, and be ashamed very speedily.

psalm:6:gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:6:gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:6:gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:6:gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:118(105-112):gloria.latin: (Nun) Lucérna pédibus meis verbum tuum, * et lumen sémitis meis.
psalm:118(105-112):gloria.english: (Nun) Thy word is a lamp to my feet, * and a light to my paths.

psalm:118(105-112):gloria.latin: Jurávi, et státui * custodíre judícia justítiæ tuæ.
psalm:118(105-112):gloria.english: I have sworn and am determined * to keep the judgments of thy justice.

psalm:118(105-112):gloria.latin: Humiliátus sum usquequáque, Dómine: * vivífica me secúndum verbum tuum.
psalm:118(105-112):gloria.english: I have been humbled, O Lord, exceedingly: * quicken thou me according to thy word.

psalm:118(105-112):gloria.latin: Voluntária oris mei beneplácita fac, Dómine: * et judícia tua doce me.
psalm:118(105-112):gloria.english: The free offerings of my mouth make acceptable, O Lord: * and teach me thy judgments.

psalm:118(105-112):gloria.latin: Ánima mea in mánibus meis semper: * et legem tuam non sum oblítus.
psalm:118(105-112):gloria.english: My soul is continually in my hands: * and I have not forgotten thy law.

psalm:118(105-112):gloria.latin: Posuérunt peccatóres láqueum mihi: * et de mandátis tuis non errávi.
psalm:118(105-112):gloria.english: Sinners have laid a snare for me: * but I have not erred from thy precepts.

psalm:118(105-112):gloria.latin: Hereditáte acquisívi testimónia tua in ætérnum: * quia exsultátio cordis mei sunt.
psalm:118(105-112):gloria.english: I have purchased thy testimonies for an inheritance for ever: * because they are the joy of my heart.

psalm:118(105-112):gloria.latin: Inclinávi cor meum ad faciéndas justificatiónes tuas in ætérnum, * propter retributiónem.
psalm:118(105-112):gloria.english: I have inclined my heart to do thy justifications for ever, * for the reward.

psalm:118(105-112):gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:118(105-112):gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:118(105-112):gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:118(105-112):gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:118(113-120):gloria.latin: (Samech) Iníquos ódio hábui: * et legem tuam diléxi.
psalm:118(113-120):gloria.english: (Samech) I have hated the unjust: * and I have loved thy law.

psalm:118(113-120):gloria.latin: Adjútor et suscéptor meus es tu: * et in verbum tuum supersperávi.
psalm:118(113-120):gloria.english: Thou art my helper and my protector: * and in thy word I have greatly hoped.

psalm:118(113-120):gloria.latin: Declináte a me, malígni: * et scrutábor mandáta Dei mei.
psalm:118(113-120):gloria.english: Depart from me, ye malignant: * and I will search the commandments of my God.

psalm:118(113-120):gloria.latin: Súscipe me secúndum elóquium tuum, et vivam: * et non confúndas me ab exspectatióne mea.
psalm:118(113-120):gloria.english: Uphold me according to thy word, and I shall live: * and let me not be confounded in my expectation.

psalm:118(113-120):gloria.latin: Ádjuva me, et salvus ero: * et meditábor in justificatiónibus tuis semper.
psalm:118(113-120):gloria.english: Help me, and I shall be saved: * and I will meditate always on thy justifications.

psalm:118(113-120):gloria.latin: Sprevísti omnes discedéntes a judíciis tuis: * quia injústa cogitátio eórum.
psalm:118(113-120):gloria.english: Thou hast despised all them that fall off from thy judgments; * for their thought is unjust.

psalm:118(113-120):gloria.latin: Prævaricántes reputávi omnes peccatóres terræ: * ídeo diléxi testimónia tua.
psalm:118(113-120):gloria.english: I have accounted all the sinners of the earth prevaricators: * therefore have I loved thy testimonies.

psalm:118(113-120):gloria.latin: Confíge timóre tuo carnes meas: * a judíciis enim tuis tímui.
psalm:118(113-120):gloria.english: Pierce thou my flesh with thy fear: * for I am afraid of thy judgments.

psalm:118(113-120):gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:118(113-120):gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:118(113-120):gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:118(113-120):gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:118(121-128):gloria.latin: (Ain) Feci judícium et justítiam: * non tradas me calumniántibus me.
psalm:118(121-128):gloria.english: (Ain) I have done judgment and justice: * give me not up to them that slander me.

psalm:118(121-128):gloria.latin: Súscipe servum tuum in bonum: * non calumniéntur me supérbi.
psalm:118(121-128):gloria.english: Uphold thy servant unto good: * let not the proud calumniate me.

psalm:118(121-128):gloria.latin: Óculi mei defecérunt in salutáre tuum: * et in elóquium justítiæ tuæ.
psalm:118(121-128):gloria.english: My eyes have fainted after thy salvation: * and for the word of thy justice.

psalm:118(121-128):gloria.latin: Fac cum servo tuo secúndum misericórdiam tuam: * et justificatiónes tuas doce me.
psalm:118(121-128):gloria.english: Deal with thy servant according to thy mercy: * and teach me thy justifications.

psalm:118(121-128):gloria.latin: Servus tuus sum ego: * da mihi intelléctum, ut sciam testimónia tua.
psalm:118(121-128):gloria.english: I am thy servant: * give me understanding that I may know thy testimonies.

psalm:118(121-128):gloria.latin: Tempus faciéndi, Dómine: * dissipavérunt legem tuam.
psalm:118(121-128):gloria.english: It is time, O Lord, to do: * they have dissipated thy law.

psalm:118(121-128):gloria.latin: Ídeo diléxi mandáta tua, * super aurum et topázion.
psalm:118(121-128):gloria.english: Therefore have I loved thy commandments * above gold and the topaz.

psalm:118(121-128):gloria.latin: Proptérea ad ómnia mandáta tua dirigébar: * omnem viam iníquam ódio hábui.
psalm:118(121-128):gloria.english: Therefore was I directed to all thy commandments: * I have hated all wicked ways.

psalm:118(121-128):gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:118(121-128):gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:118(121-128):gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:118(121-128):gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:118(129-136):gloria.latin: (Phe) Mirabília testimónia tua: * ídeo scrutáta est ea ánima mea.
psalm:118(129-136):gloria.english: (Phe) Thy testimonies are wonderful: * therefore my soul hath sought them.

psalm:118(129-136):gloria.latin: Declarátio sermónum tuórum illúminat: * et intelléctum dat párvulis.
psalm:118(129-136):gloria.english: The declaration of thy words giveth light: * and giveth understanding to little ones.

psalm:118(129-136):gloria.latin: Os meum apérui, et attráxi spíritum: * quia mandáta tua desiderábam.
psalm:118(129-136):gloria.english: I opened my mouth, and panted: * because I longed for thy commandments.

psalm:118(129-136):gloria.latin: Áspice in me, et miserére mei, * secúndum judícium diligéntium nomen tuum.
psalm:118(129-136):gloria.english: Look thou upon me, and have mercy on me, * according to the judgment of them that love thy name.

psalm:118(129-136):gloria.latin: Gressus meos dírige secúndum elóquium tuum: * et non dominétur mei omnis injustítia.
psalm:118(129-136):gloria.english: Direct my steps according to thy word: * and let no iniquity have dominion over me.

psalm:118(129-136):gloria.latin: Rédime me a calúmniis hóminum: * ut custódiam mandáta tua.
psalm:118(129-136):gloria.english: Redeem me from the calumnies of men: * that I may keep thy commandments.

psalm:118(129-136):gloria.latin: Fáciem tuam illúmina super servum tuum: * et doce me justificatiónes tuas.
psalm:118(129-136):gloria.english: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant: * and teach me thy justifications.

psalm:118(129-136):gloria.latin: Éxitus aquárum deduxérunt óculi mei: * quia non custodiérunt legem tuam.
psalm:118(129-136):gloria.english: My eyes have sent forth springs of water: * because they have not kept thy law.

psalm:118(129-136):gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:118(129-136):gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:118(129-136):gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:118(129-136):gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:118(137-144):gloria.latin: (Sade) Justus es, Dómine: * et rectum judícium tuum.
psalm:118(137-144):gloria.english: (Sade) Thou art just, O Lord: * and thy judgment is right.

psalm:118(137-144):gloria.latin: Mandásti justítiam testimónia tua: * et veritátem tuam nimis.
psalm:118(137-144):gloria.english: Thou hast commanded justice thy testimonies: * and thy truth exceedingly.

psalm:118(137-144):gloria.latin: Tabéscere me fecit zelus meus: * quia oblíti sunt verba tua inimíci mei.
psalm:118(137-144):gloria.english: My zeal hath made me pine away: * because my enemies forgot thy words.

psalm:118(137-144):gloria.latin: Ignítum elóquium tuum veheménter: * et servus tuus diléxit illud.
psalm:118(137-144):gloria.english: Thy word is exceedingly refined: * and thy servant hath loved it.

psalm:118(137-144):gloria.latin: Adolescéntulus sum ego et contémptus: * justificatiónes tuas non sum oblítus.
psalm:118(137-144):gloria.english: I am very young and despised; but * I forget not thy justifications.

psalm:118(137-144):gloria.latin: Justítia tua, justítia in ætérnum: * et lex tua véritas.
psalm:118(137-144):gloria.english: Thy justice is justice for ever: * and thy law is the truth.

psalm:118(137-144):gloria.latin: Tribulátio, et angústia invenérunt me: * mandáta tua meditátio mea est.
psalm:118(137-144):gloria.english: Trouble and anguish have found me: * thy commandments are my meditation.

psalm:118(137-144):gloria.latin: Ǽquitas testimónia tua in ætérnum: * intelléctum da mihi, et vivam.
psalm:118(137-144):gloria.english: Thy testimonies are justice for ever: * give me understanding, and I shall live.

psalm:118(137-144):gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:118(137-144):gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:118(137-144):gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:118(137-144):gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:118(145-152):gloria.latin: (Coph) Clamávi in toto corde meo, exáudi me, Dómine: * justificatiónes tuas requíram.
psalm:118(145-152):gloria.english: (Coph) I cried with my whole heart, hear me, O Lord: * I will seek thy justifications.

psalm:118(145-152):gloria.latin: Clamávi ad te, salvum me fac: * ut custódiam mandáta tua.
psalm:118(145-152):gloria.english: I cried unto thee, save me: * that I may keep thy commandments.

psalm:118(145-152):gloria.latin: Prævéni in maturitáte, et clamávi: * quia in verba tua supersperávi.
psalm:118(145-152):gloria.english: I prevented the dawning of the day, and cried: * because in thy words I very much hoped.

psalm:118(145-152):gloria.latin: Prævenérunt óculi mei ad te dilúculo: * ut meditárer elóquia tua.
psalm:118(145-152):gloria.english: My eyes to thee have prevented the morning: * that I might meditate on thy words.

psalm:118(145-152):gloria.latin: Vocem meam audi secúndum misericórdiam tuam, Dómine: * et secúndum judícium tuum vivífica me.
psalm:118(145-152):gloria.english: Hear thou my voice, O Lord, according to thy mercy: * and quicken me according to thy judgment.

psalm:118(145-152):gloria.latin: Appropinquavérunt persequéntes me iniquitáti: * a lege autem tua longe facti sunt.
psalm:118(145-152):gloria.english: They that persecute me have drawn nigh to iniquity; * but they are gone far off from thy law.

psalm:118(145-152):gloria.latin: Prope es tu, Dómine: * et omnes viæ tuæ véritas.
psalm:118(145-152):gloria.english: Thou art near, O Lord: * and all thy ways are truth.

psalm:118(145-152):gloria.latin: Inítio cognóvi de testimóniis tuis: * quia in ætérnum fundásti ea.
psalm:118(145-152):gloria.english: I have known from the beginning concerning thy testimonies: * that thou hast founded them for ever.

psalm:118(145-152):gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:118(145-152):gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:118(145-152):gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:118(145-152):gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:118(153-160):gloria.latin: (Res) Vide humilitátem meam, et éripe me: * quia legem tuam non sum oblítus.
psalm:118(153-160):gloria.english: (Res) See my humiliation and deliver me: * for I have not forgotten thy law.

psalm:118(153-160):gloria.latin: Júdica judícium meum, et rédime me: * propter elóquium tuum vivífica me.
psalm:118(153-160):gloria.english: Judge my judgment and redeem me: * quicken thou me for thy word’s sake.

psalm:118(153-160):gloria.latin: Longe a peccatóribus salus: * quia justificatiónes tuas non exquisiérunt.
psalm:118(153-160):gloria.english: Salvation is far from sinners; * because they have not sought thy justifications.

psalm:118(153-160):gloria.latin: Misericórdiæ tuæ multæ, Dómine: * secúndum judícium tuum vivífica me.
psalm:118(153-160):gloria.english: Many, O Lord, are thy mercies: * quicken me according to thy judgment.

psalm:118(153-160):gloria.latin: Multi qui persequúntur me, et tríbulant me: * a testimóniis tuis non declinávi.
psalm:118(153-160):gloria.english: Many are they that persecute me, and afflict me; * but I have not declined from thy testimonies.

psalm:118(153-160):gloria.latin: Vidi prævaricántes, et tabescébam: * quia elóquia tua non custodiérunt.
psalm:118(153-160):gloria.english: I beheld the transgressors, and I pined away; * because they kept not thy word.

psalm:118(153-160):gloria.latin: Vide quóniam mandáta tua diléxi, Dómine: * in misericórdia tua vivífica me.
psalm:118(153-160):gloria.english: Behold I have loved thy commandments, O Lord; * quicken me thou in thy mercy.

psalm:118(153-160):gloria.latin: Princípium verbórum tuórum, véritas: * in ætérnum ómnia judícia justítiæ tuæ.
psalm:118(153-160):gloria.english: The beginning of thy words is truth: * all the judgments of thy justice are for ever.

psalm:118(153-160):gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:118(153-160):gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:118(153-160):gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:118(153-160):gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:118(161-168):gloria.latin: (Sin) Príncipes persecúti sunt me gratis: * et a verbis tuis formidávit cor meum.
psalm:118(161-168):gloria.english: (Sin) Princes have persecuted me without cause: * and my heart hath been in awe of thy words.

psalm:118(161-168):gloria.latin: Lætábor ego super elóquia tua: * sicut qui invénit spólia multa.
psalm:118(161-168):gloria.english: I will rejoice at thy words, * as one that hath found great spoil.

psalm:118(161-168):gloria.latin: Iniquitátem ódio hábui, et abominátus sum: * legem autem tuam diléxi.
psalm:118(161-168):gloria.english: I have hated and abhorred iniquity; * but I have loved thy law.

psalm:118(161-168):gloria.latin: Sépties in die laudem dixi tibi, * super judícia justítiæ tuæ.
psalm:118(161-168):gloria.english: Seven times a day I have given praise to thee, * for the judgments of thy justice.

psalm:118(161-168):gloria.latin: Pax multa diligéntibus legem tuam: * et non est illis scándalum.
psalm:118(161-168):gloria.english: Much peace have they that love thy law, * and to them there is no stumbling-block.

psalm:118(161-168):gloria.latin: Exspectábam salutáre tuum, Dómine: * et mandáta tua diléxi.
psalm:118(161-168):gloria.english: I looked for thy salvation, O Lord: * and I loved thy commandments.

psalm:118(161-168):gloria.latin: Custodívit ánima mea testimónia tua: * et diléxit ea veheménter.
psalm:118(161-168):gloria.english: My soul hath kept thy testimonies: * and hath loved them exceedingly.

psalm:118(161-168):gloria.latin: Servávi mandáta tua, et testimónia tua: * quia omnes viæ meæ in conspéctu tuo.
psalm:118(161-168):gloria.english: I have kept thy commandments and thy testimonies: * because all my ways are in thy sight.

psalm:118(161-168):gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:118(161-168):gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:118(161-168):gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:118(161-168):gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:118(169-176):gloria.latin: (Thau) Appropínquet deprecátio mea in conspéctu tuo, Dómine: * juxta elóquium tuum da mihi intelléctum.
psalm:118(169-176):gloria.english: (Tau) Let my supplication, O Lord, come near in thy sight: * give me understanding according to thy word.

psalm:118(169-176):gloria.latin: Intret postulátio mea in conspéctu tuo: * secúndum elóquium tuum éripe me.
psalm:118(169-176):gloria.english: Let my request come in before thee; * deliver thou me according to thy word.

psalm:118(169-176):gloria.latin: Eructábunt lábia mea hymnum, * cum docúeris me justificatiónes tuas.
psalm:118(169-176):gloria.english: My lips shall utter a hymn, * when thou shalt teach me thy justifications.

psalm:118(169-176):gloria.latin: Pronuntiábit lingua mea elóquium tuum: * quia ómnia mandáta tua ǽquitas.
psalm:118(169-176):gloria.english: My tongue shall pronounce thy word: * because all thy commandments are justice.

psalm:118(169-176):gloria.latin: Fiat manus tua ut salvet me: * quóniam mandáta tua elégi.
psalm:118(169-176):gloria.english: Let thy hand be with me to save me; * for I have chosen thy precepts.

psalm:118(169-176):gloria.latin: Concupívi salutáre tuum, Dómine: * et lex tua meditátio mea est.
psalm:118(169-176):gloria.english: I have longed for thy salvation, O Lord; * and thy law is my meditation.

psalm:118(169-176):gloria.latin: Vivet ánima mea, et laudábit te: * et judícia tua adjuvábunt me.
psalm:118(169-176):gloria.english: My soul shall live and shall praise thee: * and thy judgments shall help me.

psalm:118(169-176):gloria.latin: Errávi, sicut ovis, quæ périit: * quære servum tuum, quia mandáta tua non sum oblítus.
psalm:118(169-176):gloria.english: I have gone astray like a sheep that is lost: * seek thy servant, because I have not forgotten thy commandments.

psalm:118(169-176):gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:118(169-176):gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:118(169-176):gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:118(169-176):gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:113:gloria.english: Psalm 113

psalm:113:gloria.latin: In éxitu Israël de Ægýpto, * domus Jacob de pópulo bárbaro:
psalm:113:gloria.english: When Israel went out of Egypt, * the house of Jacob from a barbarous people:

psalm:113:gloria.latin: Facta est Judǽa sanctificátio ejus, * Israël potéstas ejus.
psalm:113:gloria.english: Judea was made his sanctuary, * Israel his dominion.

psalm:113:gloria.latin: Mare vidit, et fugit: * Jordánis convérsus est retrórsum.
psalm:113:gloria.english: The sea saw and fled: * Jordan was turned back.

psalm:113:gloria.latin: Montes exsultavérunt ut aríetes, * et colles sicut agni óvium.
psalm:113:gloria.english: The mountains skipped like rams, * and the hills like the lambs of the flock.

psalm:113:gloria.latin: Quid est tibi, mare, quod fugísti: * et tu, Jordánis, quia convérsus es retrórsum?
psalm:113:gloria.english: What ailed thee, O thou sea, that thou didst flee: * and thou, O Jordan, that thou wast turned back?

psalm:113:gloria.latin: Montes, exsultástis sicut aríetes, * et colles, sicut agni óvium.
psalm:113:gloria.english: Ye mountains, that ye skipped like rams, * and ye hills, like lambs of the flock?

psalm:113:gloria.latin: A fácie Dómini mota est terra, * a fácie Dei Jacob.
psalm:113:gloria.english: At the presence of the Lord the earth was moved, * at the presence of the God of Jacob:

psalm:113:gloria.latin: Qui convértit petram in stagna aquárum, * et rupem in fontes aquárum.
psalm:113:gloria.english: Who turned the rock into pools of water, * and the stony hill into fountains of waters.

psalm:113:gloria.latin: Non nobis, Dómine, non nobis: * sed nómini tuo da glóriam.
psalm:113:gloria.english: Not to us, O Lord, not to us; * but to thy name give glory.

psalm:113:gloria.latin: Super misericórdia tua, et veritáte tua: * nequándo dicant gentes: Ubi est Deus eórum?
psalm:113:gloria.english: For thy mercy, and for thy truth’s sake: * lest the Gentiles should say: Where is their God?

psalm:113:gloria.latin: Deus autem noster in cælo: * ómnia quæcúmque vóluit, fecit.
psalm:113:gloria.english: But our God is in heaven: * he hath done all things whatsoever he would.

psalm:113:gloria.latin: Simulácra géntium argéntum, et aurum, * ópera mánuum hóminum.
psalm:113:gloria.english: The idols of the Gentiles are silver and gold, * the works of the hands of men.

psalm:113:gloria.latin: Os habent, et non loquéntur: * óculos habent, et non vidébunt.
psalm:113:gloria.english: They have mouths and speak not: * they have eyes and see not.

psalm:113:gloria.latin: Aures habent, et non áudient: * nares habent, et non odorábunt.
psalm:113:gloria.english: They have ears and hear not: * they have noses and smell not.

psalm:113:gloria.latin: Manus habent, et non palpábunt: † pedes habent, et non ambulábunt: * non clamábunt in gútture suo.
psalm:113:gloria.english: They have hands and feel not: † they have feet and walk not: * neither shall they cry out through their throat.

psalm:113:gloria.latin: Símiles illis fiant qui fáciunt ea: * et omnes qui confídunt in eis.
psalm:113:gloria.english: Let them that make them become like unto them: * and all such as trust in them.

psalm:113:gloria.latin: Domus Israël sperávit in Dómino: * adjútor eórum et protéctor eórum est,
psalm:113:gloria.english: The house of Israel hath hoped in the Lord: * he is their helper and their protector.

psalm:113:gloria.latin: Domus Aaron sperávit in Dómino: * adjútor eórum et protéctor eórum est,
psalm:113:gloria.english: The house of Aaron hath hoped in the Lord: * he is their helper and their protector.

psalm:113:gloria.latin: Qui timent Dóminum, speravérunt in Dómino: * adjútor eórum et protéctor eórum est.
psalm:113:gloria.english: They that fear the Lord have hoped in the Lord: * he is their helper and their protector.

psalm:113:gloria.latin: Dóminus memor fuit nostri: * et benedíxit nobis:
psalm:113:gloria.english: The Lord hath been mindful of us, * and hath blessed us.

psalm:113:gloria.latin: Benedíxit dómui Israël: * benedíxit dómui Aaron.
psalm:113:gloria.english: He hath blessed the house of Israel: * he hath blessed the house of Aaron.

psalm:113:gloria.latin: Benedíxit ómnibus, qui timent Dóminum, * pusíllis cum majóribus.
psalm:113:gloria.english: He hath blessed all that fear the Lord, * both little and great.

psalm:113:gloria.latin: Adíciat Dóminus super vos: * super vos, et super fílios vestros.
psalm:113:gloria.english: May the Lord add blessings upon you: * upon you, and upon your children.

psalm:113:gloria.latin: Benedícti vos a Dómino, * qui fecit cælum, et terram.
psalm:113:gloria.english: Blessed be you of the Lord, * who made heaven and earth.

psalm:113:gloria.latin: Cælum cæli Dómino: * terram autem dedit fíliis hóminum.
psalm:113:gloria.english: The heaven of heaven is the Lord’s: * but the earth he has given to the children of men.

psalm:113:gloria.latin: Non mórtui laudábunt te, Dómine: * neque omnes, qui descéndunt in inférnum.
psalm:113:gloria.english: The dead shall not praise thee, O Lord: * nor any of them that go down to hell.

psalm:113:gloria.latin: Sed nos qui vívimus, benedícimus Dómino, * ex hoc nunc et usque in sǽculum.
psalm:113:gloria.english: But we that live bless the Lord: * from this time now and for ever.

psalm:113:gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:113:gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:113:gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:113:gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:114:gloria.latin: Diléxi, quóniam exáudiet Dóminus * vocem oratiónis meæ.
psalm:114:gloria.english: I have loved, because the Lord will hear * the voice of my prayer.

psalm:114:gloria.latin: Quia inclinávit aurem suam mihi: * et in diébus meis invocábo.
psalm:114:gloria.english: Because he hath inclined his ear unto me: * and in my days I will call upon him.

psalm:114:gloria.latin: Circumdedérunt me dolóres mortis: * et perícula inférni invenérunt me.
psalm:114:gloria.english: The sorrows of death have compassed me: * and the perils of hell have found me.

psalm:114:gloria.latin: Tribulatiónem et dolórem invéni: * (4a) et nomen Dómini invocávi.
psalm:114:gloria.english: I met with trouble and sorrow: * (4a) and I called upon the name of the Lord.

psalm:114:gloria.latin: O Dómine, líbera ánimam meam: ‡ (5) miséricors Dóminus, et justus, * et Deus noster miserétur.
psalm:114:gloria.english: O Lord, deliver my soul. ‡ (5) The Lord is merciful and just, * and our God sheweth mercy.

psalm:114:gloria.latin: Custódiens párvulos Dóminus: * humiliátus sum, et liberávit me.
psalm:114:gloria.english: The Lord is the keeper of little ones: * I was humbled, and he delivered me.

psalm:114:gloria.latin: Convértere, ánima mea, in réquiem tuam: * quia Dóminus benefécit tibi.
psalm:114:gloria.english: Turn, O my soul, into thy rest: * for the Lord hath been bountiful to thee.

psalm:114:gloria.latin: Quia erípuit ánimam meam de morte: ‡ óculos meos a lácrimis, * pedes meos a lapsu.
psalm:114:gloria.english: For he hath delivered my soul from death: ‡ my eyes from tears, * my feet from falling.
I will please the Lord * in the land of the living.

psalm:114:gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:114:gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:114:gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:114:gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:115:no-gloria.latin: Crédidi, propter quod locútus sum: * ego autem humiliátus sum nimis.
psalm:115:no-gloria.english: I have believed, therefore have I spoken; * but I have been humbled exceedingly.

psalm:115:no-gloria.latin: Ego dixi in excéssu meo: * Omnis homo mendax.
psalm:115:no-gloria.english: I said in my excess: * Every man is a liar.

psalm:115:no-gloria.latin: Quid retríbuam Dómino, * pro ómnibus, quæ retríbuit mihi?
psalm:115:no-gloria.english: What shall I render to the Lord, * for all the things that he hath rendered to me?

psalm:115:no-gloria.latin: Cálicem salutáris accípiam: * et nomen Dómini invocábo.
psalm:115:no-gloria.english: I will take the chalice of salvation; * and I will call upon the name of the Lord.

psalm:115:no-gloria.latin: Vota mea Dómino reddam coram omni pópulo ejus: * (6) pretiósa in conspéctu Dómini mors sanctórum ejus:
psalm:115:no-gloria.english: I will pay my vows to the Lord before all his people: * (6) precious in the sight of the Lord is the death of his saints.

psalm:115:no-gloria.latin: O Dómine, quia ego servus tuus: * ego servus tuus, et fílius ancíllæ tuæ.
psalm:115:no-gloria.english: O Lord, for I am thy servant: * I am thy servant, and the son of thy handmaid.

psalm:115:no-gloria.latin: Dirupísti víncula mea: ‡ (8) tibi sacrificábo hóstiam laudis, * et nomen Dómini invocábo.
psalm:115:no-gloria.english: Thou hast broken my bonds: ‡ (8) I will sacrifice to thee the sacrifice of praise, * and I will call upon the name of the Lord.

psalm:115:no-gloria.latin: Vota mea Dómino reddam in conspéctu omnis pópuli ejus: * (10) in átriis domus Dómini, in médio tui, Jerúsalem.
psalm:115:no-gloria.english: I will pay my vows to the Lord in the sight of all his people: * (10) in the courts of the house of the Lord, in the midst of thee, O Jerusalem.

psalm:116:gloria.latin: Laudáte Dóminum, omnes gentes: * laudáte eum, omnes pópuli:
psalm:116:gloria.english: O Praise the Lord, all ye nations: * praise him, all ye people.

psalm:116:gloria.latin: Quóniam confirmáta est super nos misericórdia ejus: * et véritas Dómini manet in ætérnum.
psalm:116:gloria.english: For his mercy is confirmed upon us: * and the truth of the Lord remaineth for ever.

psalm:116:gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:116:gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:116:gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:116:gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:128:gloria.latin: Sæpe expugnavérunt me a juventúte mea, * dicat nunc Israël.
psalm:128:gloria.english: Often have they fought against me from my youth, * let Israel now say.

psalm:128:gloria.latin: Sæpe expugnavérunt me a juventúte mea: * étenim non potuérunt mihi.
psalm:128:gloria.english: Often have they fought against me from my youth: * but they could not prevail over me.

psalm:128:gloria.latin: Supra dorsum meum fabricavérunt peccatóres: * prolongavérunt iniquitátem suam.
psalm:128:gloria.english: The wicked have wrought upon my back: * they have lengthened their iniquity.

psalm:128:gloria.latin: Dóminus justus concídit cervíces peccatórum: * (5) confundántur et convertántur retrórsum omnes, qui odérunt Sion.
psalm:128:gloria.english: The Lord who is just will cut the necks of sinners: * (5) let them all be confounded and turned back that hate Sion.

psalm:128:gloria.latin: Fiant sicut fænum tectórum: * quod priúsquam evellátur, exáruit:
psalm:128:gloria.english: Let them be as grass upon the tops of houses: * which withereth before it be plucked up:

psalm:128:gloria.latin: De quo non implévit manum suam qui metit, * et sinum suum qui manípulos cólligit.
psalm:128:gloria.english: Wherewith the mower filleth not his hand: * nor he that gathereth sheaves his bosom.

psalm:128:gloria.latin: Et non dixérunt qui præteríbant: Benedíctio Dómini super vos: * benedíximus vobis in nómine Dómini.
psalm:128:gloria.english: And they that passed by have not said: The blessing of the Lord be upon you: * we have blessed you in the name of the Lord.

psalm:128:gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:128:gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:128:gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:128:gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:42:gloria.latin: Júdica me, Deus, et discérne causam meam de gente non sancta, * ab hómine iníquo, et dolóso érue me.
psalm:42:gloria.english: Judge me, O God, and distinguish my cause from the nation that is not holy: * deliver me from the unjust and deceitful man.

psalm:42:gloria.latin: Quia tu es, Deus, fortitúdo mea: * quare me repulísti? et quare tristis incédo, dum afflígit me inimícus?
psalm:42:gloria.english: For thou art God my strength: * why hast thou cast me off? and why do I go sorrowful whilst the enemy afflicteth me?

psalm:42:gloria.latin: Emítte lucem tuam et veritátem tuam: * ipsa me deduxérunt, et adduxérunt in montem sanctum tuum, et in tabernácula tua.
psalm:42:gloria.english: Send forth thy light and thy truth: * they have conducted me, and brought me unto thy holy hill, and into thy tabernacles.

psalm:42:gloria.latin: Et introíbo ad altáre Dei: * ad Deum, qui lætíficat juventútem meam.
psalm:42:gloria.english: And I will go in to the altar of God: * to God who giveth joy to my youth.

psalm:42:gloria.latin: Confitébor tibi in cíthara, Deus, Deus meus: * quare tristis es, ánima mea? et quare contúrbas me?
psalm:42:gloria.english: To thee, O God my God, I will give praise upon the harp: * why art thou sad, O my soul? and why dost thou disquiet me?

psalm:42:gloria.latin: Spera in Deo, quóniam adhuc confitébor illi: * salutáre vultus mei, et Deus meus.
psalm:42:gloria.english: Hope in God, for I will still give praise to him: * the salvation of my countenance, and my God.

psalm:42:gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:42:gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:42:gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:42:gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:56:gloria.latin: Miserére mei, Deus, miserére mei: * quóniam in te confídit ánima mea.
psalm:56:gloria.english: Have mercy on me, O God, have mercy on me: * for my soul trusteth in thee.

psalm:56:gloria.latin: Et in umbra alárum tuárum sperábo, * donec tránseat iníquitas.
psalm:56:gloria.english: And in the shadow of thy wings will I hope, * until iniquity pass away.

psalm:56:gloria.latin: Clamábo ad Deum altíssimum: * Deum qui benefécit mihi.
psalm:56:gloria.english: I will cry to God the most High; * to God who hath done good to me.

psalm:56:gloria.latin: Misit de cælo, et liberávit me: * dedit in oppróbrium conculcántes me.
psalm:56:gloria.english: He hath sent from heaven and delivered me: * he hath made them a reproach that trod upon me.

psalm:56:gloria.latin: Misit Deus misericórdiam suam, et veritátem suam, * et erípuit ánimam meam de médio catulórum leónum: dormívi conturbátus.
psalm:56:gloria.english: God hath sent his mercy and his truth, * and he hath delivered my soul from the midst of the young lions. I slept troubled.

psalm:56:gloria.latin: Fílii hóminum dentes eórum arma et sagíttæ: * et lingua eórum gládius acútus.
psalm:56:gloria.english: The sons of men, whose teeth are weapons and arrows, * and their tongue a sharp sword.

psalm:56:gloria.latin: Exaltáre super cælos, Deus, * et in omnem terram glória tua.
psalm:56:gloria.english: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens, * and thy glory above all the earth.

psalm:56:gloria.latin: Láqueum paravérunt pédibus meis: * et incurvavérunt ánimam meam.
psalm:56:gloria.english: They prepared a snare for my feet; * and they bowed down my soul.

psalm:56:gloria.latin: Fodérunt ante fáciem meam fóveam: * et incidérunt in eam.
psalm:56:gloria.english: They dug a pit before my face, * and they are fallen into it.

psalm:56:gloria.latin: Parátum cor meum, Deus, parátum cor meum: * cantábo, et psalmum dicam.
psalm:56:gloria.english: My heart is ready, O God, my heart is ready: * I will sing, and rehearse a psalm.

psalm:56:gloria.latin: Exsúrge, glória mea, exsúrge, psaltérium et cíthara: * exsúrgam dilúculo.
psalm:56:gloria.english: Arise, O my glory, arise psaltery and harp: * I will arise early.

psalm:56:gloria.latin: Confitébor tibi in pópulis, Dómine: * et psalmum dicam tibi in géntibus:
psalm:56:gloria.english: I will give praise to thee, O Lord, among the people: * I will sing a psalm to thee among the nations.

psalm:56:gloria.latin: Quóniam magnificáta est usque ad cælos misericórdia tua, * et usque ad nubes véritas tua.
psalm:56:gloria.english: For thy mercy is magnified even to the heavens: * and thy truth unto the clouds.

psalm:56:gloria.latin: Exaltáre super cælos, Deus: * et super omnem terram glória tua.
psalm:56:gloria.english: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: * and thy glory above all the earth.

psalm:56:gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:56:gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:56:gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:56:gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:222:gloria.latin: Ego dixi: In dimídio diérum meórum * vadam ad portas ínferi.
psalm:222:gloria.english: I said: In the midst of my days * I shall go to the gates of hell:

psalm:222:gloria.latin: Quæsívi resíduum annórum meórum. * Dixi: Non vidébo Dóminum Deum in terra vivéntium.
psalm:222:gloria.english: I sought for the residue of my years. * I said: I shall not see the Lord God in the land of the living.

psalm:222:gloria.latin: Non aspíciam hóminem ultra, * et habitatórem quiétis.
psalm:222:gloria.english: I shall behold man no more, * nor the inhabitant of rest.

psalm:222:gloria.latin: Generátio mea abláta est, et convolúta est a me, * quasi tabernáculum pastórum.
psalm:222:gloria.english: My generation is at an end, and it is rolled away from me, * as a shepherd’s tent.

psalm:222:gloria.latin: Præcísa est velut a texénte, vita mea: dum adhuc ordírer, succídit me: * de mane usque ad vésperam fínies me.
psalm:222:gloria.english: My life is cut off, as by a weaver: whilst I was yet but beginning, he cut me off: * from morning even to night thou wilt make an end of me.

psalm:222:gloria.latin: Sperábam usque ad mane, * quasi leo sic contrívit ómnia ossa mea:
psalm:222:gloria.english: I hoped till morning, * as a lion so hath he broken all my bones:

psalm:222:gloria.latin: De mane usque ad vésperam fínies me: * sicut pullus hirúndinis sic clamábo, meditábor ut colúmba:
psalm:222:gloria.english: From morning even to night thou wilt make an end of me. * I will cry like a young swallow, I will meditate like a dove:

psalm:222:gloria.latin: Attenuáti sunt óculi mei, * suspiciéntes in excélsum.
psalm:222:gloria.english: My eyes are weakened * looking upward:

psalm:222:gloria.latin: Dómine, vim pátior, respónde pro me. * Quid dicam, aut quid respondébit mihi, cum ipse fécerit?
psalm:222:gloria.english: Lord, I suffer violence, answer thou for me. * What shall I say, or what shall he answer for me, whereas he himself hath done it?

psalm:222:gloria.latin: Recogitábo tibi omnes annos meos * in amaritúdine ánimæ meæ.
psalm:222:gloria.english: I will recount to thee all my years * in the bitterness of my soul.

psalm:222:gloria.latin: Dómine, si sic vívitur, et in tálibus vita spíritus mei, corrípies me, et vivificábis me. * Ecce, in pace amaritúdo mea amaríssima:
psalm:222:gloria.english: O Lord, if man’s life be such, and the life of my spirit be in such things as these, thou shalt correct me, and make me to live. * Behold in peace is my bitterness most bitter:

psalm:222:gloria.latin: Tu autem eruísti ánimam meam ut non períret: * projecísti post tergum tuum ómnia peccáta mea.
psalm:222:gloria.english: But thou hast delivered my soul that it should not perish, * thou hast cast all my sins behind thy back.

psalm:222:gloria.latin: Quia non inférnus confitébitur tibi, neque mors laudábit te: * non exspectábunt qui descéndunt in lacum, veritátem tuam.
psalm:222:gloria.english: For hell shall not confess to thee, neither shall death praise thee: * nor shall they that go down into the pit, look for thy truth.

psalm:222:gloria.latin: Vivens vivens ipse confitébitur tibi, sicut et ego hódie: * pater fíliis notam fáciet veritátem tuam.
psalm:222:gloria.english: The living, the living, he shall give praise to thee, as I do this day: * the father shall make thy truth known to the children.

psalm:222:gloria.latin: Dómine, salvum me fac * et psalmos nostros cantábimus cunctis diébus vitæ nostræ in domo Dómini.
psalm:222:gloria.english: O Lord, save me, and we will sing our psalms all the days of our life * in the house of the Lord.

psalm:222:gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:222:gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:222:gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:222:gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:7:gloria.english: Psalm 7

psalm:7:gloria.latin: Dómine, Deus meus, in te sperávi: * salvum me fac ex ómnibus persequéntibus me, et líbera me.
psalm:7:gloria.english: O Lord my God, in thee have I put my trust: * save me from all them that persecute me, and deliver me.

psalm:7:gloria.latin: Nequándo rápiat ut leo ánimam meam, * dum non est qui rédimat, neque qui salvum fáciat.
psalm:7:gloria.english: Lest at any time he seize upon my soul like a lion, * while there is no one to redeem me, nor to save.

psalm:7:gloria.latin: Dómine, Deus meus, si feci istud, * si est iníquitas in mánibus meis:
psalm:7:gloria.english: O Lord my God, if I have done this thing, * if there be iniquity in my hands:

psalm:7:gloria.latin: Si réddidi retribuéntibus mihi mala, * décidam mérito ab inimícis meis inánis.
psalm:7:gloria.english: If I have rendered to them that repaid me evils, * let me deservedly fall empty before my enemies.

psalm:7:gloria.latin: Persequátur inimícus ánimam meam, † et comprehéndat, et concúlcet in terra vitam meam, * et glóriam meam in púlverem dedúcat.
psalm:7:gloria.english: Let the enemy pursue my soul, † and take it, and tread down my life on the earth, * and bring down my glory to the dust.

psalm:7:gloria.latin: Exsúrge, Dómine, in ira tua: * et exaltáre in fínibus inimicórum meórum.
psalm:7:gloria.english: Rise up, O Lord, in thy anger: * and be thou exalted in the borders of my enemies.

psalm:7:gloria.latin: Et exsúrge, Dómine, Deus meus, in præcépto quod mandásti: * (8a) et synagóga populórum circúmdabit te.
psalm:7:gloria.english: And arise, O Lord my God, in the precept which thou hast commanded: * (8a) and a congregation of people shall surround thee.

psalm:7:gloria.latin: Et propter hanc in altum regrédere: * (9a) Dóminus júdicat pópulos.
psalm:7:gloria.english: And for their sakes return thou on high. * (9a) The Lord judgeth the people.

psalm:7:gloria.latin: Júdica me, Dómine, secúndum justítiam meam, * et secúndum innocéntiam meam super me.
psalm:7:gloria.english: Judge me, O Lord, according to my justice, * and according to my innocence in me.

psalm:7:gloria.latin: Consumétur nequítia peccatórum, et díriges justum, * scrutans corda et renes, Deus.
psalm:7:gloria.english: The wickedness of sinners shall be brought to nought: and thou shalt direct the just: * the searcher of hearts and reins is God.

psalm:7:gloria.latin: Justum adjutórium meum a Dómino, * qui salvos facit rectos corde.
psalm:7:gloria.english: Just is my help from the Lord: * who saveth the upright of heart.

psalm:7:gloria.latin: Deus judex justus, fortis, et pátiens: * numquid iráscitur per síngulos dies?
psalm:7:gloria.english: God is a just judge, strong and patient: * is he angry every day?

psalm:7:gloria.latin: Nisi convérsi fuéritis, gládium suum vibrábit: * arcum suum teténdit, et parávit illum.
psalm:7:gloria.english: Except you will be converted, he will brandish his sword: * he hath bent his bow, and made it ready.

psalm:7:gloria.latin: Et in eo parávit vasa mortis: * sagíttas suas ardéntibus effécit.
psalm:7:gloria.english: And in it he hath prepared the instruments of death, * he hath made ready his arrows for them that burn.

psalm:7:gloria.latin: Ecce, partúriit injustítiam: * concépit dolórem, et péperit iniquitátem.
psalm:7:gloria.english: Behold he hath been in labour with injustice; * he hath conceived sorrow, and brought forth iniquity.

psalm:7:gloria.latin: Lacum apéruit, et effódit eum: * et íncidit in fóveam quam fecit.
psalm:7:gloria.english: He hath opened a pit and dug it: * and he is fallen into the hole he made.

psalm:7:gloria.latin: Convertétur dolor ejus in caput ejus: * et in vérticem ipsíus iníquitas ejus descéndet.
psalm:7:gloria.english: His sorrow shall be turned on his own head: * and his iniquity shall come down upon his crown.

psalm:7:gloria.latin: Confitébor Dómino secúndum justítiam ejus: * et psallam nómini Dómini altíssimi.
psalm:7:gloria.english: I will give glory to the Lord according to his justice: * and will sing to the name of the Lord the most High.

psalm:7:gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:7:gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:7:gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:7:gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:8:gloria.latin: Dómine, Dóminus noster, * quam admirábile est nomen tuum in univérsa terra!
psalm:8:gloria.english: O Lord our Lord, * how admirable is thy name in the whole earth!

psalm:8:gloria.latin: Quóniam eleváta est magnificéntia tua, * super cælos.
psalm:8:gloria.english: For thy magnificence is elevated * above the heavens.

psalm:8:gloria.latin: Ex ore infántium et lacténtium perfecísti laudem propter inimícos tuos, * ut déstruas inimícum et ultórem.
psalm:8:gloria.english: Out of the mouth of infants and of sucklings thou hast perfected praise, because of thy enemies, * that thou mayst destroy the enemy and the avenger.

psalm:8:gloria.latin: Quóniam vidébo cælos tuos, ópera digitórum tuórum: * lunam et stellas, quæ tu fundásti.
psalm:8:gloria.english: For I will behold thy heavens, the works of thy fingers: * the moon and the stars which thou hast founded.

psalm:8:gloria.latin: Quid est homo quod memor es ejus? * aut fílius hóminis, quóniam vísitas eum?
psalm:8:gloria.english: What is man that thou art mindful of him? * or the son of man that thou visitest him?

psalm:8:gloria.latin: Minuísti eum paulo minus ab Ángelis, † glória et honóre coronásti eum: * (7) et constituísti eum super ópera mánuum tuárum.
psalm:8:gloria.english: Thou hast made him a little less than the angels, † thou hast crowned him with glory and honour: * (7) and hast set him over the works of thy hands.

psalm:8:gloria.latin: Ómnia subjecísti sub pédibus ejus, * oves et boves univérsas: ínsuper et pécora campi.
psalm:8:gloria.english: Thou hast subjected all things under his feet, * all sheep and oxen: moreover the beasts also of the fields.

psalm:8:gloria.latin: Vólucres cæli, et pisces maris, * qui perámbulant sémitas maris.
psalm:8:gloria.english: The birds of the air, and the fishes of the sea, * that pass through the paths of the sea.

psalm:8:gloria.latin: Dómine, Dóminus noster, * quam admirábile est nomen tuum in univérsa terra!
psalm:8:gloria.english: O Lord our Lord, * how admirable is thy name in all the earth!

psalm:8:gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:8:gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:8:gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:8:gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:9(2-19):gloria.english: Psalm 9(2-19)

psalm:9(2-19):gloria.latin: Confitébor tibi, Dómine, in toto corde meo: * narrábo ómnia mirabília tua.
psalm:9(2-19):gloria.english: I will give praise to thee, O Lord, with my whole heart: * I will relate all thy wonders.

psalm:9(2-19):gloria.latin: Lætábor et exsultábo in te: * psallam nómini tuo, Altíssime.
psalm:9(2-19):gloria.english: I will be glad and rejoice in thee: * I will sing to thy name, O thou most high.

psalm:9(2-19):gloria.latin: In converténdo inimícum meum retrórsum: * infirmabúntur, et períbunt a fácie tua.
psalm:9(2-19):gloria.english: When my enemy shall be turned back: * they shall be weakened and perish before thy face.

psalm:9(2-19):gloria.latin: Quóniam fecísti judícium meum et causam meam: * sedísti super thronum, qui júdicas justítiam.
psalm:9(2-19):gloria.english: For thou hast maintained my judgment and my cause: * thou hast sat on the throne, who judgest justice.

psalm:9(2-19):gloria.latin: Increpásti gentes, et périit ímpius: * nomen eórum delésti in ætérnum, et in sǽculum sǽculi.
psalm:9(2-19):gloria.english: Thou hast rebuked the Gentiles, and the wicked one hath perished: * thou hast blotted out their name for ever and ever.

psalm:9(2-19):gloria.latin: Inimíci defecérunt frámeæ in finem: * et civitátes eórum destruxísti.
psalm:9(2-19):gloria.english: The swords of the enemy have failed unto the end: * and their cities thou hast destroyed.

psalm:9(2-19):gloria.latin: Périit memória eórum cum sónitu: * (8a) et Dóminus in ætérnum pérmanet.
psalm:9(2-19):gloria.english: Their memory hath perished with a noise. * (8a) But the Lord remaineth for ever.

psalm:9(2-19):gloria.latin: Parávit in judício thronum suum: * (9) et ipse judicábit orbem terræ in æquitáte, judicábit pópulos in justítia.
psalm:9(2-19):gloria.english: He hath prepared his throne in judgment: * (9) And he shall judge the world in equity, he shall judge the people in justice.

psalm:9(2-19):gloria.latin: Et factus est Dóminus refúgium páuperi: * adjútor in opportunitátibus, in tribulatióne.
psalm:9(2-19):gloria.english: And the Lord is become a refuge for the poor: * a helper in due time in tribulation.

psalm:9(2-19):gloria.latin: Et sperent in te qui novérunt nomen tuum: * quóniam non dereliquísti quæréntes te, Dómine.
