psalm:9(2-19):gloria.english: And let them trust in thee who know thy name: * for thou hast not forsaken them that seek thee, O Lord.

psalm:9(2-19):gloria.latin: Psállite Dómino, qui hábitat in Sion: * annuntiáte inter gentes stúdia ejus:
psalm:9(2-19):gloria.english: Sing ye to the Lord, who dwelleth in Sion: * declare his ways among the Gentiles.

psalm:9(2-19):gloria.latin: Quóniam requírens sánguinem eórum recordátus est: * non est oblítus clamórem páuperum.
psalm:9(2-19):gloria.english: For requiring their blood he hath remembered them: * he hath not forgotten the cry of the poor.

psalm:9(2-19):gloria.latin: Miserére mei, Dómine: * vide humilitátem meam de inimícis meis.
psalm:9(2-19):gloria.english: Have mercy on me, O Lord: * see my humiliation which I suffer from my enemies.

psalm:9(2-19):gloria.latin: Qui exáltas me de portis mortis, * ut annúntiem omnes laudatiónes tuas in portis fíliæ Sion.
psalm:9(2-19):gloria.english: Thou that liftest me up from the gates of death, * that I may declare all thy praises in the gates of the daughter of Sion.

psalm:9(2-19):gloria.latin: Exsultábo in salutári tuo: * infíxæ sunt gentes in intéritu, quem fecérunt.
psalm:9(2-19):gloria.english: I will rejoice in thy salvation: * the Gentiles have stuck fast in the destruction which they have prepared.

psalm:9(2-19):gloria.latin: In láqueo isto, quem abscondérunt, * comprehénsus est pes eórum.
psalm:9(2-19):gloria.english: Their foot hath been taken * in the very snare which they hid.

psalm:9(2-19):gloria.latin: Cognoscétur Dóminus judícia fáciens: * in opéribus mánuum suárum comprehénsus est peccátor.
psalm:9(2-19):gloria.english: The Lord shall be known when he executeth judgments: * the sinner hath been caught in the works of his own hands.

psalm:9(2-19):gloria.latin: Convertántur peccatóres in inférnum, * omnes gentes quæ obliviscúntur Deum.
psalm:9(2-19):gloria.english: The wicked shall be turned into hell, * all the nations that forget God.

psalm:9(2-19):gloria.latin: Quóniam non in finem oblívio erit páuperis: * patiéntia páuperum non períbit in finem.
psalm:9(2-19):gloria.english: For the poor man shall not be forgotten to the end: * the patience of the poor shall not perish for ever.

psalm:9(2-19):gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:9(2-19):gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:9(2-19):gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:9(2-19):gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:119:gloria.latin: Ad Dóminum cum tribulárer clamávi: * et exaudívit me.
psalm:119:gloria.english: In my trouble I cried to the Lord: * and he heard me.

psalm:119:gloria.latin: Dómine, líbera ánimam meam a lábiis iníquis, * et a lingua dolósa.
psalm:119:gloria.english: O Lord, deliver my soul from wicked lips, * and a deceitful tongue.

psalm:119:gloria.latin: Quid detur tibi, aut quid apponátur tibi * ad linguam dolósam?
psalm:119:gloria.english: What shall be given to thee, or what shall be added to thee, * to a deceitful tongue?

psalm:119:gloria.latin: Sagíttæ poténtis acútæ, * cum carbónibus desolatóriis.
psalm:119:gloria.english: The sharp arrows of the mighty, * with coals that lay waste.

psalm:119:gloria.latin: Heu mihi, quia incolátus meus prolongátus est: † habitávi cum habitántibus Cedar: * (6) multum íncola fuit ánima mea.
psalm:119:gloria.english: Woe is me, that my sojourning is prolonged! † I have dwelt with the inhabitants of Cedar: * (6) my soul hath been long a sojourner.

psalm:119:gloria.latin: Cum his, qui odérunt pacem, eram pacíficus: * cum loquébar illis, impugnábant me gratis.
psalm:119:gloria.english: With them that hated peace I was peaceable: * when I spoke to them they fought against me without cause.

psalm:119:gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:119:gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:119:gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:119:gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:120:gloria.latin: Levávi óculos meos in montes, * unde véniet auxílium mihi.
psalm:120:gloria.english: I have lifted up my eyes to the mountains, * from whence help shall come to me.

psalm:120:gloria.latin: Auxílium meum a Dómino, * qui fecit cælum et terram.
psalm:120:gloria.english: My help is from the Lord, * who made heaven and earth.

psalm:120:gloria.latin: Non det in commotiónem pedem tuum: * neque dormítet qui custódit te.
psalm:120:gloria.english: May he not suffer thy foot to be moved: * neither let him slumber that keepeth thee.

psalm:120:gloria.latin: Ecce, non dormitábit neque dórmiet, * qui custódit Israël.
psalm:120:gloria.english: Behold he shall neither slumber nor sleep, * that keepeth Israel.

psalm:120:gloria.latin: Dóminus custódit te, Dóminus protéctio tua, * super manum déxteram tuam.
psalm:120:gloria.english: The Lord is thy keeper, the Lord is thy protection * upon thy right hand.

psalm:120:gloria.latin: Per diem sol non uret te: * neque luna per noctem.
psalm:120:gloria.english: The sun shall not burn thee by day: * nor the moon by night.

psalm:120:gloria.latin: Dóminus custódit te ab omni malo: * custódiat ánimam tuam Dóminus.
psalm:120:gloria.english: The Lord keepeth thee from all evil: * may the Lord keep thy soul.

psalm:120:gloria.latin: Dóminus custódiat intróitum tuum, et éxitum tuum: * ex hoc nunc, et usque in sǽculum.
psalm:120:gloria.english: May the Lord keep thy coming in and thy going out; * from henceforth now and for ever.

psalm:120:gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:120:gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:120:gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:120:gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:121:gloria.latin: Lætátus sum in his, quæ dicta sunt mihi: * In domum Dómini íbimus.
psalm:121:gloria.english: I rejoiced at the things that were said to me: * We shall go into the house of the Lord.

psalm:121:gloria.latin: Stantes erant pedes nostri, * in átriis tuis, Jerúsalem.
psalm:121:gloria.english: Our feet were standing * in thy courts, O Jerusalem.

psalm:121:gloria.latin: Jerúsalem, quæ ædificátur ut cívitas: * cujus participátio ejus in idípsum.
psalm:121:gloria.english: Jerusalem, which is built as a city, * which is compact together.

psalm:121:gloria.latin: Illuc enim ascendérunt tribus, tribus Dómini: * testimónium Israël ad confiténdum nómini Dómini.
psalm:121:gloria.english: For thither did the tribes go up, the tribes of the Lord: * the testimony of Israel, to praise the name of the Lord.

psalm:121:gloria.latin: Quia illic sedérunt sedes in judício, * sedes super domum David.
psalm:121:gloria.english: Because their seats have sat in judgment, * seats upon the house of David.

psalm:121:gloria.latin: Rogáte quæ ad pacem sunt Jerúsalem: * et abundántia diligéntibus te:
psalm:121:gloria.english: Pray ye for the things that are for the peace of Jerusalem: * and abundance for them that love thee.

psalm:121:gloria.latin: Fiat pax in virtúte tua: * et abundántia in túrribus tuis.
psalm:121:gloria.english: Let peace be in thy strength: * and abundance in thy towers.

psalm:121:gloria.latin: Propter fratres meos, et próximos meos, * loquébar pacem de te:
psalm:121:gloria.english: For the sake of my brethren, and of my neighbours, * I spoke peace of thee.

psalm:121:gloria.latin: Propter domum Dómini, Dei nostri, * quæsívi bona tibi.
psalm:121:gloria.english: Because of the house of the Lord our God, * I have sought good things for thee.

psalm:121:gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:121:gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:121:gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:121:gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:122:gloria.latin: Ad te levávi óculos meos, * qui hábitas in cælis.
psalm:122:gloria.english: To thee have I lifted up my eyes, * who dwellest in heaven.

psalm:122:gloria.latin: Ecce, sicut óculi servórum * in mánibus dominórum suórum,
psalm:122:gloria.english: Behold as the eyes of servants * are on the hands of their masters,

psalm:122:gloria.latin: Sicut óculi ancíllæ in mánibus dóminæ suæ: * ita óculi nostri ad Dóminum, Deum nostrum, donec misereátur nostri.
psalm:122:gloria.english: As the eyes of the handmaid are on the hands of her mistress: * so are our eyes unto the Lord our God, until he have mercy on us.

psalm:122:gloria.latin: Miserére nostri, Dómine, miserére nostri: * quia multum repléti sumus despectióne:
psalm:122:gloria.english: Have mercy on us, O Lord, have mercy on us: * for we are greatly filled with contempt.

psalm:122:gloria.latin: Quia multum repléta est ánima nostra: * oppróbrium abundántibus, et despéctio supérbis.
psalm:122:gloria.english: For our soul is greatly filled: * we are a reproach to the rich, and contempt to the proud.

psalm:122:gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:122:gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:122:gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:122:gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:123:gloria.latin: Nisi quia Dóminus erat in nobis, dicat nunc Israël: * (2a) nisi quia Dóminus erat in nobis,
psalm:123:gloria.english: If it had not been that the Lord was with us, let Israel now say: * (2a) If it had not been that the Lord was with us,

psalm:123:gloria.latin: Cum exsúrgerent hómines in nos, * (3a) forte vivos deglutíssent nos:
psalm:123:gloria.english: When men rose up against us, * (3a) perhaps they had swallowed us up alive.

psalm:123:gloria.latin: Cum irascerétur furor eórum in nos, * (4) fórsitan aqua absorbuísset nos.
psalm:123:gloria.english: When their fury was enkindled against us, * (4) perhaps the waters had swallowed us up.

psalm:123:gloria.latin: Torréntem pertransívit ánima nostra: * fórsitan pertransísset ánima nostra aquam intolerábilem.
psalm:123:gloria.english: Our soul hath passed through a torrent: * perhaps our soul had passed through a water insupportable.

psalm:123:gloria.latin: Benedíctus Dóminus * qui non dedit nos in captiónem déntibus eórum.
psalm:123:gloria.english: Blessed be the Lord, * who hath not given us to be a prey to their teeth.

psalm:123:gloria.latin: Ánima nostra sicut passer erépta est * de láqueo venántium:
psalm:123:gloria.english: Our soul hath been delivered as a sparrow * out of the snare of the fowlers.

psalm:123:gloria.latin: Láqueus contrítus est, * et nos liberáti sumus.
psalm:123:gloria.english: The snare is broken, * and we are delivered.

psalm:123:gloria.latin: Adjutórium nostrum in nómine Dómini, * qui fecit cælum et terram.
psalm:123:gloria.english: Our help is in the name of the Lord, * who made heaven and earth.

psalm:123:gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:123:gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:123:gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:123:gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:124:gloria.latin: Qui confídunt in Dómino, sicut mons Sion: * non commovébitur in ætérnum, qui hábitat (2a) in Jerúsalem.
psalm:124:gloria.english: They that trust in the Lord shall be as mount Sion: * he shall not be moved for ever that dwelleth (2a) in Jerusalem.

psalm:124:gloria.latin: Montes in circúitu ejus: ‡ et Dóminus in circúitu pópuli sui, * ex hoc nunc et usque in sǽculum.
psalm:124:gloria.english: Mountains are round about it: ‡ so the Lord is round about his people * from henceforth now and for ever.

psalm:124:gloria.latin: Quia non relínquet Dóminus virgam peccatórum super sortem justórum: * ut non exténdant justi ad iniquitátem manus suas.
psalm:124:gloria.english: For the Lord will not leave the rod of sinners upon the lot of the just: * that the just may not stretch forth their hands to iniquity.

psalm:124:gloria.latin: Bénefac, Dómine, bonis, * et rectis corde.
psalm:124:gloria.english: Do good, O Lord, to those that are good, * and to the upright of heart.

psalm:124:gloria.latin: Declinántes autem in obligatiónes addúcet Dóminus cum operántibus iniquitátem: * pax super Israël.
psalm:124:gloria.english: But such as turn aside into bonds, the Lord shall lead out with the workers of iniquity: * peace upon Israel.

psalm:124:gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:124:gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:124:gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:124:gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:125:gloria.latin: In converténdo Dóminus captivitátem Sion: * facti sumus sicut consoláti:
psalm:125:gloria.english: When the Lord brought back the captivity of Sion, * we became like men comforted.

psalm:125:gloria.latin: Tunc replétum est gáudio os nostrum: * et lingua nostra exsultatióne.
psalm:125:gloria.english: Then was our mouth filled with gladness; * and our tongue with joy.

psalm:125:gloria.latin: Tunc dicent inter gentes: * Magnificávit Dóminus fácere cum eis.
psalm:125:gloria.english: Then shall they say among the Gentiles: * The Lord hath done great things for them.

psalm:125:gloria.latin: Magnificávit Dóminus fácere nobíscum: * facti sumus lætántes.
psalm:125:gloria.english: The Lord hath done great things for us: * we are become joyful.

psalm:125:gloria.latin: Convérte, Dómine, captivitátem nostram, * sicut torrens in Austro.
psalm:125:gloria.english: Turn again our captivity, O Lord, * as a stream in the south.

psalm:125:gloria.latin: Qui séminant in lácrimis, * in exsultatióne metent.
psalm:125:gloria.english: They that sow in tears * shall reap in joy.

psalm:125:gloria.latin: Eúntes ibant et flebant, * mitténtes sémina sua.
psalm:125:gloria.english: Going they went and wept, * casting their seeds.

psalm:125:gloria.latin: Veniéntes autem vénient cum exsultatióne, * portántes manípulos suos.
psalm:125:gloria.english: But coming they shall come with joyfulness, * carrying their sheaves.

psalm:125:gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:125:gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:125:gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:125:gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:126:gloria.latin: Nisi Dóminus ædificáverit domum, * in vanum laboravérunt qui ædíficant eam.
psalm:126:gloria.english: Unless the Lord build the house, * they labour in vain that build it.

psalm:126:gloria.latin: Nisi Dóminus custodíerit civitátem, * frustra vígilat qui custódit eam.
psalm:126:gloria.english: Unless the Lord keep the city, * he watcheth in vain that keepeth it.

psalm:126:gloria.latin: Vanum est vobis ante lucem súrgere: * súrgite postquam sedéritis, qui manducátis panem dolóris.
psalm:126:gloria.english: It is vain for you to rise before light, * rise ye after you have sitten, you that eat the bread of sorrow.

psalm:126:gloria.latin: Cum déderit diléctis suis somnum: * (3) ecce heréditas Dómini fílii: merces, fructus ventris.
psalm:126:gloria.english: When he shall give sleep to his beloved, * (3) behold the inheritance of the Lord are children: the reward, the fruit of the womb.

psalm:126:gloria.latin: Sicut sagíttæ in manu poténtis: * ita fílii excussórum.
psalm:126:gloria.english: As arrows in the hand of the mighty, * so the children of them that have been shaken.

psalm:126:gloria.latin: Beátus vir, qui implévit desidérium suum ex ipsis: * non confundétur cum loquétur inimícis suis in porta.
psalm:126:gloria.english: Blessed is the man that hath filled the desire with them; * he shall not be confounded when he shall speak to his enemies in the gate.

psalm:126:gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:126:gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:126:gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:126:gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:127:gloria.latin: Beáti, omnes, qui timent Dóminum, * qui ámbulant in viis ejus.
psalm:127:gloria.english: Blessed are all they that fear the Lord: * that walk in his ways.

psalm:127:gloria.latin: Labóres mánuum tuárum quia manducábis: * beátus es, et bene tibi erit.
psalm:127:gloria.english: For thou shalt eat the labours of thy hands: * blessed art thou, and it shall be well with thee.

psalm:127:gloria.latin: Uxor tua sicut vitis abúndans, * in latéribus domus tuæ.
psalm:127:gloria.english: Thy wife as a fruitful vine, * on the sides of thy house.

psalm:127:gloria.latin: Fílii tui sicut novéllæ olivárum, * in circúitu mensæ tuæ.
psalm:127:gloria.english: Thy children as olive plants, * round about thy table.

psalm:127:gloria.latin: Ecce, sic benedicétur homo, * qui timet Dóminum.
psalm:127:gloria.english: Behold, thus shall the man be blessed * that feareth the Lord.

psalm:127:gloria.latin: Benedícat tibi Dóminus ex Sion: * et vídeas bona Jerúsalem ómnibus diébus vitæ tuæ.
psalm:127:gloria.english: May the Lord bless thee out of Sion: * and mayst thou see the good things of Jerusalem all the days of thy life.

psalm:127:gloria.latin: Et vídeas fílios filiórum tuórum, * pacem super Israël.
psalm:127:gloria.english: And mayst thou see thy children’s children, * peace upon Israel.

psalm:127:gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:127:gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:127:gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:127:gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:129:gloria.latin: De profúndis clamávi ad te, Dómine: * (2a) Dómine, exáudi vocem meam:
psalm:129:gloria.english: Out of the depths I have cried to thee, O Lord: * (2a) Lord, hear my voice.

psalm:129:gloria.latin: Fiant aures tuæ intendéntes, * in vocem deprecatiónis meæ.
psalm:129:gloria.english: Let thy ears be attentive * to the voice of my supplication.

psalm:129:gloria.latin: Si iniquitátes observáveris, Dómine: * Dómine, quis sustinébit?
psalm:129:gloria.english: If thou, O Lord, wilt mark iniquities: * Lord, who shall stand it.

psalm:129:gloria.latin: Quia apud te propitiátio est: * et propter legem tuam sustínui te, Dómine.
psalm:129:gloria.english: For with thee there is merciful forgiveness: * and by reason of thy law, I have waited for thee, O Lord.

psalm:129:gloria.latin: Sustínuit ánima mea in verbo ejus: * (5) sperávit ánima mea in Dómino.
psalm:129:gloria.english: My soul hath relied on his word: * (5) my soul hath hoped in the Lord.

psalm:129:gloria.latin: A custódia matutína usque ad noctem: * speret Israël in Dómino.
psalm:129:gloria.english: From the morning watch even until night, * let Israel hope in the Lord.

psalm:129:gloria.latin: Quia apud Dóminum misericórdia: * et copiósa apud eum redémptio.
psalm:129:gloria.english: Because with the Lord there is mercy: * and with him plentiful redemption.

psalm:129:gloria.latin: Et ipse rédimet Israël, * ex ómnibus iniquitátibus ejus.
psalm:129:gloria.english: And he shall redeem Israel * from all his iniquities.

psalm:129:gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:129:gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:129:gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:129:gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:130:gloria.latin: Dómine, non est exaltátum cor meum: * neque eláti sunt óculi mei.
psalm:130:gloria.english: O Lord, my heart is not exalted: * nor are my eyes lofty.

psalm:130:gloria.latin: Neque ambulávi in magnis: * neque in mirabílibus super me.
psalm:130:gloria.english: Neither have I walked in great matters, * nor in wonderful things above me.

psalm:130:gloria.latin: Si non humíliter sentiébam: * sed exaltávi ánimam meam:
psalm:130:gloria.english: If I was not humbly minded, * but exalted my soul:

psalm:130:gloria.latin: Sicut ablactátus est super matre sua, * ita retribútio in ánima mea.
psalm:130:gloria.english: As a child that is weaned is towards his mother, * so reward in my soul.

psalm:130:gloria.latin: Speret Israël in Dómino, * ex hoc nunc et usque in sǽculum.
psalm:130:gloria.english: Let Israel hope in the Lord, * from henceforth now and for ever.

psalm:130:gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:130:gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:130:gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:130:gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:131:gloria.english: Psalm 131

psalm:131:gloria.latin: Meménto, Dómine, David, * et omnis mansuetúdinis ejus:
psalm:131:gloria.english: Lord, remember David, * and all his meekness.

psalm:131:gloria.latin: Sicut jurávit Dómino, * votum vovit Deo Jacob:
psalm:131:gloria.english: How he swore to the Lord, * he vowed a vow to the God of Jacob:

psalm:131:gloria.latin: Si introíero in tabernáculum domus meæ, * si ascéndero in lectum strati mei:
psalm:131:gloria.english: If I shall enter into the tabernacle of my house: * if I shall go up into the bed wherein I lie:

psalm:131:gloria.latin: Si dédero somnum óculis meis, * et pálpebris meis dormitatiónem:
psalm:131:gloria.english: If I shall give sleep to my eyes, * or slumber to my eyelids,

psalm:131:gloria.latin: Et réquiem tempóribus meis: donec invéniam locum Dómino, * tabernáculum Deo Jacob.
psalm:131:gloria.english: Or rest to my temples: until I find out a place for the Lord, * a tabernacle for the God of Jacob.

psalm:131:gloria.latin: Ecce, audívimus eam in Éphrata: * invénimus eam in campis silvæ.
psalm:131:gloria.english: Behold we have heard of it in Ephrata: * we have found it in the fields of the wood.

psalm:131:gloria.latin: Introíbimus in tabernáculum ejus: * adorábimus in loco, ubi stetérunt pedes ejus.
psalm:131:gloria.english: We will go into his tabernacle: * we will adore in the place where his feet stood.

psalm:131:gloria.latin: Surge, Dómine, in réquiem tuam, * tu et arca sanctificatiónis tuæ.
psalm:131:gloria.english: Arise, O Lord, into thy resting place: * thou and the ark, which thou hast sanctified.

psalm:131:gloria.latin: Sacerdótes tui induántur justítiam: * et sancti tui exsúltent.
psalm:131:gloria.english: Let thy priests be clothed with justice: * and let thy saints rejoice.

psalm:131:gloria.latin: Propter David, servum tuum, * non avértas fáciem Christi tui.
psalm:131:gloria.english: For thy servant David’s sake, * turn not away the face of thy anointed.

psalm:131:gloria.latin: Jurávit Dóminus David veritátem, et non frustrábitur eam: * De fructu ventris tui ponam super sedem tuam.
psalm:131:gloria.english: The Lord hath sworn truth to David, and he will not make it void: * of the fruit of thy womb I will set upon thy throne.

psalm:131:gloria.latin: Si custodíerint fílii tui testaméntum meum, * et testimónia mea hæc, quæ docébo eos:
psalm:131:gloria.english: If thy children will keep my covenant, * and these my testimonies which I shall teach them:

psalm:131:gloria.latin: Et fílii eórum usque in sǽculum, * sedébunt super sedem tuam.
psalm:131:gloria.english: Their children also for evermore * shall sit upon thy throne.

psalm:131:gloria.latin: Quóniam elégit Dóminus Sion: * elégit eam in habitatiónem sibi.
psalm:131:gloria.english: For the Lord hath chosen Sion: * he hath chosen it for his dwelling.

psalm:131:gloria.latin: Hæc réquies mea in sǽculum sǽculi: * hic habitábo quóniam elégi eam.
psalm:131:gloria.english: This is my rest for ever and ever: * here will I dwell, for I have chosen it.

psalm:131:gloria.latin: Víduam ejus benedícens benedícam: * páuperes ejus saturábo pánibus.
psalm:131:gloria.english: Blessing I will bless her widow: * I will satisfy her poor with bread.

psalm:131:gloria.latin: Sacerdótes ejus índuam salutári: * et sancti ejus exsultatióne exsultábunt.
psalm:131:gloria.english: I will clothe her priests with salvation: * and her saints shall rejoice with exceeding great joy.

psalm:131:gloria.latin: Illuc prodúcam cornu David, * parávi lucérnam Christo meo.
psalm:131:gloria.english: There will I bring forth a horn to David: * I have prepared a lamp for my anointed.

psalm:131:gloria.latin: Inimícos ejus índuam confusióne: * super ipsum autem efflorébit sanctificátio mea.
psalm:131:gloria.english: His enemies I will clothe with confusion: * but upon him shall my sanctification flourish.

psalm:131:gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:131:gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:131:gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:131:gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:132:gloria.latin: Ecce quam bonum et quam jucúndum, * habitáre fratres in unum:
psalm:132:gloria.english: Behold how good and how pleasant it is * for brethren to dwell together in unity:

psalm:132:gloria.latin: Sicut unguéntum in cápite, * quod descéndit in barbam, barbam Aaron,
psalm:132:gloria.english: Like the precious ointment on the head, * that ran down upon the beard, the beard of Aaron,

psalm:132:gloria.latin: Quod descéndit in oram vestiménti ejus: * (3a) sicut ros Hermon, qui descéndit in montem Sion.
psalm:132:gloria.english: Which ran down to the skirt of his garment: * (3a) as the dew of Hermon, which descendeth upon mount Sion.

psalm:132:gloria.latin: Quóniam illic mandávit Dóminus benedictiónem, * et vitam usque in sǽculum.
psalm:132:gloria.english: For there the Lord hath commanded blessing, * and life for evermore.

psalm:132:gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:132:gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:132:gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:132:gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:63:gloria.latin: Exáudi, Deus, oratiónem meam cum déprecor: * a timóre inimíci éripe ánimam meam.
psalm:63:gloria.english: Hear, O God, my prayer, when I make supplication to thee: * deliver my soul from the fear of the enemy.

psalm:63:gloria.latin: Protexísti me a convéntu malignántium: * a multitúdine operántium iniquitátem.
psalm:63:gloria.english: Thou hast protected me from the assembly of the malignant; * from the multitude of the workers of iniquity.

psalm:63:gloria.latin: Quia exacuérunt ut gládium linguas suas: * intendérunt arcum rem amáram, ut sagíttent in occúltis immaculátum.
psalm:63:gloria.english: For they have whetted their tongues like a sword; * they have bent their bow a bitter thing, to shoot in secret the undefiled.

psalm:63:gloria.latin: Súbito sagittábunt eum, et non timébunt: * firmavérunt sibi sermónem nequam.
psalm:63:gloria.english: They will shoot at him on a sudden, and will not fear: * they are resolute in wickedness.

psalm:63:gloria.latin: Narravérunt ut abscónderent láqueos: * dixérunt: Quis vidébit eos?
psalm:63:gloria.english: They have talked of hiding snares; * they have said: Who shall see them?

psalm:63:gloria.latin: Scrutáti sunt iniquitátes: * defecérunt scrutántes scrutínio.
psalm:63:gloria.english: They have searched after iniquities: * they have failed in their search.

psalm:63:gloria.latin: Accédet homo ad cor altum: * et exaltábitur Deus.
psalm:63:gloria.english: Man shall come to a deep heart: * and God shall be exalted.

psalm:63:gloria.latin: Sagíttæ parvulórum factæ sunt plagæ eórum: * et infirmátæ sunt contra eos linguæ eórum.
psalm:63:gloria.english: The arrows of children are their wounds: * and their tongues against them are made weak.

psalm:63:gloria.latin: Conturbáti sunt omnes qui vidébant eos: * et tímuit omnis homo.
psalm:63:gloria.english: All that saw them were troubled; * and every man was afraid.

psalm:63:gloria.latin: Et annuntiavérunt ópera Dei, * et facta ejus intellexérunt.
psalm:63:gloria.english: And they declared the works of God: * and understood his doings.

psalm:63:gloria.latin: Lætábitur justus in Dómino, et sperábit in eo, * et laudabúntur omnes recti corde.
psalm:63:gloria.english: The just shall rejoice in the Lord, and shall hope in him: * and all the upright in heart shall be praised.

psalm:63:gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:63:gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:63:gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:63:gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:64:gloria.latin: Te decet hymnus, Deus, in Sion: * et tibi reddétur votum in Jerúsalem.
psalm:64:gloria.english: A hymn, O God, becometh thee in Sion: * and a vow shall be paid to thee in Jerusalem.

psalm:64:gloria.latin: Exáudi oratiónem meam: * ad te omnis caro véniet.
psalm:64:gloria.english: O hear my prayer: * all flesh shall come to thee.

psalm:64:gloria.latin: Verba iniquórum prævaluérunt super nos: * et impietátibus nostris tu propitiáberis.
psalm:64:gloria.english: The words of the wicked have prevailed over us: * and thou wilt pardon our transgressions.

psalm:64:gloria.latin: Beátus, quem elegísti, et assumpsísti: * inhabitábit in átriis tuis.
psalm:64:gloria.english: Blessed is he whom thou hast chosen and taken to thee: * he shall dwell in thy courts.

psalm:64:gloria.latin: Replébimur in bonis domus tuæ: * sanctum est templum tuum, mirábile in æquitáte.
psalm:64:gloria.english: We shall be filled with the good things of thy house; holy is thy temple, * wonderful in justice.

psalm:64:gloria.latin: Exáudi nos, Deus, salutáris noster, * spes ómnium fínium terræ, et in mari longe.
psalm:64:gloria.english: Hear us, O God our saviour, * who art the hope of all the ends of the earth, and in the sea afar off.

psalm:64:gloria.latin: Prǽparans montes in virtúte tua, accínctus poténtia: * qui contúrbas profúndum maris sonum flúctuum ejus.
psalm:64:gloria.english: Thou who preparest the mountains by thy strength, being girded with power: * who troublest the depth of the sea, the noise of its waves.

psalm:64:gloria.latin: Turbabúntur gentes, et timébunt qui hábitant términos a signis tuis: * éxitus matutíni, et véspere delectábis.
psalm:64:gloria.english: The Gentiles shall be troubled, and they that dwell in the uttermost borders shall be afraid at thy signs: * thou shalt make the outgoings of the morning and of the evening to be joyful.

psalm:64:gloria.latin: Visitásti terram, et inebriásti eam: * multiplicásti locupletáre eam.
psalm:64:gloria.english: Thou hast visited the earth, and hast plentifully watered it; * thou hast many ways enriched it.

psalm:64:gloria.latin: Flumen Dei replétum est aquis, parásti cibum illórum: * quóniam ita est præparátio ejus.
psalm:64:gloria.english: The river of God is filled with water, thou hast prepared their food; * for so is its preparation.

psalm:64:gloria.latin: Rivos ejus inébria, multíplica genímina ejus: * in stillicídiis ejus lætábitur gérminans.
psalm:64:gloria.english: Fill up plentifully the streams thereof, multiply its fruits; * it shall spring up and rejoice in its showers.

psalm:64:gloria.latin: Benedíces corónæ anni benignitátis tuæ: * et campi tui replebúntur ubertáte.
psalm:64:gloria.english: Thou shalt bless the crown of the year of thy goodness: * and thy fields shall be filled with plenty.

psalm:64:gloria.latin: Pinguéscent speciósa desérti: * et exsultatióne colles accingéntur.
psalm:64:gloria.english: The beautiful places of the wilderness shall grow fat: * and the hills shall be girded about with joy.

psalm:64:gloria.latin: Indúti sunt aríetes óvium, et valles abundábunt fruménto: * clamábunt, étenim hymnum dicent.
psalm:64:gloria.english: The rams of the flock are clothed, and the vales shall abound with corn: * they shall shout, yea they shall sing a hymn.

psalm:64:gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:64:gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:64:gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:64:gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:223:gloria.latin: Exsultávit cor meum in Dómino, * et exaltátum est cornu meum in Deo meo.
psalm:223:gloria.english: My heart hath rejoiced in the Lord, * and my horn is exalted in my God:

psalm:223:gloria.latin: Dilatátum est os meum super inimícos meos: * quia lætáta sum in salutári tuo.
psalm:223:gloria.english: My mouth is enlarged over my enemies: * because I have joyed in thy salvation.

psalm:223:gloria.latin: Non est sanctus, ut est Dóminus: neque enim est álius extra te, * et non est fortis sicut Deus noster.
psalm:223:gloria.english: There is none holy as the Lord is: for there is no other beside thee, * and there is none strong like our God.
Do not multiply to speak lofty things, * boasting:

psalm:223:gloria.latin: Recédant vétera de ore vestro: quia Deus scientiárum, Dóminus est, * et ipsi præparántur cogitatiónes.
psalm:223:gloria.english: Let old matters depart from your mouth: for the Lord is a God of all knowledge, * and to him are thoughts prepared.

psalm:223:gloria.latin: Arcus fórtium superátus est, * et infírmi accíncti sunt róbore.
psalm:223:gloria.english: The bow of the mighty is overcome, * and the weak are girt with strength.

psalm:223:gloria.latin: Repléti prius, pro pánibus se locavérunt: * et famélici saturáti sunt.
psalm:223:gloria.english: They that were full before have hired out themselves for bread: * and the hungry are filled,

psalm:223:gloria.latin: Donec stérilis péperit plúrimos: * et quæ multos habébat fílios, infirmáta est.
psalm:223:gloria.english: So that the barren hath borne many: * and she that had many children is weakened.

psalm:223:gloria.latin: Dóminus mortíficat et vivíficat, * dedúcit ad ínferos et redúcit.
psalm:223:gloria.english: The Lord killeth and maketh alive, * he bringeth down to hell and bringeth back again.

psalm:223:gloria.latin: Dóminus páuperem facit et ditat, * humíliat et súblevat.
psalm:223:gloria.english: The Lord maketh poor and maketh rich, * he humbleth and he exalteth.

psalm:223:gloria.latin: Súscitat de púlvere egénum, * et de stércore élevat páuperem:
psalm:223:gloria.english: He raiseth up the needy from the dust, * and lifteth up the poor from the dunghill:

psalm:223:gloria.latin: Ut sédeat cum princípibus, * et sólium glóriæ téneat.
psalm:223:gloria.english: That he may sit with princes, * and hold the throne of glory.

psalm:223:gloria.latin: Dómini enim sunt cárdines terræ, * et pósuit super eos orbem.
psalm:223:gloria.english: For the poles of the earth are the Lord’s, * and upon them he hath set the world.

psalm:223:gloria.latin: Pedes sanctórum suórum servábit, et ímpii in ténebris conticéscent: * quia non in fortitúdine sua roborábitur vir.
psalm:223:gloria.english: He will keep the feet of his saints, and the wicked shall be silent in darkness, * because no man shall prevail by his own strength.

psalm:223:gloria.latin: Dóminum formidábunt adversárii ejus: * et super ipsos in cælis tonábit:
psalm:223:gloria.english: The adversaries of the Lord shall fear him: * and upon them shall he thunder in the heavens.

psalm:223:gloria.latin: Dóminus judicábit fines terræ, et dabit impérium regi suo, * et sublimábit cornu Christi sui.
psalm:223:gloria.english: The Lord shall judge the ends of the earth, and he shall give empire to his king, * and shall exalt the horn of his Christ.

psalm:223:gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:223:gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:223:gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:223:gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:9(20-39):gloria.latin: Exsúrge, Dómine, non confortétur homo: * judicéntur gentes in conspéctu tuo.
psalm:9(20-39):gloria.english: Arise, O Lord, let not man be strengthened: * let the Gentiles be judged in thy sight.

psalm:9(20-39):gloria.latin: Constítue, Dómine, legislatórem super eos: * ut sciant gentes quóniam hómines sunt.
psalm:9(20-39):gloria.english: Appoint, O Lord, a lawgiver over them: * that the Gentiles may know themselves to be but men.

psalm:9(20-39):gloria.latin: Ut quid, Dómine, recessísti longe, * déspicis in opportunitátibus, in tribulatióne?
psalm:9(20-39):gloria.english: Why, O Lord, hast thou retired afar off? * why dost thou slight us in our wants, in the time of trouble?

psalm:9(20-39):gloria.latin: Dum supérbit ímpius, incénditur pauper: * comprehendúntur in consíliis quibus cógitant.
psalm:9(20-39):gloria.english: Whilst the wicked man is proud, the poor is set on fire: * they are caught in the counsels which they devise.

psalm:9(20-39):gloria.latin: Quóniam laudátur peccátor in desidériis ánimæ suæ: * et iníquus benedícitur.
psalm:9(20-39):gloria.english: For the sinner is praised in the desires of his soul: * and the unjust man is blessed.

psalm:9(20-39):gloria.latin: Exacerbávit Dóminum peccátor, * secúndum multitúdinem iræ suæ non quæret.
psalm:9(20-39):gloria.english: The sinner hath provoked the Lord, * according to the multitude of his wrath he will not seek him.

psalm:9(20-39):gloria.latin: Non est Deus in conspéctu ejus: * inquinátæ sunt viæ illíus in omni témpore.
psalm:9(20-39):gloria.english: God is not before his eyes: * his ways are filthy at all times.

psalm:9(20-39):gloria.latin: Auferúntur judícia tua a fácie ejus: * ómnium inimicórum suórum dominábitur.
psalm:9(20-39):gloria.english: Thy judgments are removed from his sight: * he shall rule over all his enemies.

psalm:9(20-39):gloria.latin: Dixit enim in corde suo: * Non movébor a generatióne in generatiónem sine malo.
psalm:9(20-39):gloria.english: For he hath said in his heart: * I shall not be moved from generation to generation, and shall be without evil.

psalm:9(20-39):gloria.latin: Cujus maledictióne os plenum est, et amaritúdine, et dolo: * sub lingua ejus labor et dolor.
psalm:9(20-39):gloria.english: His mouth is full of cursing, and of bitterness, and of deceit: * under his tongue are labour and sorrow.

psalm:9(20-39):gloria.latin: Sedet in insídiis cum divítibus in occúltis: * ut interfíciat innocéntem.
psalm:9(20-39):gloria.english: He sitteth in ambush with the rich, in private places, * that he may kill the innocent.

psalm:9(20-39):gloria.latin: Óculi ejus in páuperem respíciunt: * insidiátur in abscóndito, quasi leo in spelúnca sua.
psalm:9(20-39):gloria.english: His eyes are upon the poor man: * he lieth in wait, in secret, like a lion in his den.

psalm:9(20-39):gloria.latin: Insidiátur ut rápiat páuperem: * rápere páuperem, dum áttrahit eum.
psalm:9(20-39):gloria.english: He lieth in ambush, that he may catch the poor man: * so catch the poor, whilst he draweth him to him.

psalm:9(20-39):gloria.latin: In láqueo suo humiliábit eum: * inclinábit se, et cadet, cum dominátus fúerit páuperum.
psalm:9(20-39):gloria.english: In his net he will bring him down, * he will crouch and fall, when he shall have power over the poor.

psalm:9(20-39):gloria.latin: Dixit enim in corde suo: Oblítus est Deus, * avértit fáciem suam ne vídeat in finem.
psalm:9(20-39):gloria.english: For he hath said in his heart: God hath forgotten, * he hath turned away his face, not to see to the end.

psalm:9(20-39):gloria.latin: Exsúrge, Dómine Deus, exaltétur manus tua: * ne obliviscáris páuperum.
psalm:9(20-39):gloria.english: Arise, O Lord God, let thy hand be exalted: * forget not the poor.

psalm:9(20-39):gloria.latin: Propter quid irritávit ímpius Deum? * dixit enim in corde suo: Non requíret.
psalm:9(20-39):gloria.english: Wherefore hath the wicked provoked God? * for he hath said in his heart: He will not require it.

psalm:9(20-39):gloria.latin: Vides quóniam tu labórem et dolórem consíderas: * ut tradas eos in manus tuas.
psalm:9(20-39):gloria.english: Thou seest it, for thou considerest labour and sorrow: * that thou mayst deliver them into thy hands.

psalm:9(20-39):gloria.latin: Tibi derelíctus est pauper: * órphano tu eris adjútor.
psalm:9(20-39):gloria.english: To thee is the poor man left: * thou wilt be a helper to the orphan.

psalm:9(20-39):gloria.latin: Cóntere brácchium peccatóris et malígni: * quærétur peccátum illíus, et non inveniétur.
psalm:9(20-39):gloria.english: Break thou the arm of the sinner and of the malignant: * his sin shall be sought, and shall not be found.

psalm:9(20-39):gloria.latin: Dóminus regnábit in ætérnum, et in sǽculum sǽculi: * períbitis, gentes, de terra illíus.
psalm:9(20-39):gloria.english: The Lord shall reign to eternity, yea, for ever and ever: * ye Gentiles shall perish from his land.

psalm:9(20-39):gloria.latin: Desidérium páuperum exaudívit Dóminus: * præparatiónem cordis eórum audívit auris tua.
psalm:9(20-39):gloria.english: The Lord hath heard the desire of the poor: * thy ear hath heard the preparation of their heart.

psalm:9(20-39):gloria.latin: Judicáre pupíllo et húmili, * ut non appónat ultra magnificáre se homo super terram.
psalm:9(20-39):gloria.english: To judge for the fatherless and for the humble, * that man may no more presume to magnify himself upon earth.

psalm:9(20-39):gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:9(20-39):gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:9(20-39):gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:9(20-39):gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:10:gloria.latin: In Dómino confído: † quómodo dícitis ánimæ meæ: * Tránsmigra in montem sicut passer?
psalm:10:gloria.english: In the Lord I put my trust: † how then do you say to my soul: * Get thee away from hence to the mountain, like a sparrow?

psalm:10:gloria.latin: Quóniam ecce peccatóres intendérunt arcum, † paravérunt sagíttas suas in pháretra, * ut sagíttent in obscúro rectos corde.
psalm:10:gloria.english: For, lo, the wicked have bent their bow: † they have prepared their arrows in the quiver, * to shoot in the dark the upright of heart.

psalm:10:gloria.latin: Quóniam quæ perfecísti, destruxérunt: * justus autem quid fecit?
psalm:10:gloria.english: For they have destroyed the things which thou hast made: * but what has the just man done?

psalm:10:gloria.latin: Dóminus in templo sancto suo, * Dóminus in cælo sedes ejus.
psalm:10:gloria.english: The Lord is in his holy temple, * the Lord’s throne is in heaven.

psalm:10:gloria.latin: Óculi ejus in páuperem respíciunt: * pálpebræ ejus intérrogant fílios hóminum.
psalm:10:gloria.english: His eyes look on the poor man: * his eyelids examine the sons of men.

psalm:10:gloria.latin: Dóminus intérrogat justum et ímpium: * qui autem díligit iniquitátem, odit ánimam suam.
psalm:10:gloria.english: The Lord trieth the just and the wicked: * but he that loveth iniquity, hateth his own soul.

psalm:10:gloria.latin: Pluet super peccatóres láqueos: * ignis, et sulphur, et spíritus procellárum pars cálicis eórum.
psalm:10:gloria.english: He shall rain snares upon sinners: * fire and brimstone, and storms of winds, shall be the portion of their cup.

psalm:10:gloria.latin: Quóniam justus Dóminus, et justítias diléxit: * æquitátem vidit vultus ejus.
psalm:10:gloria.english: For the Lord is just, and hath loved justice: * his countenance hath beheld righteousness.

psalm:10:gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:10:gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:10:gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:10:gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:11:gloria.latin: Salvum me fac, Dómine, quóniam defécit sanctus: * quóniam diminútæ sunt veritátes a fíliis hóminum.
psalm:11:gloria.english: Save me, O Lord, for there is now no saint: * truths are decayed from among the children of men.

psalm:11:gloria.latin: Vana locúti sunt unusquísque ad próximum suum: * lábia dolósa, in corde et corde locúti sunt.
psalm:11:gloria.english: They have spoken vain things every one to his neighbour: * with deceitful lips, and with a double heart have they spoken.

psalm:11:gloria.latin: Dispérdat Dóminus univérsa lábia dolósa, * et linguam magníloquam.
psalm:11:gloria.english: May the Lord destroy all deceitful lips, * and the tongue that speaketh proud things.

psalm:11:gloria.latin: Qui dixérunt: Linguam nostram magnificábimus, † lábia nostra a nobis sunt, * quis noster Dóminus est?
psalm:11:gloria.english: Who have said: We will magnify our tongue; † our lips are our own; * who is Lord over us?

psalm:11:gloria.latin: Propter misériam ínopum, et gémitum páuperum, * nunc exsúrgam, dicit Dóminus.
psalm:11:gloria.english: By reason of the misery of the needy, and the groans of the poor, * now will I arise, saith the Lord.

psalm:11:gloria.latin: Ponam in salutári: * fiduciáliter agam in eo.
psalm:11:gloria.english: I will set him in safety; * I will deal confidently in his regard.

psalm:11:gloria.latin: Elóquia Dómini, elóquia casta: * argéntum igne examinátum, probátum terræ purgátum séptuplum.
psalm:11:gloria.english: The words of the Lord are pure words: * as silver tried by the fire, purged from the earth, refined seven times.

psalm:11:gloria.latin: Tu, Dómine, servábis nos: et custódies nos * a generatióne hac in ætérnum.
psalm:11:gloria.english: Thou, O Lord, wilt preserve us: and keep us * from this generation for ever.

psalm:11:gloria.latin: In circúitu ímpii ámbulant: * secúndum altitúdinem tuam multiplicásti fílios hóminum.
psalm:11:gloria.english: The wicked walk round about: * according to thy highness, thou hast multiplied the children of men.

psalm:11:gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:11:gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:11:gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:11:gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:134:gloria.english: Psalm 134

psalm:134:gloria.latin: Laudáte nomen Dómini, * laudáte, servi, Dóminum.
psalm:134:gloria.english: Praise ye the name of the Lord: * O you his servants, praise the Lord:

psalm:134:gloria.latin: Qui statis in domo Dómini, * in átriis domus Dei nostri.
psalm:134:gloria.english: You that stand in the house of the Lord, * in the courts of the house of our God.

psalm:134:gloria.latin: Laudáte Dóminum, quia bonus Dóminus: * psállite nómini ejus, quóniam suáve.
psalm:134:gloria.english: Praise ye the Lord, for the Lord is good: * sing ye to his name, for it is sweet.

psalm:134:gloria.latin: Quóniam Jacob elégit sibi Dóminus, * Israël in possessiónem sibi.
psalm:134:gloria.english: For the Lord hath chosen Jacob unto himself: * Israel for his own possession.

psalm:134:gloria.latin: Quia ego cognóvi quod magnus est Dóminus, * et Deus noster præ ómnibus diis.
psalm:134:gloria.english: For I have known that the Lord is great, * and our God is above all gods.

psalm:134:gloria.latin: Ómnia quæcúmque vóluit, Dóminus fecit in cælo, et in terra, * in mari, et in ómnibus abýssis.
psalm:134:gloria.english: Whatsoever the Lord pleased he hath done, in heaven, in earth, * in the sea, and in all the deeps.

psalm:134:gloria.latin: Edúcens nubes ab extrémo terræ: * fúlgura in plúviam fecit.
psalm:134:gloria.english: He bringeth up clouds from the end of the earth: * he hath made lightnings for the rain.

psalm:134:gloria.latin: Qui prodúcit ventos de thesáuris suis: * (8) qui percússit primogénita Ægýpti ab hómine usque ad pecus.
psalm:134:gloria.english: He bringeth forth winds out of his stores: * (8) He slew the firstborn of Egypt from man even unto beast.

psalm:134:gloria.latin: Et misit signa, et prodígia in médio tui, Ægýpte: * in Pharaónem, et in omnes servos ejus.
psalm:134:gloria.english: He sent forth signs and wonders in the midst of thee, O Egypt: * upon Pharao, and upon all his servants.

psalm:134:gloria.latin: Qui percússit gentes multas: * et occídit reges fortes:
psalm:134:gloria.english: He smote many nations, * and slew mighty kings:

psalm:134:gloria.latin: Sehon, regem Amorrhæórum, et Og, regem Basan, * et ómnia regna Chánaan.
psalm:134:gloria.english: Sehon king of the Amorrhites, and Og king of Basan, * and all the kingdoms of Chanaan.

psalm:134:gloria.latin: Et dedit terram eórum hereditátem, * hereditátem Israël, pópulo suo.
psalm:134:gloria.english: And gave their land for an inheritance, * for an inheritance to his people Israel.

psalm:134:gloria.latin: Dómine, nomen tuum in ætérnum: * Dómine, memoriále tuum in generatiónem et generatiónem.
psalm:134:gloria.english: Thy name, O Lord, is for ever: * thy memorial, O Lord, unto all generations.

psalm:134:gloria.latin: Quia judicábit Dóminus pópulum suum: * et in servis suis deprecábitur.
psalm:134:gloria.english: For the Lord will judge his people, * and will be entreated in favour of his servants.

psalm:134:gloria.latin: Simulácra géntium argéntum, et aurum, * ópera mánuum hóminum.
psalm:134:gloria.english: The idols of the Gentiles are silver and gold, * the works of men’s hands.

psalm:134:gloria.latin: Os habent, et non loquéntur: * óculos habent, et non vidébunt.
psalm:134:gloria.english: They have a mouth, but they speak not: * they have eyes, but they see not.

psalm:134:gloria.latin: Aures habent, et non áudient: * neque enim est spíritus in ore ipsórum.
psalm:134:gloria.english: They have ears, but they hear not: * neither is there any breath in their mouths.

psalm:134:gloria.latin: Símiles illis fiant qui fáciunt ea: * et omnes qui confídunt in eis.
psalm:134:gloria.english: Let them that make them be like to them: * and every one that trusteth in them.

psalm:134:gloria.latin: Domus Israël, benedícite Dómino: * domus Aaron, benedícite Dómino.
psalm:134:gloria.english: Bless the Lord, O house of Israel: * bless the Lord, O house of Aaron.

psalm:134:gloria.latin: Domus Levi, benedícite Dómino: * qui timétis Dóminum, benedícite Dómino.
psalm:134:gloria.english: Bless the Lord, O house of Levi: * you that fear the Lord, bless the Lord.

psalm:134:gloria.latin: Benedíctus Dóminus ex Sion, * qui hábitat in Jerúsalem.
psalm:134:gloria.english: Blessed be the Lord out of Sion, * who dwelleth in Jerusalem.

psalm:134:gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:134:gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:134:gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:134:gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:135:gloria.english: Psalm 135

psalm:135:gloria.latin: Confitémini Dómino quóniam bonus: * quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia ejus.
psalm:135:gloria.english: Praise the Lord, for he is good: * for his mercy endureth for ever.

psalm:135:gloria.latin: Confitémini Deo deórum: * quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia ejus.
psalm:135:gloria.english: Praise ye the God of gods: * for his mercy endureth for ever.

psalm:135:gloria.latin: Confitémini Dómino dominórum: * quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia ejus.
psalm:135:gloria.english: Praise ye the Lord of lords: * for his mercy endureth for ever.

psalm:135:gloria.latin: Qui facit mirabília magna solus: * quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia ejus.
psalm:135:gloria.english: Who alone doth great wonders: * for his mercy endureth for ever.

psalm:135:gloria.latin: Qui fecit cælos in intelléctu: * quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia ejus.
psalm:135:gloria.english: Who made the heavens in understanding: * for his mercy endureth for ever.

psalm:135:gloria.latin: Qui firmávit terram super aquas: * quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia ejus.
psalm:135:gloria.english: Who established the earth above the waters: * for his mercy endureth for ever.

psalm:135:gloria.latin: Qui fecit luminária magna: * quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia ejus.
psalm:135:gloria.english: Who made the great lights: * for his mercy endureth for ever.

psalm:135:gloria.latin: Solem in potestátem diéi: * quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia ejus.
psalm:135:gloria.english: The sun to rule the day: * for his mercy endureth for ever.

psalm:135:gloria.latin: Lunam, et stellas in potestátem noctis: * quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia ejus.
psalm:135:gloria.english: The moon and the stars to rule the night: * for his mercy endureth for ever.

psalm:135:gloria.latin: Qui percússit Ægýptum cum primogénitis eórum: * quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia ejus.
psalm:135:gloria.english: Who smote Egypt with their firstborn: * for his mercy endureth for ever.

psalm:135:gloria.latin: Qui edúxit Israël de médio eórum: * quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia ejus.
psalm:135:gloria.english: Who brought out Israel from among them: * for his mercy endureth for ever.

psalm:135:gloria.latin: In manu poténti, et brácchio excélso: * quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia ejus.
psalm:135:gloria.english: With a mighty hand and with a stretched out arm: * for his mercy endureth for ever.

psalm:135:gloria.latin: Qui divísit Mare Rubrum in divisiónes: * quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia ejus.
psalm:135:gloria.english: Who divided the Red sea into parts: * for his mercy endureth for ever.

psalm:135:gloria.latin: Et edúxit Israël per médium ejus: * quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia ejus.
psalm:135:gloria.english: And brought out Israel through the midst thereof: * for his mercy endureth for ever.

psalm:135:gloria.latin: Et excússit Pharaónem, et virtútem ejus in Mari Rubro: * quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia ejus.
psalm:135:gloria.english: And overthrew Pharao and his host in the Red sea: * for his mercy endureth for ever.

psalm:135:gloria.latin: Qui tradúxit pópulum suum per desértum: * quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia ejus.
psalm:135:gloria.english: Who led his people through the desert: * for his mercy endureth for ever.

psalm:135:gloria.latin: Qui percússit reges magnos: * quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia ejus.
psalm:135:gloria.english: Who smote great kings: * for his mercy endureth for ever.

psalm:135:gloria.latin: Et occídit reges fortes: * quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia ejus.
psalm:135:gloria.english: And slew strong kings: * for his mercy endureth for ever.

psalm:135:gloria.latin: Sehon, regem Amorrhæórum: * quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia ejus.
psalm:135:gloria.english: Sehon king of the Amorrhites: * for his mercy endureth for ever.

psalm:135:gloria.latin: Et Og, regem Basan: * quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia ejus.
psalm:135:gloria.english: And Og king of Basan: * for his mercy endureth for ever.

psalm:135:gloria.latin: Et dedit terram eórum hereditátem: * quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia ejus.
psalm:135:gloria.english: And he gave their land for an inheritance: * for his mercy endureth for ever.

psalm:135:gloria.latin: Hereditátem Israël, servo suo: * quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia ejus.
psalm:135:gloria.english: For an inheritance to his servant Israel: * for his mercy endureth for ever.

psalm:135:gloria.latin: Quia in humilitáte nostra memor fuit nostri: * quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia ejus.
psalm:135:gloria.english: For he was mindful of us in our affliction: * for his mercy endureth for ever.

psalm:135:gloria.latin: Et redémit nos ab inimícis nostris: * quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia ejus.
psalm:135:gloria.english: And he redeemed us from our enemies: * for his mercy endureth for ever.

psalm:135:gloria.latin: Qui dat escam omni carni: * quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia ejus.
psalm:135:gloria.english: Who giveth food to all flesh: * for his mercy endureth for ever.

psalm:135:gloria.latin: Confitémini Deo cæli: * quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia ejus.
psalm:135:gloria.english: Give glory to the God of heaven: * for his mercy endureth for ever.

psalm:135:gloria.latin: Confitémini Dómino dominórum: * quóniam in ætérnum misericórdia ejus.
psalm:135:gloria.english: Give glory to the Lord of lords: * for his mercy endureth for ever.

psalm:135:gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:135:gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:135:gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:135:gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:136:gloria.latin: Super flúmina Babylónis, illic sédimus et flévimus: * cum recordarémur Sion:
psalm:136:gloria.english: Upon the rivers of Babylon, there we sat and wept: * when we remembered Sion:

psalm:136:gloria.latin: In salícibus in médio ejus, * suspéndimus órgana nostra.
psalm:136:gloria.english: On the willows in the midst thereof * we hung up our instruments.

psalm:136:gloria.latin: Quia illic interrogavérunt nos, qui captívos duxérunt nos, * verba cantiónum:
psalm:136:gloria.english: For there they that led us into captivity required of us * the words of songs.

psalm:136:gloria.latin: Et qui abduxérunt nos: * Hymnum cantáte nobis de cánticis Sion.
psalm:136:gloria.english: And they that carried us away, said: * Sing ye to us a hymn of the songs of Sion.

psalm:136:gloria.latin: Quómodo cantábimus cánticum Dómini * in terra aliéna?
psalm:136:gloria.english: How shall we sing the song of the Lord * in a strange land?

psalm:136:gloria.latin: Si oblítus fúero tui, Jerúsalem, * oblivióni detur déxtera mea.
psalm:136:gloria.english: If I forget thee, O Jerusalem, * let my right hand be forgotten.

psalm:136:gloria.latin: Adhǽreat lingua mea fáucibus meis, * si non memínero tui:
psalm:136:gloria.english: Let my tongue cleave to my jaws, * if I do not remember thee:

psalm:136:gloria.latin: Si non proposúero Jerúsalem, * in princípio lætítiæ meæ.
psalm:136:gloria.english: If I make not Jerusalem * the beginning of my joy.

psalm:136:gloria.latin: Memor esto, Dómine, filiórum Edom, * in die Jerúsalem:
psalm:136:gloria.english: Remember, O Lord, the children of Edom, * in the day of Jerusalem:

psalm:136:gloria.latin: Qui dicunt: Exinaníte, exinaníte * usque ad fundaméntum in ea.
psalm:136:gloria.english: Who say: Rase it, rase it, * even to the foundation thereof.

psalm:136:gloria.latin: Fília Babylónis mísera: * beátus, qui retríbuet tibi retributiónem tuam, quam retribuísti nobis.
psalm:136:gloria.english: O daughter of Babylon, miserable: * blessed shall he be who shall repay thee thy payment which thou hast paid us.

psalm:136:gloria.latin: Beátus, qui tenébit, * et allídet párvulos tuos ad petram.
psalm:136:gloria.english: Blessed be he that shall take * and dash thy little ones against the rock.

psalm:136:gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:136:gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:136:gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:136:gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:137:gloria.latin: Confitébor tibi, Dómine, in toto corde meo: * quóniam audísti verba oris mei.
psalm:137:gloria.english: I will praise thee, O Lord, with my whole heart: * for thou hast heard the words of my mouth.

psalm:137:gloria.latin: In conspéctu Angelórum psallam tibi: * (2a) adorábo ad templum sanctum tuum, et confitébor nómini tuo.
psalm:137:gloria.english: I will sing praise to thee in the sight of the Angels: * I will worship towards thy holy temple, and I will give glory to thy name.

psalm:137:gloria.latin: Super misericórdia tua, et veritáte tua: * quóniam magnificásti super omne, nomen sanctum tuum.
psalm:137:gloria.english: For thy mercy, and for thy truth: * for thou hast magnified thy holy name.

psalm:137:gloria.latin: In quacúmque die invocávero te, exáudi me: * multiplicábis in ánima mea virtútem.
psalm:137:gloria.english: In what day soever I shall call upon thee, hear me: * thou shalt multiply strength in my soul.

psalm:137:gloria.latin: Confiteántur tibi, Dómine, omnes reges terræ: * quia audiérunt ómnia verba oris tui:
psalm:137:gloria.english: May all the kings of the earth give glory to thee: * for they have heard all the words of thy mouth.

psalm:137:gloria.latin: Et cantent in viis Dómini: * quóniam magna est glória Dómini.
psalm:137:gloria.english: And let them sing in the ways of the Lord: * for great is the glory of the Lord.

psalm:137:gloria.latin: Quóniam excélsus Dóminus, et humília réspicit: * et alta a longe cognóscit.
psalm:137:gloria.english: For the Lord is high, and looketh on the low: * and the high he knoweth afar off.

psalm:137:gloria.latin: Si ambulávero in médio tribulatiónis, vivificábis me: ‡ et super iram inimicórum meórum extendísti manum tuam, * et salvum me fecit déxtera tua.
psalm:137:gloria.english: If I shall walk in the midst of tribulation, thou wilt quicken me: ‡ and thou hast stretched forth thy hand against the wrath of my enemies: * and thy right hand hath saved me.

psalm:137:gloria.latin: Dóminus retríbuet pro me: ‡ Dómine, misericórdia tua in sǽculum: * ópera mánuum tuárum ne despícias.
psalm:137:gloria.english: The Lord will repay for me: ‡ thy mercy, O Lord, endureth for ever: * O despise not the works of thy hands.

psalm:137:gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:137:gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:137:gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:137:gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:87:gloria.english: Psalm 87

psalm:87:gloria.latin: Dómine, Deus salútis meæ: * in die clamávi, et nocte coram te.
psalm:87:gloria.english: Lord, the God of my salvation: * I have cried in the day, and in the night before thee.

psalm:87:gloria.latin: Intret in conspéctu tuo orátio mea: * inclína aurem tuam ad precem meam:
psalm:87:gloria.english: Let my prayer come in before thee: * incline thy ear to my petition.

psalm:87:gloria.latin: Quia repléta est malis ánima mea: * et vita mea inférno appropinquávit.
psalm:87:gloria.english: For my soul is filled with evils: * and my life hath drawn nigh to hell.

psalm:87:gloria.latin: Æstimátus sum cum descendéntibus in lacum: * factus sum sicut homo sine adjutório, inter mórtuos liber.
psalm:87:gloria.english: I am counted among them that go down to the pit: * I am become as a man without help, free among the dead.

psalm:87:gloria.latin: Sicut vulneráti dormiéntes in sepúlcris, quorum non es memor ámplius: * et ipsi de manu tua repúlsi sunt.
psalm:87:gloria.english: Like the slain sleeping in the sepulchres, whom thou rememberest no more: * and they are cast off from thy hand.

psalm:87:gloria.latin: Posuérunt me in lacu inferióri: * in tenebrósis, et in umbra mortis.
psalm:87:gloria.english: They have laid me in the lower pit: * in the dark places, and in the shadow of death.

psalm:87:gloria.latin: Super me confirmátus est furor tuus: * et omnes fluctus tuos induxísti super me.
psalm:87:gloria.english: Thy wrath is strong over me: * and all thy waves thou hast brought in upon me.

psalm:87:gloria.latin: Longe fecísti notos meos a me: * posuérunt me abominatiónem sibi.
psalm:87:gloria.english: Thou hast put away my acquaintance far from me: * they have set me an abomination to themselves.

psalm:87:gloria.latin: Tráditus sum, et non egrediébar: * óculi mei languérunt præ inópia.
psalm:87:gloria.english: I was delivered up, and came not forth: * my eyes languished through poverty.

psalm:87:gloria.latin: Clamávi ad te, Dómine, tota die: * expándi ad te manus meas.
psalm:87:gloria.english: All the day I cried to thee, O Lord: * I stretched out my hands to thee.

psalm:87:gloria.latin: Numquid mórtuis fácies mirabília: * aut médici suscitábunt, et confitebúntur tibi?
psalm:87:gloria.english: Wilt thou shew wonders to the dead? * or shall physicians raise to life, and give praise to thee?

psalm:87:gloria.latin: Numquid narrábit áliquis in sepúlcro misericórdiam tuam, * et veritátem tuam in perditióne?
psalm:87:gloria.english: Shall any one in the sepulchre declare thy mercy: * and thy truth in destruction?

psalm:87:gloria.latin: Numquid cognoscéntur in ténebris mirabília tua, * et justítia tua in terra obliviónis?
psalm:87:gloria.english: Shall thy wonders be known in the dark; * and thy justice in the land of forgetfulness?

psalm:87:gloria.latin: Et ego ad te, Dómine, clamávi: * et mane orátio mea prævéniet te.
psalm:87:gloria.english: But I, O Lord, have cried to thee: * and in the morning my prayer shall prevent thee.

psalm:87:gloria.latin: Ut quid, Dómine, repéllis oratiónem meam: * avértis fáciem tuam a me?
psalm:87:gloria.english: Lord, why castest thou off my prayer: * why turnest thou away thy face from me?

psalm:87:gloria.latin: Pauper sum ego, et in labóribus a juventúte mea: * exaltátus autem, humiliátus sum et conturbátus.
psalm:87:gloria.english: I am poor, and in labours from my youth: * and being exalted have been humbled and troubled.

psalm:87:gloria.latin: In me transiérunt iræ tuæ: * et terróres tui conturbavérunt me.
psalm:87:gloria.english: Thy wrath hath come upon me: * and thy terrors have troubled me.

psalm:87:gloria.latin: Circumdedérunt me sicut aqua tota die: * circumdedérunt me simul.
psalm:87:gloria.english: They have come round about me like water all the day: * they have compassed me about together.

psalm:87:gloria.latin: Elongásti a me amícum et próximum: * et notos meos a miséria.
psalm:87:gloria.english: Friend and neighbour thou hast put far from me: * and my acquaintance, because of misery.

psalm:87:gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:87:gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:87:gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:87:gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:89:gloria.english: Psalm 89

psalm:89:gloria.latin: Dómine, refúgium factus es nobis: * a generatióne in generatiónem.
psalm:89:gloria.english: Lord, thou hast been our refuge * from generation to generation.

psalm:89:gloria.latin: Priúsquam montes fíerent, aut formarétur terra et orbis: * a sǽculo et usque in sǽculum tu es, Deus.
psalm:89:gloria.english: Before the mountains were made, or the earth and the world was formed; * from eternity and to eternity thou art God.

psalm:89:gloria.latin: Ne avértas hóminem in humilitátem: * et dixísti: Convertímini, fílii hóminum.
psalm:89:gloria.english: Turn not man away to be brought low: * and thou hast said: Be converted, O ye sons of men.

psalm:89:gloria.latin: Quóniam mille anni ante óculos tuos, * tamquam dies hestérna, quæ prætériit,
psalm:89:gloria.english: For a thousand years in thy sight * are as yesterday, which is past.

psalm:89:gloria.latin: Et custódia in nocte, * quæ pro níhilo habéntur, eórum anni erunt.
psalm:89:gloria.english: And as a watch in the night, * things that are counted nothing, shall their years be.

psalm:89:gloria.latin: Mane sicut herba tránseat, mane flóreat, et tránseat: * véspere décidat, indúret et aréscat.
psalm:89:gloria.english: In the morning man shall grow up like grass; in the morning he shall flourish and pass away: * in the evening he shall fall, grow dry, and wither.

psalm:89:gloria.latin: Quia defécimus in ira tua, * et in furóre tuo turbáti sumus.
psalm:89:gloria.english: For in thy wrath we have fainted away: * and are troubled in thy indignation.

psalm:89:gloria.latin: Posuísti iniquitátes nostras in conspéctu tuo: * sǽculum nostrum in illuminatióne vultus tui.
psalm:89:gloria.english: Thou hast set our iniquities before thy eyes: * our life in the light of thy countenance.

psalm:89:gloria.latin: Quóniam omnes dies nostri defecérunt: * et in ira tua defécimus.
psalm:89:gloria.english: For all our days are spent; * and in thy wrath we have fainted away.

psalm:89:gloria.latin: Anni nostri sicut aránea meditabúntur: * dies annórum nostrórum in ipsis, septuagínta anni.
psalm:89:gloria.english: Our years shall be considered as a spider: * the days of our years in them are threescore and ten years.

psalm:89:gloria.latin: Si autem in potentátibus, octogínta anni: * et ámplius eórum, labor et dolor.
psalm:89:gloria.english: But if in the strong they be fourscore years: * and what is more of them is labour and sorrow.

psalm:89:gloria.latin: Quóniam supervénit mansuetúdo: * et corripiémur.
psalm:89:gloria.english: For mildness is come upon us: * and we shall be corrected.

psalm:89:gloria.latin: Quis novit potestátem iræ tuæ: * et præ timóre tuo iram tuam dinumeráre?
psalm:89:gloria.english: Who knoweth the power of thy anger, * and for thy fear can number thy wrath?

psalm:89:gloria.latin: Déxteram tuam sic notam fac: * et erudítos corde in sapiéntia.
psalm:89:gloria.english: So make thy right hand known: * and men learned in heart, in wisdom.

psalm:89:gloria.latin: Convértere, Dómine, úsquequo? * et deprecábilis esto super servos tuos.
psalm:89:gloria.english: Return, O Lord, how long? * and be entreated in favour of thy servants.

psalm:89:gloria.latin: Repléti sumus mane misericórdia tua: * et exsultávimus, et delectáti sumus ómnibus diébus nostris.
psalm:89:gloria.english: We are filled in the morning with thy mercy: * and we have rejoiced, and are delighted all our days.

psalm:89:gloria.latin: Lætáti sumus pro diébus, quibus nos humiliásti: * annis, quibus vídimus mala.
psalm:89:gloria.english: We have rejoiced for the days in which thou hast humbled us: * for the years in which we have seen evils.

psalm:89:gloria.latin: Réspice in servos tuos, et in ópera tua: * et dírige fílios eórum.
psalm:89:gloria.english: Look upon thy servants and upon their works: * and direct their children.

psalm:89:gloria.latin: Et sit splendor Dómini, Dei nostri, super nos, et ópera mánuum nostrárum dírige super nos: * et opus mánuum nostrárum dírige.
psalm:89:gloria.english: And let the brightness of the Lord our God be upon us: and direct thou the works of our hands over us; * yea, the work of our hands do thou direct.

psalm:89:gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:89:gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:89:gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:89:gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:224:gloria.english: Canticle 224

psalm:224:gloria.latin: Cantémus Dómino: glorióse enim magnificátus est, * equum et ascensórem dejécit in mare.
psalm:224:gloria.english: Let us sing to the Lord: for he is gloriously magnified, * the horse and the rider he hath thrown into the sea.

psalm:224:gloria.latin: Fortitúdo mea, et laus mea Dóminus, * et factus est mihi in salútem.
psalm:224:gloria.english: The Lord is my strength and my praise, * and he is become salvation to me:

psalm:224:gloria.latin: Iste Deus meus, et glorificábo eum: * Deus patris mei, et exaltábo eum.
psalm:224:gloria.english: He is my God and I will glorify him: * the God of my father, and I will exalt him.

psalm:224:gloria.latin: Dóminus quasi vir pugnátor, Omnípotens nomen ejus. * Currus Pharaónis et exércitum ejus projécit in mare.
psalm:224:gloria.english: The Lord is as a man of war, Almighty is his name. * Pharao’s chariots and his army he hath cast into the sea:

psalm:224:gloria.latin: Elécti príncipes ejus submérsi sunt in Mari Rubro: * abýssi operuérunt eos, descendérunt in profúndum quasi lapis.
psalm:224:gloria.english: His chosen captains are drowned in the Red Sea. * The depths have covered them, they are sunk to the bottom like a stone.

psalm:224:gloria.latin: Déxtera tua, Dómine, magnificáta est in fortitúdine: déxtera tua, Dómine, percússit inimícum. * Et in multitúdine glóriæ tuæ deposuísti adversários tuos:
psalm:224:gloria.english: Thy right hand, O Lord, is magnified in strength: thy right hand, O Lord, hath slain the enemy. * And in the multitude of thy glory thou hast put down thy adversaries:

psalm:224:gloria.latin: Misísti iram tuam, quæ devorávit eos sicut stípulam. * Et in spíritu furóris tui congregátæ sunt aquæ:
psalm:224:gloria.english: Thou hast sent thy wrath, which hath devoured them like stubble. * And with the blast of thy anger the waters were gathered together:

psalm:224:gloria.latin: Stetit unda fluens, * congregátæ sunt abýssi in médio mari.
psalm:224:gloria.english: The flowing water stood, * the depths were gathered together in the midst of the sea.

psalm:224:gloria.latin: Dixit inimícus: Pérsequar et comprehéndam, * dívidam spólia, implébitur ánima mea:
psalm:224:gloria.english: The enemy said: I will pursue and overtake, * I will divide the spoils, my soul shall have its fill:

psalm:224:gloria.latin: Evaginábo gládium meum, * interfíciet eos manus mea.
psalm:224:gloria.english: I will draw my sword, * my hand shall slay them.

psalm:224:gloria.latin: Flavit spíritus tuus, et opéruit eos mare: * submérsi sunt quasi plumbum in aquis veheméntibus.
psalm:224:gloria.english: Thy wind blew and the sea covered them: * they sunk as lead in the mighty waters.

psalm:224:gloria.latin: Quis símilis tui in fórtibus, Dómine? * quis símilis tui, magníficus in sanctitáte, terríbilis atque laudábilis, fáciens mirabília?
psalm:224:gloria.english: Who is like to thee, among the strong, O Lord? * who is like to thee, glorious in holiness, terrible and praiseworthy, doing wonders?

psalm:224:gloria.latin: Extendísti manum tuam, et devorávit eos terra. * Dux fuísti in misericórdia tua pópulo quem redemísti:
psalm:224:gloria.english: Thou stretchedst forth thy hand, and the earth swallowed them. * In thy mercy thou hast been a leader to the people which thou hast redeemed:

psalm:224:gloria.latin: Et portásti eum in fortitúdine tua, * ad habitáculum sanctum tuum.
psalm:224:gloria.english: And in thy strength thou hast carried them * to thy holy habitation.

psalm:224:gloria.latin: Ascendérunt pópuli, et iráti sunt: * dolóres obtinuérunt habitatóres Philísthiim.
psalm:224:gloria.english: Nations rose up, and were angry: * sorrows took hold on the inhabitants of Philisthiim.

psalm:224:gloria.latin: Tunc conturbáti sunt príncipes Edom, robústos Moab obtínuit tremor: * obriguérunt omnes habitatóres Chánaan.
psalm:224:gloria.english: Then were the princes of Edom troubled, trembling seized on the stout men of Moab: * all the inhabitants of Chanaan became stiff.

psalm:224:gloria.latin: Írruat super eos formído et pavor, * in magnitúdine brácchii tui:
psalm:224:gloria.english: Let fear and dread fall upon them, * in the greatness of thy arm:

psalm:224:gloria.latin: Fiant immóbiles quasi lapis, donec pertránseat pópulus tuus, Dómine, * donec pertránseat pópulus tuus iste, quem possedísti.
psalm:224:gloria.english: Let them become unmoveable as a stone, until thy people, O Lord, pass by: * until this thy people pass by, which thou hast possessed.

psalm:224:gloria.latin: Introdúces eos, et plantábis in monte hereditátis tuæ, * firmíssimo habitáculo tuo quod operátus es, Dómine:
psalm:224:gloria.english: Thou shalt bring them in, and plant them in the mountain of thy inheritance, * in thy most firm habitation which thou hast made, O Lord;

psalm:224:gloria.latin: Sanctuárium tuum, Dómine, quod firmavérunt manus tuæ. * Dóminus regnábit in ætérnum et ultra.
psalm:224:gloria.english: Thy sanctuary, O Lord, which thy hands have established. * The Lord shall reign for ever and ever.

psalm:224:gloria.latin: Ingréssus est enim eques Phárao cum cúrribus et equítibus ejus in mare: * et redúxit super eos Dóminus aquas maris:
psalm:224:gloria.english: For Pharao went in on horseback with his chariots and horsemen into the sea: * and the Lord brought back upon them the waters of the sea:

psalm:224:gloria.latin: Fílii autem Israël ambulavérunt per siccum * in médio ejus.
psalm:224:gloria.english: But the children of Israel walked on dry ground * in the midst thereof.

psalm:224:gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:224:gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:224:gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:224:gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:12:gloria.latin: Úsquequo, Dómine, obliviscéris me in finem? * Úsquequo avértis fáciem tuam a me?
psalm:12:gloria.english: How long, O Lord, wilt thou forget me unto the end? * how long dost thou turn away thy face from me?

psalm:12:gloria.latin: Quámdiu ponam consília in ánima mea, * dolórem in corde meo per diem?
psalm:12:gloria.english: How long shall I take counsels in my soul, * sorrow in my heart all the day?

psalm:12:gloria.latin: Úsquequo exaltábitur inimícus meus super me? * (4a) réspice, et exáudi me, Dómine, Deus meus.
psalm:12:gloria.english: How long shall my enemy be exalted over me? * (4a) Consider, and hear me, O Lord my God.

psalm:12:gloria.latin: Illúmina óculos meos ne umquam obdórmiam in morte: * (5a) nequándo dicat inimícus meus: Præválui advérsus eum.
psalm:12:gloria.english: Enlighten my eyes that I never sleep in death: * (5a) lest at any time my enemy say: I have prevailed against him.

psalm:12:gloria.latin: Qui tríbulant me, exsultábunt si motus fúero: * (6a) ego autem in misericórdia tua sperávi.
psalm:12:gloria.english: They that trouble me will rejoice when I am moved: * (6a) but I have trusted in thy mercy.

psalm:12:gloria.latin: Exsultábit cor meum in salutári tuo: † cantábo Dómino qui bona tríbuit mihi: * et psallam nómini Dómini altíssimi.
psalm:12:gloria.english: My heart shall rejoice in thy salvation: † I will sing to the Lord, who giveth me good things: * yea, I will sing to the name of the Lord the most High.

psalm:12:gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:12:gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:12:gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
