psalm:12:gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:13:gloria.latin: Dixit insípiens in corde suo: * non est Deus.
psalm:13:gloria.english: The fool hath said in his heart: * there is no God.

psalm:13:gloria.latin: Corrúpti sunt, et abominábiles facti sunt in stúdiis suis: * non est qui fáciat bonum, non est usque ad unum.
psalm:13:gloria.english: They are corrupt, and are become abominable in their ways: * there is none that doth good, no not one.

psalm:13:gloria.latin: Dóminus de cælo prospéxit super fílios hóminum, * ut vídeat si est intéllegens, aut requírens Deum.
psalm:13:gloria.english: The Lord hath looked down from heaven upon the children of men, * to see if there be any that understand and seek God.

psalm:13:gloria.latin: Omnes declinavérunt, simul inútiles facti sunt: * non est qui fáciat bonum, non est usque ad unum.
psalm:13:gloria.english: They are all gone aside, they are become unprofitable together: * there is none that doth good: no not one.

psalm:13:gloria.latin: Sepúlcrum patens est guttur eórum: † linguis suis dolóse agébant * venénum áspidum sub lábiis eórum.
psalm:13:gloria.english: Their throat is an open sepulchre; † with their tongues they acted deceitfully: * the poison of asps is under their lips.

psalm:13:gloria.latin: Quorum os maledictióne et amaritúdine plenum est: * velóces pedes eórum ad effundéndum sánguinem.
psalm:13:gloria.english: Their mouth is full of cursing and bitterness; * their feet are swift to shed blood.

psalm:13:gloria.latin: Contrítio et infelícitas in viis eórum, † et viam pacis non cognovérunt: * non est timor Dei ante óculos eórum.
psalm:13:gloria.english: Destruction and unhappiness in their ways; † and the way of peace they have not known: * there is no fear of God before their eyes.

psalm:13:gloria.latin: Nonne cognóscent omnes qui operántur iniquitátem, * qui dévorant plebem meam sicut escam panis?
psalm:13:gloria.english: Shall not all they know that work iniquity, * who devour my people as they eat bread?

psalm:13:gloria.latin: Dóminum non invocavérunt, * illic trepidavérunt timóre, ubi non erat timor.
psalm:13:gloria.english: They have not called upon the Lord: * there have they trembled for fear, where there was no fear.

psalm:13:gloria.latin: Quóniam Dóminus in generatióne justa est, † consílium ínopis confudístis: * quóniam Dóminus spes ejus est.
psalm:13:gloria.english: For the Lord is in the just generation: † you have confounded the counsel of the poor man; * but the Lord is his hope.

psalm:13:gloria.latin: Quis dabit ex Sion salutáre Israël? * cum avérterit Dóminus captivitátem plebis suæ, exsultábit Jacob, et lætábitur Israël.
psalm:13:gloria.english: Who shall give out of Sion the salvation of Israel? * when the Lord shall have turned away the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.

psalm:13:gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:13:gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:13:gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:13:gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:14:gloria.latin: Dómine, quis habitábit in tabernáculo tuo? * aut quis requiéscet in monte sancto tuo?
psalm:14:gloria.english: Lord, who shall dwell in thy tabernacle? * or who shall rest in thy holy hill?

psalm:14:gloria.latin: Qui ingréditur sine mácula, * et operátur justítiam:
psalm:14:gloria.english: He that walketh without blemish, * and worketh justice:

psalm:14:gloria.latin: Qui lóquitur veritátem in corde suo, * qui non egit dolum in lingua sua:
psalm:14:gloria.english: He that speaketh truth in his heart, * who hath not used deceit in his tongue:

psalm:14:gloria.latin: Nec fecit próximo suo malum, * et oppróbrium non accépit advérsus próximos suos.
psalm:14:gloria.english: Nor hath done evil to his neighbour: * nor taken up a reproach against his neighbours.

psalm:14:gloria.latin: Ad níhilum dedúctus est in conspéctu ejus malígnus: * timéntes autem Dóminum gloríficat:
psalm:14:gloria.english: In his sight the malignant is brought to nothing: * but he glorifieth them that fear the Lord:

psalm:14:gloria.latin: Qui jurat próximo suo, et non décipit, * (5a) qui pecúniam suam non dedit ad usúram, et múnera super innocéntem non accépit.
psalm:14:gloria.english: He that sweareth to his neighbour, and deceiveth not; * (5a) He that hath not put out his money to usury, nor taken bribes against the innocent:

psalm:14:gloria.latin: Qui facit hæc: * non movébitur in ætérnum.
psalm:14:gloria.english: He that doth these things, * shall not be moved for ever.

psalm:14:gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:14:gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:14:gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:14:gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:138(1-10):gloria.latin: Dómine, probásti me, et cognovísti me: * (2) tu cognovísti sessiónem meam, et resurrectiónem meam.
psalm:138(1-10):gloria.english: Lord, thou hast proved me, and known me: * (2) thou hast known my sitting down, and my rising up.

psalm:138(1-10):gloria.latin: Intellexísti cogitatiónes meas de longe: * sémitam meam, et funículum meum investigásti.
psalm:138(1-10):gloria.english: Thou hast understood my thoughts afar off: * my path and my life thou hast searched out.

psalm:138(1-10):gloria.latin: Et omnes vias meas prævidísti: * quia non est sermo in lingua mea.
psalm:138(1-10):gloria.english: And thou hast foreseen all my ways: * for there is no speech on my tongue.

psalm:138(1-10):gloria.latin: Ecce, Dómine, tu cognovísti ómnia novíssima, et antíqua: * tu formásti me, et posuísti super me manum tuam.
psalm:138(1-10):gloria.english: Behold, O Lord, thou hast known all things, the last and those of old: * thou hast formed me, and hast laid thy hand upon me.

psalm:138(1-10):gloria.latin: Mirábilis facta est sciéntia tua ex me: * confortáta est, et non pótero ad eam.
psalm:138(1-10):gloria.english: Thy knowledge is become wonderful to me: * it is high, and I cannot reach to it.

psalm:138(1-10):gloria.latin: Quo ibo a spíritu tuo? * et quo a fácie tua fúgiam?
psalm:138(1-10):gloria.english: Whither shall I go from thy spirit? * or whither shall I flee from thy face?

psalm:138(1-10):gloria.latin: Si ascéndero in cælum, tu illic es: * si descéndero in inférnum, ades.
psalm:138(1-10):gloria.english: If I ascend into heaven, thou art there: * if I descend into hell, thou art present.

psalm:138(1-10):gloria.latin: Si súmpsero pennas meas dilúculo, * et habitávero in extrémis maris:
psalm:138(1-10):gloria.english: If I take my wings early in the morning, * and dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea:

psalm:138(1-10):gloria.latin: Étenim illuc manus tua dedúcet me: * et tenébit me déxtera tua.
psalm:138(1-10):gloria.english: Even there also shall thy hand lead me: * and thy right hand shall hold me.

psalm:138(1-10):gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:138(1-10):gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:138(1-10):gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:138(1-10):gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:138(11-24):gloria.latin: Et dixi: Fórsitan ténebræ conculcábunt me: * et nox illuminátio mea in delíciis meis.
psalm:138(11-24):gloria.english: And I said: Perhaps darkness shall cover me: * and night shall be my light in my pleasures.

psalm:138(11-24):gloria.latin: Quia ténebræ non obscurabúntur a te, † et nox sicut dies illuminábitur: * sicut ténebræ ejus, ita et lumen ejus.
psalm:138(11-24):gloria.english: But darkness shall not be dark to thee, † and night shall be light as the day: * the darkness thereof, and the light thereof are alike to thee.

psalm:138(11-24):gloria.latin: Quia tu possedísti renes meos: * suscepísti me de útero matris meæ.
psalm:138(11-24):gloria.english: For thou hast possessed my reins: * thou hast protected me from my mother’s womb.

psalm:138(11-24):gloria.latin: Confitébor tibi quia terribíliter magnificátus es: ‡ mirabília ópera tua, * et ánima mea cognóscit nimis.
psalm:138(11-24):gloria.english: I will praise thee, for thou art fearfully magnified: ‡ wonderful are thy works, * and my soul knoweth right well.

psalm:138(11-24):gloria.latin: Non est occultátum os meum a te, quod fecísti in occúlto: * et substántia mea in inferióribus terræ.
psalm:138(11-24):gloria.english: My bone is not hidden from thee, which thou hast made in secret: * and my substance in the lower parts of the earth.

psalm:138(11-24):gloria.latin: Imperféctum meum vidérunt óculi tui, † et in libro tuo omnes scribéntur: * dies formabúntur, et nemo in eis.
psalm:138(11-24):gloria.english: Thy eyes did see my imperfect being, † and in thy book all shall be written: * days shall be formed, and no one in them.

psalm:138(11-24):gloria.latin: Mihi autem nimis honorificáti sunt amíci tui, Deus: * nimis confortátus est principátus eórum.
psalm:138(11-24):gloria.english: But to me thy friends, O God, are made exceedingly honourable: * their principality is exceedingly strengthened.

psalm:138(11-24):gloria.latin: Dinumerábo eos, et super arénam multiplicabúntur: * exsurréxi, et adhuc sum tecum.
psalm:138(11-24):gloria.english: I will number them, and they shall be multiplied above the sand: * I rose up and am still with thee.

psalm:138(11-24):gloria.latin: Si occíderis, Deus, peccatóres: * viri sánguinum, declináte a me:
psalm:138(11-24):gloria.english: If thou wilt kill the wicked, O God: * ye men of blood, depart from me:

psalm:138(11-24):gloria.latin: Quia dícitis in cogitatióne: * Accípient in vanitáte civitátes tuas.
psalm:138(11-24):gloria.english: Because you say in thought: * They shall receive thy cities in vain.

psalm:138(11-24):gloria.latin: Nonne qui odérunt te, Dómine, óderam? * et super inimícos tuos tabescébam?
psalm:138(11-24):gloria.english: Have I not hated them, O Lord, that hated thee: * and pined away because of thy enemies?

psalm:138(11-24):gloria.latin: Perfécto ódio óderam illos: * et inimíci facti sunt mihi.
psalm:138(11-24):gloria.english: I have hated them with a perfect hatred: * and they are become enemies to me.

psalm:138(11-24):gloria.latin: Proba me, Deus, et scito cor meum: * intérroga me, et cognósce sémitas meas.
psalm:138(11-24):gloria.english: Prove me, O God, and know my heart: * examine me, and know my paths.

psalm:138(11-24):gloria.latin: Et vide, si via iniquitátis in me est: * et deduc me in via ætérna.
psalm:138(11-24):gloria.english: And see if there be in me the way of iniquity: * and lead me in the eternal way.

psalm:138(11-24):gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:138(11-24):gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:138(11-24):gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:138(11-24):gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:139:gloria.latin: Éripe me, Dómine, ab hómine malo: * a viro iníquo éripe me.
psalm:139:gloria.english: Deliver me, O Lord, from the evil man: * rescue me from the unjust man.

psalm:139:gloria.latin: Qui cogitavérunt iniquitátes in corde: * tota die constituébant prǽlia.
psalm:139:gloria.english: Who have devised iniquities in their hearts: * all the day long they designed battles.

psalm:139:gloria.latin: Acuérunt linguas suas sicut serpéntis: * venénum áspidum sub lábiis eórum.
psalm:139:gloria.english: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent: * the venom of asps is under their lips.

psalm:139:gloria.latin: Custódi me, Dómine, de manu peccatóris: * et ab homínibus iníquis éripe me.
psalm:139:gloria.english: Keep me, O Lord, from the hand of the wicked: * and from unjust men deliver me.

psalm:139:gloria.latin: Qui cogitavérunt supplantáre gressus meos: * abscondérunt supérbi láqueum mihi:
psalm:139:gloria.english: Who have proposed to supplant my steps: * the proud have hidden a net for me.

psalm:139:gloria.latin: Et funes extendérunt in láqueum: * juxta iter scándalum posuérunt mihi.
psalm:139:gloria.english: And they have stretched out cords for a snare: * they have laid for me a stumbling block by the wayside.

psalm:139:gloria.latin: Dixi Dómino: Deus meus es tu: * exáudi, Dómine, vocem deprecatiónis meæ.
psalm:139:gloria.english: I said to the Lord: Thou art my God: * hear, O Lord, the voice of my supplication.

psalm:139:gloria.latin: Dómine, Dómine, virtus salútis meæ: * obumbrásti super caput meum in die belli.
psalm:139:gloria.english: O Lord, Lord, the strength of my salvation: * thou hast overshadowed my head in the day of battle.

psalm:139:gloria.latin: Ne tradas me, Dómine, a desidério meo peccatóri: * cogitavérunt contra me, ne derelínquas me, ne forte exalténtur.
psalm:139:gloria.english: Give me not up, O Lord, from my desire to the wicked: * they have plotted against me; do not thou forsake me, lest they should triumph.

psalm:139:gloria.latin: Caput circúitus eórum: * labor labiórum ipsórum opériet eos.
psalm:139:gloria.english: The head of them compassing me about: * the labour of their lips shall overwhelm them.

psalm:139:gloria.latin: Cadent super eos carbónes, in ignem deícies eos: * in misériis non subsístent.
psalm:139:gloria.english: Burning coals shall fall upon them; thou wilt cast them down into the fire: * in miseries they shall not be able to stand.

psalm:139:gloria.latin: Vir linguósus non dirigétur in terra: * virum injústum mala cápient in intéritu.
psalm:139:gloria.english: A man full of tongue shall not be established in the earth: * evil shall catch the unjust man unto destruction.

psalm:139:gloria.latin: Cognóvi quia fáciet Dóminus judícium ínopis: * et vindíctam páuperum.
psalm:139:gloria.english: I know that the Lord will do justice to the needy, * and will revenge the poor.

psalm:139:gloria.latin: Verúmtamen justi confitebúntur nómini tuo: * et habitábunt recti cum vultu tuo.
psalm:139:gloria.english: But as for the just, they shall give glory to thy name: * and the upright shall dwell with thy countenance.

psalm:139:gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:139:gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:139:gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:139:gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:140:gloria.latin: Dómine, clamávi ad te, exáudi me: * inténde voci meæ, cum clamávero ad te.
psalm:140:gloria.english: I have cried to thee, O Lord, hear me: * hearken to my voice, when I cry to thee.

psalm:140:gloria.latin: Dirigátur orátio mea sicut incénsum in conspéctu tuo: * elevátio mánuum meárum sacrifícium vespertínum.
psalm:140:gloria.english: Let my prayer be directed as incense in thy sight; * the lifting up of my hands, as evening sacrifice.

psalm:140:gloria.latin: Pone, Dómine, custódiam ori meo: * et óstium circumstántiæ lábiis meis.
psalm:140:gloria.english: Set a watch, O Lord, before my mouth: * and a door round about my lips.

psalm:140:gloria.latin: Non declínes cor meum in verba malítiæ, * ad excusándas excusatiónes in peccátis.
psalm:140:gloria.english: Incline not my heart to evil words; * to make excuses in sins.

psalm:140:gloria.latin: Cum homínibus operántibus iniquitátem: * et non communicábo cum eléctis eórum.
psalm:140:gloria.english: With men that work iniquity: * and I will not communicate with the choicest of them.

psalm:140:gloria.latin: Corrípiet me justus in misericórdia, et increpábit me: * óleum autem peccatóris non impínguet caput meum.
psalm:140:gloria.english: The just man shall correct me in mercy, and shall reprove me: * but let not the oil of the sinner fatten my head.

psalm:140:gloria.latin: Quóniam adhuc et orátio mea in beneplácitis eórum: * absórpti sunt juncti petræ júdices eórum.
psalm:140:gloria.english: For my prayer also shall still be against the things with which they are well pleased: * their judges falling upon the rock have been swallowed up.

psalm:140:gloria.latin: Áudient verba mea quóniam potuérunt: * sicut crassitúdo terræ erúpta est super terram.
psalm:140:gloria.english: They shall hear my words, for they have prevailed: * as when the thickness of the earth is broken up upon the ground.

psalm:140:gloria.latin: Dissipáta sunt ossa nostra secus inférnum: * quia ad te, Dómine, Dómine, óculi mei: in te sperávi, non áuferas ánimam meam.
psalm:140:gloria.english: Our bones are scattered by the side of hell. * But to thee, O Lord, Lord, are my eyes: in thee have I put my trust, take not away my soul.

psalm:140:gloria.latin: Custódi me a láqueo, quem statuérunt mihi: * et a scándalis operántium iniquitátem.
psalm:140:gloria.english: Keep me from the snare, which they have laid for me, * and from the stumbling blocks of them that work iniquity.

psalm:140:gloria.latin: Cadent in retiáculo ejus peccatóres: * singuláriter sum ego donec tránseam.
psalm:140:gloria.english: The wicked shall fall in his net: * I am alone until I pass.

psalm:140:gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:140:gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:140:gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:140:gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:75:gloria.latin: Notus in Judǽa Deus: * in Israël magnum nomen ejus.
psalm:75:gloria.english: In Judea God is known: * his name is great in Israel.

psalm:75:gloria.latin: Et factus est in pace locus ejus: * et habitátio ejus in Sion.
psalm:75:gloria.english: And his place is in peace: * and his abode in Sion:

psalm:75:gloria.latin: Ibi confrégit poténtias árcuum, * scutum, gládium, et bellum.
psalm:75:gloria.english: There hath he broken the powers of bows, * the shield, the sword, and the battle.

psalm:75:gloria.latin: Illúminans tu mirabíliter a móntibus ætérnis: * turbáti sunt omnes insipiéntes corde.
psalm:75:gloria.english: Thou enlightenest wonderfully from the everlasting hills. * All the foolish of heart were troubled.

psalm:75:gloria.latin: Dormiérunt somnum suum: * et nihil invenérunt omnes viri divitiárum in mánibus suis.
psalm:75:gloria.english: They have slept their sleep; * and all the men of riches have found nothing in their hands.

psalm:75:gloria.latin: Ab increpatióne tua, Deus Jacob, * dormitavérunt qui ascendérunt equos.
psalm:75:gloria.english: At thy rebuke, O God of Jacob, * they have all slumbered that mounted on horseback.

psalm:75:gloria.latin: Tu terríbilis es, et quis resístet tibi? * ex tunc ira tua.
psalm:75:gloria.english: Thou art terrible, and who shall resist thee? * from that time thy wrath.

psalm:75:gloria.latin: De cælo audítum fecísti judícium: * terra trémuit et quiévit,
psalm:75:gloria.english: Thou hast caused judgment to be heard from heaven: * the earth trembled and was still,

psalm:75:gloria.latin: Cum exsúrgeret in judícium Deus, * ut salvos fáceret omnes mansuétos terræ.
psalm:75:gloria.english: When God arose in judgment, * to save all the meek of the earth.

psalm:75:gloria.latin: Quóniam cogitátio hóminis confitébitur tibi: * et relíquiæ cogitatiónis diem festum agent tibi.
psalm:75:gloria.english: For the thought of man shall give praise to thee: * and the remainders of the thought shall keep holiday to thee.

psalm:75:gloria.latin: Vovéte, et réddite Dómino, Deo vestro: * omnes, qui in circúitu ejus affértis múnera.
psalm:75:gloria.english: Vow ye, and pay to the Lord your God: * all you that are round about him bring presents.

psalm:75:gloria.latin: Terríbili et ei qui aufert spíritum príncipum, * terríbili apud reges terræ.
psalm:75:gloria.english: To him that is terrible, even to him who taketh away the spirit of princes: * to the terrible with the kings of the earth.

psalm:75:gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:75:gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:75:gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:75:gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:91:gloria.latin: Bonum est confitéri Dómino: * et psállere nómini tuo, Altíssime.
psalm:91:gloria.english: It is good to give praise to the Lord: * and to sing to thy name, O most High.

psalm:91:gloria.latin: Ad annuntiándum mane misericórdiam tuam: * et veritátem tuam per noctem.
psalm:91:gloria.english: To shew forth thy mercy in the morning, * and thy truth in the night:

psalm:91:gloria.latin: In decachórdo, psaltério: * cum cántico, in cíthara.
psalm:91:gloria.english: Upon an instrument of ten strings, upon the psaltery: * with a canticle upon the harp.

psalm:91:gloria.latin: Quia delectásti me, Dómine, in factúra tua: * et in opéribus mánuum tuárum exsultábo.
psalm:91:gloria.english: For thou hast given me, O Lord, a delight in thy doings: * and in the works of thy hands I shall rejoice.

psalm:91:gloria.latin: Quam magnificáta sunt ópera tua, Dómine! * nimis profúndæ factæ sunt cogitatiónes tuæ.
psalm:91:gloria.english: O Lord, how great are thy works! * thy thoughts are exceeding deep.

psalm:91:gloria.latin: Vir insípiens non cognóscet: * et stultus non intélleget hæc.
psalm:91:gloria.english: The senseless man shall not know: * nor will the fool understand these things.

psalm:91:gloria.latin: Cum exórti fúerint peccatóres sicut fænum: * et apparúerint omnes, qui operántur iniquitátem:
psalm:91:gloria.english: When the wicked shall spring up as grass: * and all the workers of iniquity shall appear:

psalm:91:gloria.latin: Ut intéreant in sǽculum sǽculi: * tu autem Altíssimus in ætérnum, Dómine.
psalm:91:gloria.english: That they may perish for ever and ever: * but thou, O Lord, art most high for evermore.

psalm:91:gloria.latin: Quóniam ecce inimíci tui, Dómine, quóniam ecce inimíci tui períbunt: * et dispergéntur omnes, qui operántur iniquitátem.
psalm:91:gloria.english: For behold thy enemies, O Lord, for behold thy enemies shall perish: * and all the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.

psalm:91:gloria.latin: Et exaltábitur sicut unicórnis cornu meum: * et senéctus mea in misericórdia úberi.
psalm:91:gloria.english: But my horn shall be exalted like that of the unicorn: * and my old age in plentiful mercy.

psalm:91:gloria.latin: Et despéxit óculus meus inimícos meos: * et in insurgéntibus in me malignántibus áudiet auris mea.
psalm:91:gloria.english: My eye also hath looked down upon my enemies: * and my ear shall hear of the downfall of the malignant that rise up against me.

psalm:91:gloria.latin: Justus, ut palma florébit: * sicut cedrus Líbani multiplicábitur.
psalm:91:gloria.english: The just shall flourish like the palm tree: * he shall grow up like the cedar of Libanus.

psalm:91:gloria.latin: Plantáti in domo Dómini, * in átriis domus Dei nostri florébunt.
psalm:91:gloria.english: They that are planted in the house of the Lord * shall flourish in the courts of the house of our God.

psalm:91:gloria.latin: Adhuc multiplicabúntur in senécta úberi: * et bene patiéntes erunt, ut annúntient:
psalm:91:gloria.english: They shall still increase in a fruitful old age: * and shall be well treated, that they may shew,

psalm:91:gloria.latin: Quóniam rectus Dóminus, Deus noster: * et non est iníquitas in eo.
psalm:91:gloria.english: That the Lord our God is righteous, * and there is no iniquity in him.

psalm:91:gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:91:gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:91:gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:91:gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:225:gloria.english: Canticle 225

psalm:225:gloria.latin: Dómine, audívi auditiónem tuam, * et tímui.
psalm:225:gloria.english: O Lord, I have heard thy hearing, * and was afraid.

psalm:225:gloria.latin: Dómine, opus tuum, * in médio annórum vivífica illud:
psalm:225:gloria.english: O Lord, thy work, * in the midst of the years bring it to life:

psalm:225:gloria.latin: In médio annórum notum fácies: * cum irátus fúeris, misericórdiæ recordáberis.
psalm:225:gloria.english: In the midst of the years thou shalt make it known: * when thou art angry, thou wilt remember mercy.

psalm:225:gloria.latin: Deus ab Austro véniet, * et sanctus de monte Pharan:
psalm:225:gloria.english: God will come from the south, * and the holy one from mount Pharan:

psalm:225:gloria.latin: Opéruit cælos glória ejus: * et laudis ejus plena est terra.
psalm:225:gloria.english: His glory covered the heavens, * and the earth is full of his praise.

psalm:225:gloria.latin: Splendor ejus ut lux erit: * córnua in mánibus ejus:
psalm:225:gloria.english: His brightness shall be as the light: * horns are in his hands:

psalm:225:gloria.latin: Ibi abscóndita est fortitúdo ejus: * (5a) ante fáciem ejus ibit mors.
psalm:225:gloria.english: There is his strength hid: * (5a) Death shall go before his face.

psalm:225:gloria.latin: Et egrediétur diábolus ante pedes ejus. * (6a) Stetit, et mensus est terram.
psalm:225:gloria.english: And the devil shall go forth before his feet. * (6a) He stood and measured the earth.

psalm:225:gloria.latin: Aspéxit, et dissólvit gentes: * et contríti sunt montes sǽculi.
psalm:225:gloria.english: He beheld, and melted the nations: * and the ancient mountains were crushed to pieces.

psalm:225:gloria.latin: Incurváti sunt colles mundi, * ab itinéribus æternitátis ejus.
psalm:225:gloria.english: The hills of the world were bowed down * by the journeys of his eternity.

psalm:225:gloria.latin: Pro iniquitáte vidi tentória Æthiópiæ, * turbabúntur pelles terræ Mádian.
psalm:225:gloria.english: I saw the tents of Ethiopia for their iniquity, * the curtains of the land of Madian shall be troubled.

psalm:225:gloria.latin: Numquid in flumínibus irátus es, Dómine? * aut in flumínibus furor tuus? vel in mari indignátio tua?
psalm:225:gloria.english: Wast thou angry, O Lord, with the rivers? * or was thy wrath upon the rivers? or thy indignation in the sea?

psalm:225:gloria.latin: Qui ascéndes super equos tuos: * et quadrígæ tuæ salvátio.
psalm:225:gloria.english: Who will ride upon thy horses: * and thy chariots are salvation.

psalm:225:gloria.latin: Súscitans suscitábis arcum tuum: * juraménta tríbubus quæ locútus es.
psalm:225:gloria.english: Thou wilt surely take up thy bow: * according to the oaths which thou hast spoken to the tribes.

psalm:225:gloria.latin: Flúvios scindes terræ: † (10a) vidérunt te, et doluérunt montes: * gurges aquárum tránsiit.
psalm:225:gloria.english: Thou wilt divide the rivers of the earth. † (10a) The mountains saw thee, and were grieved: * the great body of waters passed away.

psalm:225:gloria.latin: Dedit abýssus vocem suam: * altitúdo manus suas levávit.
psalm:225:gloria.english: The deep put forth its voice: * the deep lifted up its hands.

psalm:225:gloria.latin: Sol, et luna stetérunt in habitáculo suo, * in luce sagittárum tuárum, ibunt in splendóre fulgurántis hastæ tuæ.
psalm:225:gloria.english: The sun and the moon stood still in their habitation, * in the light of thy arrows, they shall go in the brightness of thy glittering spear.

psalm:225:gloria.latin: In frémitu conculcábis terram: * et in furóre obstupefácies gentes.
psalm:225:gloria.english: In thy anger thou wilt tread the earth under foot: * in thy wrath thou wilt astonish the nations.

psalm:225:gloria.latin: Egréssus es in salútem pópuli tui: * in salútem cum Christo tuo.
psalm:225:gloria.english: Thou wentest forth for the salvation of thy people: * for salvation with thy Christ.

psalm:225:gloria.latin: Percussísti caput de domo ímpii: * denudásti fundaméntum ejus usque ad collum.
psalm:225:gloria.english: Thou struckest the head of the house of the wicked: * thou hast laid bare his foundation even to the neck.

psalm:225:gloria.latin: Maledixísti sceptris ejus, † cápiti bellatórum ejus, * veniéntibus ut turbo ad dispergéndum me.
psalm:225:gloria.english: Thou hast cursed his sceptres, † the head of his warriors, * them that came out as a whirlwind to scatter me.

psalm:225:gloria.latin: Exsultátio eórum * sicut ejus, qui dévorat páuperem in abscóndito.
psalm:225:gloria.english: Their joy * was like that of him that devoureth the poor man in secret.

psalm:225:gloria.latin: Viam fecísti in mari equis tuis, * in luto aquárum multárum.
psalm:225:gloria.english: Thou madest a way in the sea for thy horses, * in the mud of many waters.

psalm:225:gloria.latin: Audívi, et conturbátus est venter meus: * a voce contremuérunt lábia mea.
psalm:225:gloria.english: I have heard and my bowels were troubled: * my lips trembled at the voice.

psalm:225:gloria.latin: Ingrediátur putrédo in óssibus meis, * et subter me scáteat.
psalm:225:gloria.english: Let rottenness enter into my bones, * and swarm under me.

psalm:225:gloria.latin: Ut requiéscam in die tribulatiónis: * ut ascéndam ad pópulum accínctum nostrum.
psalm:225:gloria.english: That I may rest in the day of tribulation: * that I may go up to our people that are girded.

psalm:225:gloria.latin: Ficus enim non florébit: * et non erit germen in víneis.
psalm:225:gloria.english: For the fig tree shall not blossom: * and there shall be no spring in the vines.

psalm:225:gloria.latin: Mentiétur opus olívæ: * et arva non áfferent cibum.
psalm:225:gloria.english: The labour of the olive tree shall fail: * and the fields shall yield no food:

psalm:225:gloria.latin: Abscindétur de ovíli pecus: * et non erit arméntum in præsépibus.
psalm:225:gloria.english: The flock shall be cut off from the fold, * and there shall be no herd in the stalls.

psalm:225:gloria.latin: Ego autem in Dómino gaudébo: * et exsultábo in Deo Jesu meo.
psalm:225:gloria.english: But I will rejoice in the Lord: * and I will joy in God my Jesus.

psalm:225:gloria.latin: Deus Dóminus fortitúdo mea: * et ponet pedes meos quasi cervórum.
psalm:225:gloria.english: The Lord God is my strength: * and he will make my feet like the feet of harts:

psalm:225:gloria.latin: Et super excélsa mea dedúcet me victor * in psalmis canéntem.
psalm:225:gloria.english: And he the conqueror will lead me upon my high places * singing psalms.

psalm:225:gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:225:gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:225:gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:225:gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:15:gloria.latin: Consérva me, Dómine, quóniam sperávi in te. ‡ (2) Dixi Dómino: Deus meus es tu, * quóniam bonórum meórum non eges.
psalm:15:gloria.english: Preserve me, O Lord, for I have put my trust in thee. ‡ (2) I have said to the Lord, thou art my God, * for thou hast no need of my goods.

psalm:15:gloria.latin: Sanctis, qui sunt in terra ejus, * mirificávit omnes voluntátes meas in eis.
psalm:15:gloria.english: To the saints, who are in his land, * he hath made wonderful all my desires in them.

psalm:15:gloria.latin: Multiplicátæ sunt infirmitátes eórum: * póstea acceleravérunt.
psalm:15:gloria.english: Their infirmities were multiplied: * afterwards they made haste.

psalm:15:gloria.latin: Non congregábo conventícula eórum de sanguínibus, * nec memor ero nóminum eórum per lábia mea.
psalm:15:gloria.english: I will not gather together their meetings for blood offerings: * nor will I be mindful of their names by my lips.

psalm:15:gloria.latin: Dóminus pars hereditátis meæ, et cálicis mei: * tu es, qui restítues hereditátem meam mihi.
psalm:15:gloria.english: The Lord is the portion of my inheritance and of my cup: * it is thou that wilt restore my inheritance to me.

psalm:15:gloria.latin: Funes cecidérunt mihi in præcláris: * étenim heréditas mea præclára est mihi.
psalm:15:gloria.english: The lines are fallen unto me in goodly places: * for my inheritance is goodly to me.

psalm:15:gloria.latin: Benedícam Dóminum, qui tríbuit mihi intelléctum: * ínsuper et usque ad noctem increpuérunt me renes mei.
psalm:15:gloria.english: I will bless the Lord, who hath given me understanding: * moreover my reins also have corrected me even till night.

psalm:15:gloria.latin: Providébam Dóminum in conspéctu meo semper: * quóniam a dextris est mihi, ne commóvear.
psalm:15:gloria.english: I set the Lord always in my sight: * for he is at my right hand, that I be not moved.

psalm:15:gloria.latin: Propter hoc lætátum est cor meum, et exsultávit lingua mea: * ínsuper et caro mea requiéscet in spe.
psalm:15:gloria.english: Therefore my heart hath been glad, and my tongue hath rejoiced: * moreover my flesh also shall rest in hope.

psalm:15:gloria.latin: Quóniam non derelínques ánimam meam in inférno: * nec dabis sanctum tuum vidére corruptiónem.
psalm:15:gloria.english: Because thou wilt not leave my soul in hell; * nor wilt thou give thy holy one to see corruption.

psalm:15:gloria.latin: Notas mihi fecísti vias vitæ, † adimplébis me lætítia cum vultu tuo: * delectatiónes in déxtera tua usque in finem.
psalm:15:gloria.english: Thou hast made known to me the ways of life, † thou shalt fill me with joy with thy countenance: * at thy right hand are delights even to the end.

psalm:15:gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:15:gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:15:gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:15:gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:16:gloria.english: Psalm 16

psalm:16:gloria.latin: Exáudi, Dómine, justítiam meam: * inténde deprecatiónem meam.
psalm:16:gloria.english: Hear, O Lord, my justice: * attend to my supplication.

psalm:16:gloria.latin: Áuribus pércipe oratiónem meam, * non in lábiis dolósis.
psalm:16:gloria.english: Give ear unto my prayer, * which proceedeth not from deceitful lips.

psalm:16:gloria.latin: De vultu tuo judícium meum pródeat: * óculi tui vídeant æquitátes.
psalm:16:gloria.english: Let my judgment come forth from thy countenance: * let thy eyes behold the things that are equitable.

psalm:16:gloria.latin: Probásti cor meum, et visitásti nocte: * igne me examinásti, et non est invénta in me iníquitas.
psalm:16:gloria.english: Thou hast proved my heart, and visited it by night, * thou hast tried me by fire: and iniquity hath not been found in me.

psalm:16:gloria.latin: Ut non loquátur os meum ópera hóminum: * propter verba labiórum tuórum ego custodívi vias duras.
psalm:16:gloria.english: That my mouth may not speak the works of men: * for the sake of the words of thy lips, I have kept hard ways.

psalm:16:gloria.latin: Pérfice gressus meos in sémitis tuis: * ut non moveántur vestígia mea.
psalm:16:gloria.english: Perfect thou my goings in thy paths: * that my footsteps be not moved.

psalm:16:gloria.latin: Ego clamávi, quóniam exaudísti me, Deus: * inclína aurem tuam mihi, et exáudi verba mea.
psalm:16:gloria.english: I have cried to thee, for thou, O God, hast heard me: * O incline thy ear unto me, and hear my words.

psalm:16:gloria.latin: Mirífica misericórdias tuas, * qui salvos facis sperántes in te.
psalm:16:gloria.english: Shew forth thy wonderful mercies; * thou who savest them that trust in thee.

psalm:16:gloria.latin: A resisténtibus déxteræ tuæ custódi me, * ut pupíllam óculi.
psalm:16:gloria.english: From them that resist thy right hand keep me, * as the apple of thy eye.

psalm:16:gloria.latin: Sub umbra alárum tuárum prótege me: * (9a) a fácie impiórum qui me afflixérunt.
psalm:16:gloria.english: Protect me under the shadow of thy wings: * (9a) from the face of the wicked who have afflicted me.

psalm:16:gloria.latin: Inimíci mei ánimam meam circumdedérunt, † (10) ádipem suum conclusérunt: * os eórum locútum est supérbiam.
psalm:16:gloria.english: My enemies have surrounded my soul: † (10) They have shut up their fat: * their mouth hath spoken proudly.

psalm:16:gloria.latin: Proiciéntes me nunc circumdedérunt me: * óculos suos statuérunt declináre in terram.
psalm:16:gloria.english: They have cast me forth, and now they have surrounded me: * they have set their eyes bowing down to the earth.

psalm:16:gloria.latin: Suscepérunt me sicut leo parátus ad prædam: * et sicut cátulus leónis hábitans in ábditis.
psalm:16:gloria.english: They have taken me, as a lion prepared for the prey; * and as a young lion dwelling in secret places.

psalm:16:gloria.latin: Exsúrge, Dómine, prǽveni eum, et supplánta eum: * éripe ánimam meam ab ímpio, frámeam tuam (14a) ab inimícis manus tuæ.
psalm:16:gloria.english: Arise, O Lord, disappoint him and supplant him; * deliver my soul from the wicked one; thy sword (14a) from the enemies of thy hand.

psalm:16:gloria.latin: Dómine, a paucis de terra dívide eos in vita eórum: * de abscónditis tuis adimplétus est venter eórum.
psalm:16:gloria.english: O Lord, divide them from the few of the earth in their life: * their belly is filled from thy hidden stores.

psalm:16:gloria.latin: Saturáti sunt fíliis: * et dimisérunt relíquias suas párvulis suis.
psalm:16:gloria.english: They are full of children: * and they have left to their little ones the rest of their substance.

psalm:16:gloria.latin: Ego autem in justítia apparébo conspéctui tuo: * satiábor cum apparúerit glória tua.
psalm:16:gloria.english: But as for me, I will appear before thy sight in justice: * I shall be satisfied when thy glory shall appear.

psalm:16:gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:16:gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:16:gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:16:gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:17(2-25):gloria.latin: Díligam te, Dómine, fortitúdo mea: * (3a) Dóminus firmaméntum meum, et refúgium meum, et liberátor meus.
psalm:17(2-25):gloria.english: I will love thee, O Lord, my strength: * (3a) The Lord is my firmament, my refuge, and my deliverer.

psalm:17(2-25):gloria.latin: Deus meus adjútor meus, * et sperábo in eum.
psalm:17(2-25):gloria.english: My God is my helper, * and in him will I put my trust.

psalm:17(2-25):gloria.latin: Protéctor meus, et cornu salútis meæ, * et suscéptor meus.
psalm:17(2-25):gloria.english: My protector, and the horn of my salvation, * and my support.

psalm:17(2-25):gloria.latin: Laudans invocábo Dóminum: * et ab inimícis meis salvus ero.
psalm:17(2-25):gloria.english: Praising, I will call upon the Lord: * and I shall be saved from my enemies.

psalm:17(2-25):gloria.latin: Circumdedérunt me dolóres mortis: * et torréntes iniquitátis conturbavérunt me.
psalm:17(2-25):gloria.english: The sorrows of death surrounded me: * and the torrents of iniquity troubled me.

psalm:17(2-25):gloria.latin: Dolóres inférni circumdedérunt me: * præoccupavérunt me láquei mortis.
psalm:17(2-25):gloria.english: The sorrows of hell encompassed me: * and the snares of death prevented me.

psalm:17(2-25):gloria.latin: In tribulatióne mea invocávi Dóminum, * et ad Deum meum clamávi.
psalm:17(2-25):gloria.english: In my affliction I called upon the Lord, * and I cried to my God:

psalm:17(2-25):gloria.latin: Et exaudívit de templo sancto suo vocem meam: * et clamor meus in conspéctu ejus, introívit in aures ejus.
psalm:17(2-25):gloria.english: And he heard my voice from his holy temple: * and my cry before him came into his ears.

psalm:17(2-25):gloria.latin: Commóta est, et contrémuit terra: * fundaménta móntium conturbáta sunt, et commóta sunt, quóniam irátus est eis.
psalm:17(2-25):gloria.english: The earth shook and trembled: * the foundations of the mountains were troubled and were moved, because he was angry with them.

psalm:17(2-25):gloria.latin: Ascéndit fumus in ira ejus: † et ignis a fácie ejus exársit: * carbónes succénsi sunt ab eo.
psalm:17(2-25):gloria.english: There went up a smoke in his wrath: † and a fire flamed from his face: * coals were kindled by it.

psalm:17(2-25):gloria.latin: Inclinávit cælos, et descéndit: * et calígo sub pédibus ejus.
psalm:17(2-25):gloria.english: He bowed the heavens, and came down, * and darkness was under his feet.

psalm:17(2-25):gloria.latin: Et ascéndit super Chérubim, et volávit: * volávit super pennas ventórum.
psalm:17(2-25):gloria.english: And he ascended upon the cherubim, and he flew; * he flew upon the wings of the winds.

psalm:17(2-25):gloria.latin: Et pósuit ténebras latíbulum suum, † in circúitu ejus tabernáculum ejus: * tenebrósa aqua in núbibus áëris.
psalm:17(2-25):gloria.english: And he made darkness his covert, † his pavilion round about him: * dark waters in the clouds of the air.

psalm:17(2-25):gloria.latin: Præ fulgóre in conspéctu ejus nubes transiérunt, * grando et carbónes ignis.
psalm:17(2-25):gloria.english: At the brightness that was before him the clouds passed, * hail and coals of fire.

psalm:17(2-25):gloria.latin: Et intónuit de cælo Dóminus, † et Altíssimus dedit vocem suam: * grando et carbónes ignis.
psalm:17(2-25):gloria.english: And the Lord thundered from heaven, † and the Highest gave his voice: * hail and coals of fire.

psalm:17(2-25):gloria.latin: Et misit sagíttas suas, et dissipávit eos: * fúlgura multiplicávit, et conturbávit eos.
psalm:17(2-25):gloria.english: And he sent forth his arrows, and he scattered them: * he multiplied lightnings, and troubled them.

psalm:17(2-25):gloria.latin: Et apparuérunt fontes aquárum, * et reveláta sunt fundaménta orbis terrárum:
psalm:17(2-25):gloria.english: Then the fountains of waters appeared, * and the foundations of the world were discovered:

psalm:17(2-25):gloria.latin: Ab increpatióne tua, Dómine, * ab inspiratióne spíritus iræ tuæ.
psalm:17(2-25):gloria.english: At thy rebuke, O Lord, * at the blast of the spirit of thy wrath.

psalm:17(2-25):gloria.latin: Misit de summo, et accépit me: * et assúmpsit me de aquis multis.
psalm:17(2-25):gloria.english: He sent from on high, and took me: * and received me out of many waters.

psalm:17(2-25):gloria.latin: Erípuit me de inimícis meis fortíssimis, † et ab his qui odérunt me: * quóniam confortáti sunt super me.
psalm:17(2-25):gloria.english: He delivered me from my strongest enemies, † and from them that hated me: * for they were too strong for me.

psalm:17(2-25):gloria.latin: Prævenérunt me in die afflictiónis meæ: * et factus est Dóminus protéctor meus.
psalm:17(2-25):gloria.english: They prevented me in the day of my affliction: * and the Lord became my protector.

psalm:17(2-25):gloria.latin: Et edúxit me in latitúdinem: * salvum me fecit, quóniam vóluit me.
psalm:17(2-25):gloria.english: And he brought me forth into a large place: * he saved me, because he was well pleased with me.

psalm:17(2-25):gloria.latin: Et retríbuet mihi Dóminus secúndum justítiam meam: * et secúndum puritátem mánuum meárum retríbuet mihi:
psalm:17(2-25):gloria.english: And the Lord will reward me according to my justice; * and will repay me according to the cleanness of my hands:

psalm:17(2-25):gloria.latin: Quia custodívi vias Dómini, * nec ímpie gessi a Deo meo.
psalm:17(2-25):gloria.english: Because I have kept the ways of the Lord; * and have not done wickedly against my God.

psalm:17(2-25):gloria.latin: Quóniam ómnia judícia ejus in conspéctu meo: * et justítias ejus non répuli a me.
psalm:17(2-25):gloria.english: For all his judgments are in my sight: * and his justices I have not put away from me.

psalm:17(2-25):gloria.latin: Et ero immaculátus cum eo: * et observábo me ab iniquitáte mea.
psalm:17(2-25):gloria.english: And I shall be spotless with him: * and shall keep myself from my iniquity.

psalm:17(2-25):gloria.latin: Et retríbuet mihi Dóminus secúndum justítiam meam: * et secúndum puritátem mánuum meárum in conspéctu oculórum ejus.
psalm:17(2-25):gloria.english: And the Lord will reward me according to my justice: * and according to the cleanness of my hands before his eyes.

psalm:17(2-25):gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:17(2-25):gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:17(2-25):gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:17(2-25):gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:141:gloria.latin: Voce mea ad Dóminum clamávi: * voce mea ad Dóminum deprecátus sum:
psalm:141:gloria.english: I cried to the Lord with my voice: * with my voice I made supplication to the Lord.

psalm:141:gloria.latin: Effúndo in conspéctu ejus oratiónem meam, * et tribulatiónem meam ante ipsum pronúntio.
psalm:141:gloria.english: In his sight I pour out my prayer, * and before him I declare my trouble:

psalm:141:gloria.latin: In deficiéndo ex me spíritum meum, * et tu cognovísti sémitas meas.
psalm:141:gloria.english: When my spirit failed me, * then thou knewest my paths.

psalm:141:gloria.latin: In via hac, qua ambulábam, * abscondérunt láqueum mihi.
psalm:141:gloria.english: In this way wherein I walked, * they have hidden a snare for me.

psalm:141:gloria.latin: Considerábam ad déxteram, et vidébam: * et non erat qui cognósceret me.
psalm:141:gloria.english: I looked on my right hand, and beheld, * and there was no one that would know me.

psalm:141:gloria.latin: Périit fuga a me, * et non est qui requírat ánimam meam.
psalm:141:gloria.english: Flight hath failed me: * and there is no one that hath regard to my soul.

psalm:141:gloria.latin: Clamávi ad te, Dómine, * dixi: Tu es spes mea, pórtio mea in terra vivéntium.
psalm:141:gloria.english: I cried to thee, O Lord: * I said: Thou art my hope, my portion in the land of the living.

psalm:141:gloria.latin: Inténde ad deprecatiónem meam: * quia humiliátus sum nimis.
psalm:141:gloria.english: Attend to my supplication: * for I am brought very low.

psalm:141:gloria.latin: Líbera me a persequéntibus me: * quia confortáti sunt super me.
psalm:141:gloria.english: Deliver me from my persecutors; * for they are stronger than I.

psalm:141:gloria.latin: Educ de custódia ánimam meam ad confiténdum nómini tuo: * me exspéctant justi, donec retríbuas mihi.
psalm:141:gloria.english: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may praise thy name: * the just wait for me, until thou reward me.

psalm:141:gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:141:gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:141:gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:141:gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:143(1-8):gloria.latin: Benedíctus Dóminus, Deus meus, qui docet manus meas ad prǽlium, * et dígitos meos ad bellum.
psalm:143(1-8):gloria.english: Blessed be the Lord my God, who teacheth my hands to fight, * and my fingers to war.

psalm:143(1-8):gloria.latin: Misericórdia mea, et refúgium meum: * suscéptor meus, et liberátor meus:
psalm:143(1-8):gloria.english: My mercy, and my refuge: * my support, and my deliverer:

psalm:143(1-8):gloria.latin: Protéctor meus, et in ipso sperávi: * qui subdit pópulum meum sub me.
psalm:143(1-8):gloria.english: My protector, and I have hoped in him: * who subdueth my people under me.

psalm:143(1-8):gloria.latin: Dómine, quid est homo, quia innotuísti ei? * aut fílius hóminis, quia réputas eum?
psalm:143(1-8):gloria.english: Lord, what is man, that thou art made known to him? * or the son of man, that thou makest account of him?

psalm:143(1-8):gloria.latin: Homo vanitáti símilis factus est: * dies ejus sicut umbra prætéreunt.
psalm:143(1-8):gloria.english: Man is like to vanity: * his days pass away like a shadow.

psalm:143(1-8):gloria.latin: Dómine, inclína cælos tuos, et descénde: * tange montes, et fumigábunt.
psalm:143(1-8):gloria.english: Lord, bow down thy heavens and descend: * touch the mountains, and they shall smoke.

psalm:143(1-8):gloria.latin: Fúlgura coruscatiónem, et dissipábis eos: * emítte sagíttas tuas, et conturbábis eos.
psalm:143(1-8):gloria.english: Send forth lightning, and thou shalt scatter them: * shoot out thy arrows, and thou shalt trouble them.

psalm:143(1-8):gloria.latin: Emítte manum tuam de alto, éripe me, et líbera me de aquis multis: * de manu filiórum alienórum.
psalm:143(1-8):gloria.english: Put forth thy hand from on high, take me out, and deliver me from many waters: * from the hand of strange children:

psalm:143(1-8):gloria.latin: Quorum os locútum est vanitátem: * et déxtera eórum, déxtera iniquitátis.
psalm:143(1-8):gloria.english: Whose mouth hath spoken vanity: * and their right hand is the right hand of iniquity.

psalm:143(1-8):gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:143(1-8):gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:143(1-8):gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:143(1-8):gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:143(9-15):gloria.latin: Deus, cánticum novum cantábo tibi: * in psaltério decachórdo psallam tibi.
psalm:143(9-15):gloria.english: To thee, O God, I will sing a new canticle: * on the psaltery and an instrument of ten strings I will sing praises to thee.

psalm:143(9-15):gloria.latin: Qui das salútem régibus: * qui redemísti David, servum tuum, de gládio malígno: éripe me.
psalm:143(9-15):gloria.english: Who givest salvation to kings: * who hast redeemed thy servant David from the malicious sword: Deliver me,

psalm:143(9-15):gloria.latin: Et érue me de manu filiórum alienórum, quorum os locútum est vanitátem: * et déxtera eórum, déxtera iniquitátis:
psalm:143(9-15):gloria.english: And rescue me out of the hand of strange children; whose mouth hath spoken vanity: * and their right hand is the right hand of iniquity:

psalm:143(9-15):gloria.latin: Quorum fílii, sicut novéllæ plantatiónes * in juventúte sua.
psalm:143(9-15):gloria.english: Whose sons are as new plants * in their youth:

psalm:143(9-15):gloria.latin: Fíliæ eórum compósitæ: * circumornátæ ut similitúdo templi.
psalm:143(9-15):gloria.english: Their daughters decked out, * adorned round about after the similitude of a temple:

psalm:143(9-15):gloria.latin: Promptuária eórum plena, * eructántia ex hoc in illud.
psalm:143(9-15):gloria.english: Their storehouses full, * flowing out of this into that.

psalm:143(9-15):gloria.latin: Oves eórum fœtósæ, abundántes in egréssibus suis: * boves eórum crassæ.
psalm:143(9-15):gloria.english: Their sheep fruitful in young, abounding in their goings forth: * their oxen fat.

psalm:143(9-15):gloria.latin: Non est ruína macériæ, neque tránsitus: * neque clamor in platéis eórum.
psalm:143(9-15):gloria.english: There is no breach of wall, nor passage, * nor crying out in their streets.

psalm:143(9-15):gloria.latin: Beátum dixérunt pópulum, cui hæc sunt: * beátus pópulus, cujus Dóminus Deus ejus.
psalm:143(9-15):gloria.english: They have called the people happy, that hath these things: * but happy is that people whose God is the Lord.

psalm:143(9-15):gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:143(9-15):gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:143(9-15):gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:143(9-15):gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:144(1-9):gloria.latin: Exaltábo te, Deus meus, rex: * et benedícam nómini tuo in sǽculum, et in sǽculum sǽculi.
psalm:144(1-9):gloria.english: I will extol thee, O God my king: * and I will bless thy name for ever; yea, for ever and ever.

psalm:144(1-9):gloria.latin: Per síngulos dies benedícam tibi: * et laudábo nomen tuum in sǽculum, et in sǽculum sǽculi.
psalm:144(1-9):gloria.english: Every day will I bless thee: * and I will praise thy name for ever; yea, for ever and ever.

psalm:144(1-9):gloria.latin: Magnus Dóminus, et laudábilis nimis: * et magnitúdinis ejus non est finis.
psalm:144(1-9):gloria.english: Great is the Lord, and greatly to be praised: * and of his greatness there is no end.

psalm:144(1-9):gloria.latin: Generátio et generátio laudábit ópera tua: * et poténtiam tuam pronuntiábunt.
psalm:144(1-9):gloria.english: Generation and generation shall praise thy works: * and they shall declare thy power.

psalm:144(1-9):gloria.latin: Magnificéntiam glóriæ sanctitátis tuæ loquéntur: * et mirabília tua narrábunt.
psalm:144(1-9):gloria.english: They shall speak of the magnificence of the glory of thy holiness: * and shall tell thy wondrous works.

psalm:144(1-9):gloria.latin: Et virtútem terribílium tuórum dicent: * et magnitúdinem tuam narrábunt.
psalm:144(1-9):gloria.english: And they shall speak of the might of thy terrible acts: * and shall declare thy greatness.

psalm:144(1-9):gloria.latin: Memóriam abundántiæ suavitátis tuæ eructábunt: * et justítia tua exsultábunt.
psalm:144(1-9):gloria.english: They shall publish the memory of the abundance of thy sweetness: * and shall rejoice in thy justice.

psalm:144(1-9):gloria.latin: Miserátor, et miséricors Dóminus: * pátiens, et multum miséricors.
psalm:144(1-9):gloria.english: The Lord is gracious and merciful: * patient and plenteous in mercy.

psalm:144(1-9):gloria.latin: Suávis Dóminus univérsis: * et miseratiónes ejus super ómnia ópera ejus.
psalm:144(1-9):gloria.english: The Lord is sweet to all: * and his tender mercies are over all his works.

psalm:144(1-9):gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:144(1-9):gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:144(1-9):gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:144(1-9):gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:142:gloria.latin: Dómine, exáudi oratiónem meam: áuribus pércipe obsecratiónem meam in veritáte tua: * exáudi me in tua justítia.
psalm:142:gloria.english: Hear, O Lord, my prayer: give ear to my supplication in thy truth: * hear me in thy justice.

psalm:142:gloria.latin: Et non intres in judícium cum servo tuo: * quia non justificábitur in conspéctu tuo omnis vivens.
psalm:142:gloria.english: And enter not into judgment with thy servant: * for in thy sight no man living shall be justified.

psalm:142:gloria.latin: Quia persecútus est inimícus ánimam meam: * humiliávit in terra vitam meam.
psalm:142:gloria.english: For the enemy hath persecuted my soul: * he hath brought down my life to the earth.

psalm:142:gloria.latin: Collocávit me in obscúris sicut mórtuos sǽculi: * (4) et anxiátus est super me spíritus meus, in me turbátum est cor meum.
psalm:142:gloria.english: He hath made me to dwell in darkness as those that have been dead of old: * (4) and my spirit is in anguish within me: my heart within me is troubled.

psalm:142:gloria.latin: Memor fui diérum antiquórum, meditátus sum in ómnibus opéribus tuis: * in factis mánuum tuárum meditábar.
psalm:142:gloria.english: I remembered the days of old, I meditated on all thy works: * I meditated upon the works of thy hands.

psalm:142:gloria.latin: Expándi manus meas ad te: * ánima mea sicut terra sine aqua tibi.
psalm:142:gloria.english: I stretched forth my hands to thee: * my soul is as earth without water unto thee.

psalm:142:gloria.latin: Velóciter exáudi me, Dómine: * defécit spíritus meus.
psalm:142:gloria.english: Hear me speedily, O Lord: * my spirit hath fainted away.

psalm:142:gloria.latin: Non avértas fáciem tuam a me: * et símilis ero descendéntibus in lacum.
psalm:142:gloria.english: Turn not away thy face from me, * lest I be like unto them that go down into the pit.

psalm:142:gloria.latin: Audítam fac mihi mane misericórdiam tuam: * quia in te sperávi.
psalm:142:gloria.english: Cause me to hear thy mercy in the morning; * for in thee have I hoped.

psalm:142:gloria.latin: Notam fac mihi viam, in qua ámbulem: * quia ad te levávi ánimam meam.
psalm:142:gloria.english: Make the way known to me, wherein I should walk: * for I have lifted up my soul to thee.

psalm:142:gloria.latin: Éripe me de inimícis meis, Dómine, ad te confúgi: * (10a) doce me fácere voluntátem tuam, quia Deus meus es tu.
psalm:142:gloria.english: Deliver me from my enemies, O Lord, to thee have I fled: * (10a) teach me to do thy will, for thou art my God.

psalm:142:gloria.latin: Spíritus tuus bonus dedúcet me in terram rectam: * (11a) propter nomen tuum, Dómine, vivificábis me, in æquitáte tua.
psalm:142:gloria.english: Thy good spirit shall lead me into the right land: * (11a) for thy name’s sake, O Lord, thou wilt quicken me in thy justice.

psalm:142:gloria.latin: Edúces de tribulatióne ánimam meam: * (12a) et in misericórdia tua dispérdes inimícos meos.
psalm:142:gloria.english: Thou wilt bring my soul out of trouble: * (12a) and in thy mercy thou wilt destroy my enemies.

psalm:142:gloria.latin: Et perdes omnes, qui tríbulant ánimam meam: * quóniam ego servus tuus sum.
psalm:142:gloria.english: And thou wilt cut off all them that afflict my soul: * for I am thy servant.

psalm:142:gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:142:gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:142:gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:142:gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:226(1-32):gloria.english: Canticle 226

psalm:226(1-32):gloria.latin: Audíte, cæli, quæ loquor: * áudiat terra verba oris mei.
psalm:226(1-32):gloria.english: Hear, O ye heavens, the things I speak, * let the earth give ear to the words of my mouth.

psalm:226(1-32):gloria.latin: Concréscat ut plúvia doctrína mea, * fluat ut ros elóquium meum.
psalm:226(1-32):gloria.english: Let my doctrine gather as the rain, * let my speech distill as the dew,

psalm:226(1-32):gloria.latin: Quasi imber super herbam, et quasi stillæ super grámina. * Quia nomen Dómini invocábo.
psalm:226(1-32):gloria.english: As a shower upon the herb, and as drops upon the grass. * Because I will invoke the name of the Lord:

psalm:226(1-32):gloria.latin: Date magnificéntiam Deo nostro. * Dei perfécta sunt ópera, et omnes viæ ejus judícia:
psalm:226(1-32):gloria.english: Give ye magnificence to our God. * The works of God are perfect, and all his ways are judgments:

psalm:226(1-32):gloria.latin: Deus fidélis, et absque ulla iniquitáte, justus et rectus. * Peccavérunt ei, et non fílii ejus in sórdibus:
psalm:226(1-32):gloria.english: God is faithful and without any iniquity, he is just and right. * They have sinned against him, and are none of his children in their filth:

psalm:226(1-32):gloria.latin: Generátio prava atque pervérsa. * Hǽccine reddis Dómino, pópule stulte et insípiens?
psalm:226(1-32):gloria.english: They are a wicked and perverse generation. * Is this the return thou makest to the Lord, O foolish and senseless people?

psalm:226(1-32):gloria.latin: Numquid non ipse est pater tuus, * qui possédit te, et fecit, et creávit te?
psalm:226(1-32):gloria.english: Is not he thy father, * that hath possessed thee, and made thee, and created thee?

psalm:226(1-32):gloria.latin: Meménto diérum antiquórum, * cógita generatiónes síngulas:
psalm:226(1-32):gloria.english: Remember the days of old, * think upon every generation:

psalm:226(1-32):gloria.latin: Intérroga patrem tuum, et annuntiábit tibi: * majóres tuos, et dicent tibi.
psalm:226(1-32):gloria.english: Ask thy father, and he will declare to thee: * thy elders and they will tell thee.

psalm:226(1-32):gloria.latin: Quando dividébat Altíssimus gentes: * quando separábat fílios Adam.
psalm:226(1-32):gloria.english: When the Most High divided the nations: * when he separated the sons of Adam,

psalm:226(1-32):gloria.latin: Constítuit términos populórum * juxta númerum filiórum Israël.
psalm:226(1-32):gloria.english: He appointed the bounds of people * according to the number of the children of Israel.

psalm:226(1-32):gloria.latin: Pars autem Dómini, pópulus ejus: * Jacob funículus hereditátis ejus.
psalm:226(1-32):gloria.english: But the Lord’s portion is his people: * Jacob the lot of his inheritance.

psalm:226(1-32):gloria.latin: Invénit eum in terra desérta, * in loco horróris et vastæ solitúdinis:
psalm:226(1-32):gloria.english: He found him in a desert land, * in a place of horror, and of vast wilderness:

psalm:226(1-32):gloria.latin: Circumdúxit eum, et dócuit: * et custodívit quasi pupíllam óculi sui.
psalm:226(1-32):gloria.english: He led him about, and taught him: * and he kept him as the apple of his eye.

psalm:226(1-32):gloria.latin: Sicut áquila próvocans ad volándum pullos suos, * et super eos vólitans,
psalm:226(1-32):gloria.english: As the eagle enticing her young to fly, * and hovering over them,

psalm:226(1-32):gloria.latin: Expándit alas suas, et assúmpsit eum, * atque portávit in húmeris suis.
psalm:226(1-32):gloria.english: He spread his wings, and hath taken him * and carried him on his shoulders.

psalm:226(1-32):gloria.latin: Dóminus solus dux ejus fuit: * et non erat cum eo deus aliénus.
psalm:226(1-32):gloria.english: The Lord alone was his leader: * and there was no strange god with him.

psalm:226(1-32):gloria.latin: Constítuit eum super excélsam terram: * ut coméderet fructus agrórum,
psalm:226(1-32):gloria.english: He set him upon high land: * that he might eat the fruits of the fields,

psalm:226(1-32):gloria.latin: Ut súgeret mel de petra, * oleúmque de saxo duríssimo.
psalm:226(1-32):gloria.english: That he might suck honey out of the rock, * and oil out of the hardest stone,

psalm:226(1-32):gloria.latin: Butýrum de arménto, et lac de óvibus * cum ádipe agnórum, et aríetum filiórum Basan:
psalm:226(1-32):gloria.english: Butter of the herd, and milk of the sheep * with the fat of lambs, and of the rams of the breed of Basan:

psalm:226(1-32):gloria.latin: Et hircos cum medúlla trítici, * et sánguinem uvæ bíberet meracíssimum.
psalm:226(1-32):gloria.english: And goats with the marrow of wheat, * and might drink the purest blood of the grape.

psalm:226(1-32):gloria.latin: Incrassátus est diléctus, et recalcitrávit: * incrassátus, impinguátus, dilatátus,
psalm:226(1-32):gloria.english: The beloved grew fat, and kicked: * he grew fat, and thick and gross,

psalm:226(1-32):gloria.latin: Derelíquit Deum, factórem suum, * et recéssit a Deo, salutári suo.
psalm:226(1-32):gloria.english: He forsook God who made him, * and departed from God his saviour.

psalm:226(1-32):gloria.latin: Provocavérunt eum in diis aliénis, * et in abominatiónibus ad iracúndiam concitavérunt.
psalm:226(1-32):gloria.english: They provoked him by strange gods, * and stirred him up to anger, with their abominations.

psalm:226(1-32):gloria.latin: Immolavérunt dæmóniis, et non Deo, * diis, quos ignorábant:
psalm:226(1-32):gloria.english: They sacrificed to devils and not to God: * to gods whom they knew not:

psalm:226(1-32):gloria.latin: Novi recentésque venérunt, * quos non coluérunt patres eórum.
psalm:226(1-32):gloria.english: That were newly come up, * whom their fathers worshipped not.

psalm:226(1-32):gloria.latin: Deum qui te génuit dereliquísti, * et oblítus es Dómini, creatóris tui.
psalm:226(1-32):gloria.english: Thou hast forsaken the God that beget * and hast forgotten the Lord that created thee.

psalm:226(1-32):gloria.latin: Vidit Dóminus, et ad iracúndiam concitátus est: * quia provocavérunt eum fílii sui et fíliæ.
psalm:226(1-32):gloria.english: The Lord saw, and was moved to wrath: * because his own sons and daughters provoked him.

psalm:226(1-32):gloria.latin: Et ait: Abscóndam fáciem meam ab eis, * et considerábo novíssima eórum:
psalm:226(1-32):gloria.english: And he said: I will hide my face from them, * and will consider what their last end shall be:

psalm:226(1-32):gloria.latin: Generátio enim pervérsa est, * et infidéles fílii.
psalm:226(1-32):gloria.english: for it is a perverse generation, * and unfaithful children.

psalm:226(1-32):gloria.latin: Ipsi me provocavérunt in eo, qui non erat Deus, * et irritavérunt in vanitátibus suis:
psalm:226(1-32):gloria.english: They have provoked me with that which was no god, * and have angered me with their vanities:

psalm:226(1-32):gloria.latin: Et ego provocábo eos in eo, qui non est pópulus, * et in gente stulta irritábo illos.
psalm:226(1-32):gloria.english: and I will provoke them with that which is no people, * and will vex them with a foolish nation.

psalm:226(1-32):gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:226(1-32):gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:226(1-32):gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:226(1-32):gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:226(33-65):gloria.english: Canticle 226

psalm:226(33-65):gloria.latin: Ignis succénsus est in furóre meo, * et ardébit usque ad inférni novíssima:
psalm:226(33-65):gloria.english: A fire is kindled in my wrath, * and shall burn even to the lowest hell:

psalm:226(33-65):gloria.latin: Devorabítque terram cum gérmine suo, * et móntium fundaménta combúret.
psalm:226(33-65):gloria.english: and shall devour the earth with her increase, * and shall burn the foundations of the mountains.

psalm:226(33-65):gloria.latin: Congregábo super eos mala, * et sagíttas meas complébo in eis.
psalm:226(33-65):gloria.english: I will heap evils upon them, * and will spend my arrows among them.

psalm:226(33-65):gloria.latin: Consuméntur fame, * et devorábunt eos aves morsu amaríssimo:
psalm:226(33-65):gloria.english: They shall be consumed with famine, * and birds shall devour them with a most bitter bite:

psalm:226(33-65):gloria.latin: Dentes bestiárum immíttam in eos, * cum furóre trahéntium super terram, atque serpéntium.
psalm:226(33-65):gloria.english: I will send the teeth of beasts upon them, * with the fury of creatures that trail upon the ground, and of serpents.

psalm:226(33-65):gloria.latin: Foris vastábit eos gládius, et intus pavor, * júvenem simul ac vírginem, lactántem cum hómine sene.
psalm:226(33-65):gloria.english: Without, the sword shall lay them waste, and terror within, * both the young man and the virgin, the sucking child with the man in years.

psalm:226(33-65):gloria.latin: Dixi: Ubinam sunt? * cessáre fáciam ex homínibus memóriam eórum.
psalm:226(33-65):gloria.english: I said: Where are they? * I will make the memory of them to cease from among men.

psalm:226(33-65):gloria.latin: Sed propter iram inimicórum dístuli: * ne forte superbírent hostes eórum,
psalm:226(33-65):gloria.english: But for the wrath of the enemies * I have deferred it: lest perhaps their enemies might be proud,

psalm:226(33-65):gloria.latin: Et dícerent: Manus nostra excélsa, et non Dóminus, * fecit hæc ómnia.
psalm:226(33-65):gloria.english: and should say: Our mighty hand, and not the Lord, * hath done all these things.

psalm:226(33-65):gloria.latin: Gens absque consílio est, et sine prudéntia. * Utinam sáperent, et intellégerent, ac novíssima providérent.
psalm:226(33-65):gloria.english: They are a nation without counsel, and without wisdom * O that they would be wise and would understand, and would provide for their last end.

psalm:226(33-65):gloria.latin: Quómodo persequátur unus mille, * et duo fugent decem míllia?
psalm:226(33-65):gloria.english: How should one pursue after a thousand, * and two chase ten thousand?

psalm:226(33-65):gloria.latin: Nonne ídeo, quia Deus suus véndidit eos, * et Dóminus conclúsit illos?
psalm:226(33-65):gloria.english: Was it not, because their God had sold them, * and the Lord had shut them up?

psalm:226(33-65):gloria.latin: Non enim est Deus noster ut dii eórum: * et inimíci nostri sunt júdices.
psalm:226(33-65):gloria.english: For our God is not as their gods: * our enemies themselves are judges.

psalm:226(33-65):gloria.latin: De vínea Sodomórum vínea eórum, * et de suburbánis Gomórrhæ:
psalm:226(33-65):gloria.english: Their vines are of the vineyard of Sodom, * and of the suburbs of Gomorrha:

psalm:226(33-65):gloria.latin: Uva eórum uva fellis, * et botri amaríssimi.
psalm:226(33-65):gloria.english: their grapes are grapes of gall, * and their clusters most bitter.

psalm:226(33-65):gloria.latin: Fel dracónum vinum eórum, * et venénum áspidum insanábile.
psalm:226(33-65):gloria.english: Their wine is the gall of dragons, * and the venom of asps, which is incurable.

psalm:226(33-65):gloria.latin: Nonne hæc cóndita sunt apud me, * et signáta in thesáuris meis?
psalm:226(33-65):gloria.english: Are not these things stored up with me, * and sealed up in my treasures?

psalm:226(33-65):gloria.latin: Mea est últio, et ego retríbuam in témpore, * ut labátur pes eórum:
psalm:226(33-65):gloria.english: Revenge is mine, and I will repay them in due time, * that their foot may slide:

psalm:226(33-65):gloria.latin: Juxta est dies perditiónis, * et adésse festínant témpora.
psalm:226(33-65):gloria.english: the day of destruction is at hand, * and the time makes haste to come.

psalm:226(33-65):gloria.latin: Judicábit Dóminus pópulum suum, * et in servis suis miserébitur:
psalm:226(33-65):gloria.english: The Lord will judge his people, * and will have mercy on his servants:

psalm:226(33-65):gloria.latin: Vidébit quod infirmáta sit manus, * et clausi quoque defecérunt, residuíque consúmpti sunt.
psalm:226(33-65):gloria.english: he shall see that their hand is weakened, * and that they who were shut up have also failed, and they that remained are consumed.

psalm:226(33-65):gloria.latin: Et dicet: Ubi sunt dii eórum, * in quibus habébant fidúciam?
psalm:226(33-65):gloria.english: And he shall say: Where are their gods, * in whom they trusted?

psalm:226(33-65):gloria.latin: De quorum víctimis comedébant ádipes, * et bibébant vinum libáminum:
psalm:226(33-65):gloria.english: Of whose victims they ate the fat, * and drank the wine of their drink offerings:

psalm:226(33-65):gloria.latin: Surgant, et opituléntur vobis, * et in necessitáte vos prótegant.
psalm:226(33-65):gloria.english: let them arise and help you, * and protect you in your distress.

psalm:226(33-65):gloria.latin: Vidéte quod ego sim solus, * et non sit álius Deus præter me:
psalm:226(33-65):gloria.english: See ye that I alone am, * and there is no other God besides me:

psalm:226(33-65):gloria.latin: Ego occídam, et ego vívere fáciam: percútiam, et ego sanábo, * et non est qui de manu mea possit erúere.
psalm:226(33-65):gloria.english: I will kill and I will make to live: I will strike, and I will heal, * and there is none that can deliver out of my hand.

psalm:226(33-65):gloria.latin: Levábo ad cælum manum meam, et dicam: * Vivo ego in ætérnum.
psalm:226(33-65):gloria.english: I will lift up my hand to heaven, * and I will say: I live for ever.

psalm:226(33-65):gloria.latin: Si acúero ut fulgur gládium meum, * et arripúerit judícium manus mea:
psalm:226(33-65):gloria.english: If I shall whet my sword as the lightning, * and my hand take hold on judgment:

psalm:226(33-65):gloria.latin: Reddam ultiónem hóstibus meis, * et his qui odérunt me retríbuam.
psalm:226(33-65):gloria.english: I will render vengeance to my enemies, * and repay them that hate me.

psalm:226(33-65):gloria.latin: Inebriábo sagíttas meas sánguine, * et gládius meus devorábit carnes,
psalm:226(33-65):gloria.english: I will make my arrows drunk with blood, * and my sword shall devour flesh,

psalm:226(33-65):gloria.latin: De cruóre occisórum, * et de captivitáte, nudáti inimicórum cápitis.
psalm:226(33-65):gloria.english: of the blood of the slain * and of the captivity, of the bare head of the enemies.

psalm:226(33-65):gloria.latin: Laudáte, gentes, pópulum ejus, * quia sánguinem servórum suórum ulciscétur:
psalm:226(33-65):gloria.english: Praise his people, ye nations, * for he will revenge the blood of his servants:

psalm:226(33-65):gloria.latin: Et vindíctam retríbuet in hostes eórum, * et propítius erit terræ pópuli sui.
psalm:226(33-65):gloria.english: and will render vengeance to their enemies, * and he will be merciful to the land of his people.

psalm:226(33-65):gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:226(33-65):gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:226(33-65):gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:226(33-65):gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:17(26-51):gloria.latin: Cum sancto sanctus eris, * et cum viro innocénte ínnocens eris:
psalm:17(26-51):gloria.english: With the holy thou wilt be holy; * and with the innocent man thou wilt be innocent:

psalm:17(26-51):gloria.latin: Et cum elécto eléctus eris: * et cum pervérso pervertéris.
psalm:17(26-51):gloria.english: And with the elect thou wilt be elect: * and with the perverse thou wilt be perverted.

psalm:17(26-51):gloria.latin: Quóniam tu pópulum húmilem salvum fácies: * et óculos superbórum humiliábis.
psalm:17(26-51):gloria.english: For thou wilt save the humble people; * but wilt bring down the eyes of the proud.

psalm:17(26-51):gloria.latin: Quóniam tu illúminas lucérnam meam, Dómine: * Deus meus, illúmina ténebras meas.
psalm:17(26-51):gloria.english: For thou lightest my lamp, O Lord: * O my God, enlighten my darkness.

psalm:17(26-51):gloria.latin: Quóniam in te erípiar a tentatióne, * et in Deo meo transgrédiar murum.
psalm:17(26-51):gloria.english: For by thee I shall be delivered from temptation; * and through my God I shall go over a wall.

psalm:17(26-51):gloria.latin: Deus meus, impollúta via ejus: † elóquia Dómini igne examináta: * protéctor est ómnium sperántium in se.
psalm:17(26-51):gloria.english: As for my God, his way is undefiled: † the words of the Lord are fire-tried: * he is the protector of all that trust in him.

psalm:17(26-51):gloria.latin: Quóniam quis Deus præter Dóminum? * aut quis Deus præter Deum nostrum?
psalm:17(26-51):gloria.english: For who is God but the Lord? * or who is God but our God?

psalm:17(26-51):gloria.latin: Deus, qui præcínxit me virtúte: * et pósuit immaculátam viam meam.
psalm:17(26-51):gloria.english: God, who hath girt me with strength; * and made my way blameless.

psalm:17(26-51):gloria.latin: Qui perfécit pedes meos tamquam cervórum, * et super excélsa státuens me.
psalm:17(26-51):gloria.english: Who hath made my feet like the feet of harts: * and who setteth me upon high places.

psalm:17(26-51):gloria.latin: Qui docet manus meas ad prǽlium: * et posuísti, ut arcum ǽreum, brácchia mea.
psalm:17(26-51):gloria.english: Who teacheth my hands to war: * and thou hast made my arms like a brazen bow.

psalm:17(26-51):gloria.latin: Et dedísti mihi protectiónem salútis tuæ: * et déxtera tua suscépit me:
psalm:17(26-51):gloria.english: Thou hast given me the protection of thy salvation: * and thy right hand hath held me up:

psalm:17(26-51):gloria.latin: Et disciplína tua corréxit me in finem: * et disciplína tua ipsa me docébit.
psalm:17(26-51):gloria.english: And thy discipline hath corrected me unto the end: * and thy discipline, the same shall teach me.

psalm:17(26-51):gloria.latin: Dilatásti gressus meos subtus me: * et non sunt infirmáta vestígia mea:
psalm:17(26-51):gloria.english: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me; * and my feet are not weakened.

psalm:17(26-51):gloria.latin: Pérsequar inimícos meos et comprehéndam illos: * et non convértar, donec defíciant.
psalm:17(26-51):gloria.english: I will pursue after my enemies, and overtake them: * and I will not turn again till they are consumed.

psalm:17(26-51):gloria.latin: Confríngam illos, nec póterunt stare: * cadent subtus pedes meos.
psalm:17(26-51):gloria.english: I will break them, and they shall not be able to stand: * they shall fall under my feet.

psalm:17(26-51):gloria.latin: Et præcinxísti me virtúte ad bellum: * et supplantásti insurgéntes in me subtus me.
psalm:17(26-51):gloria.english: And thou hast girded me with strength unto battle; * and hast subdued under me them that rose up against me.

psalm:17(26-51):gloria.latin: Et inimícos meos dedísti mihi dorsum, * et odiéntes me disperdidísti.
psalm:17(26-51):gloria.english: And thou hast made my enemies turn their back upon me, * and hast destroyed them that hated me.

psalm:17(26-51):gloria.latin: Clamavérunt, nec erat qui salvos fáceret ad Dóminum: * nec exaudívit eos.
psalm:17(26-51):gloria.english: They cried, but there was none to save them, to the Lord: * but he heard them not.

psalm:17(26-51):gloria.latin: Et commínuam eos, ut púlverem ante fáciem venti: * ut lutum plateárum delébo eos.
psalm:17(26-51):gloria.english: And I shall beat them as small as the dust before the wind; * I shall bring them to nought, like the dirt in the streets.

psalm:17(26-51):gloria.latin: Erípies me de contradictiónibus pópuli: * constítues me in caput géntium.
psalm:17(26-51):gloria.english: Thou wilt deliver me from the contradictions of the people; * thou wilt make me head of the Gentiles.

psalm:17(26-51):gloria.latin: Pópulus quem non cognóvi servívit mihi: * in audítu auris obedívit mihi.
psalm:17(26-51):gloria.english: A people which I knew not, hath served me: * at the hearing of the ear they have obeyed me.

psalm:17(26-51):gloria.latin: Fílii aliéni mentíti sunt mihi, * fílii aliéni inveteráti sunt, et claudicavérunt a sémitis suis.
psalm:17(26-51):gloria.english: The children that are strangers have lied to me, * strange children have faded away, and have halted from their paths.

psalm:17(26-51):gloria.latin: Vivit Dóminus, et benedíctus Deus meus: * et exaltétur Deus salútis meæ.
psalm:17(26-51):gloria.english: The Lord liveth, and blessed be my God, * and let the God of my salvation be exalted.

psalm:17(26-51):gloria.latin: Deus, qui das vindíctas mihi, et subdis pópulos sub me: * liberátor meus de inimícis meis iracúndis.
psalm:17(26-51):gloria.english: O God, who avengest me, and subduest the people under me, * my deliverer from my enraged enemies.

psalm:17(26-51):gloria.latin: Et ab insurgéntibus in me exaltábis me: * a viro iníquo erípies me.
psalm:17(26-51):gloria.english: And thou wilt lift me up above them that rise up against me: * from the unjust man thou wilt deliver me.

psalm:17(26-51):gloria.latin: Proptérea confitébor tibi in natiónibus, Dómine: * et nómini tuo psalmum dicam.
psalm:17(26-51):gloria.english: Therefore will I give glory to thee, O Lord, among the nations, * and I will sing a psalm to thy name.
