psalm:17(26-51):gloria.latin: Magníficans salútes Regis ejus, † et fáciens misericórdiam Christo suo David: * et sémini ejus usque in sǽculum.
psalm:17(26-51):gloria.english: Giving great deliverance to his king, † and shewing mercy to David, his anointed: * and to his seed for ever.

psalm:17(26-51):gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:17(26-51):gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:17(26-51):gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:17(26-51):gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:18:gloria.latin: Cæli enárrant glóriam Dei: * et ópera mánuum ejus annúntiat firmaméntum.
psalm:18:gloria.english: The heavens shew forth the glory of God, * and the firmament declareth the work of his hands.

psalm:18:gloria.latin: Dies diéi erúctat verbum, * et nox nocti índicat sciéntiam.
psalm:18:gloria.english: Day to day uttereth speech, * and night to night sheweth knowledge.

psalm:18:gloria.latin: Non sunt loquélæ, neque sermónes, * quorum non audiántur voces eórum.
psalm:18:gloria.english: There are no speeches nor languages, * where their voices are not heard.

psalm:18:gloria.latin: In omnem terram exívit sonus eórum: * et in fines orbis terræ verba eórum.
psalm:18:gloria.english: Their sound hath gone forth into all the earth: * and their words unto the ends of the world.

psalm:18:gloria.latin: In sole pósuit tabernáculum suum: * et ipse tamquam sponsus procédens de thálamo suo:
psalm:18:gloria.english: He hath set his tabernacle in the sun: * and he, as a bridegroom coming out of his bride chamber,

psalm:18:gloria.latin: Exsultávit ut gigas ad curréndam viam, * (7a) a summo cælo egréssio ejus:
psalm:18:gloria.english: Hath rejoiced as a giant to run the way: * (7a) his going out is from the end of heaven,

psalm:18:gloria.latin: Et occúrsus ejus usque ad summum ejus: * nec est qui se abscóndat a calóre ejus.
psalm:18:gloria.english: And his circuit even to the end thereof: * and there is no one that can hide himself from his heat.

psalm:18:gloria.latin: Lex Dómini immaculáta, convértens ánimas: * testimónium Dómini fidéle, sapiéntiam præstans párvulis.
psalm:18:gloria.english: The law of the Lord is unspotted, converting souls: * the testimony of the Lord is faithful, giving wisdom to little ones.

psalm:18:gloria.latin: Justítiæ Dómini rectæ, lætificántes corda: * præcéptum Dómini lúcidum, illúminans óculos.
psalm:18:gloria.english: The justices of the Lord are right, rejoicing hearts: * the commandment of the Lord is lightsome, enlightening the eyes.

psalm:18:gloria.latin: Timor Dómini sanctus, pérmanens in sǽculum sǽculi: * judícia Dómini vera, justificáta in semetípsa.
psalm:18:gloria.english: The fear of the Lord is holy, enduring for ever and ever: * the judgments of the Lord are true, justified in themselves.

psalm:18:gloria.latin: Desiderabília super aurum et lápidem pretiósum multum: * et dulcióra super mel et favum.
psalm:18:gloria.english: More to be desired than gold and many precious stones: * and sweeter than honey and the honeycomb.

psalm:18:gloria.latin: Étenim servus tuus custódit ea, * in custodiéndis illis retribútio multa.
psalm:18:gloria.english: For thy servant keepeth them, * and in keeping them there is a great reward.

psalm:18:gloria.latin: Delícta quis intéllegit? † ab occúltis meis munda me: * (14a) et ab aliénis parce servo tuo.
psalm:18:gloria.english: Who can understand sins? † from my secret ones cleanse me, O Lord: * (14a) and from those of others spare thy servant.

psalm:18:gloria.latin: Si mei non fúerint domináti, tunc immaculátus ero: * et emundábor a delícto máximo.
psalm:18:gloria.english: If they shall have no dominion over me, then shall I be without spot: * and I shall be cleansed from the greatest sin.

psalm:18:gloria.latin: Et erunt ut compláceant elóquia oris mei: * et meditátio cordis mei in conspéctu tuo semper.
psalm:18:gloria.english: And the words of my mouth shall be such as may please: * and the meditation of my heart always in thy sight.

psalm:18:gloria.latin: Dómine, adjútor meus, * et redémptor meus.
psalm:18:gloria.english: O Lord, my helper, * and my redeemer.

psalm:18:gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:18:gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:18:gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:18:gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:19:gloria.latin: Exáudiat te Dóminus in die tribulatiónis: * prótegat te nomen Dei Jacob.
psalm:19:gloria.english: May the Lord hear thee in the day of tribulation: * may the name of the God of Jacob protect thee.

psalm:19:gloria.latin: Mittat tibi auxílium de sancto: * et de Sion tueátur te.
psalm:19:gloria.english: May he send thee help from the sanctuary: * and defend thee out of Sion.

psalm:19:gloria.latin: Memor sit omnis sacrifícii tui: * et holocáustum tuum pingue fiat.
psalm:19:gloria.english: May he be mindful of all thy sacrifices: * and may thy whole burnt offering be made fat.

psalm:19:gloria.latin: Tríbuat tibi secúndum cor tuum: * et omne consílium tuum confírmet.
psalm:19:gloria.english: May he give thee according to thy own heart; * and confirm all thy counsels.

psalm:19:gloria.latin: Lætábimur in salutári tuo: * et in nómine Dei nostri magnificábimur.
psalm:19:gloria.english: We will rejoice in thy salvation; * and in the name of our God we shall be exalted.

psalm:19:gloria.latin: Ímpleat Dóminus omnes petitiónes tuas: * nunc cognóvi quóniam salvum fecit Dóminus Christum suum.
psalm:19:gloria.english: The Lord fulfil all thy petitions: * now have I known that the Lord hath saved his anointed.

psalm:19:gloria.latin: Exáudiet illum de cælo sancto suo: * in potentátibus salus déxteræ ejus.
psalm:19:gloria.english: He will hear him from his holy heaven: * the salvation of his right hand is in powers.

psalm:19:gloria.latin: Hi in cúrribus, et hi in equis: * nos autem in nómine Dómini, Dei nostri invocábimus.
psalm:19:gloria.english: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses: * but we will call upon the name of the Lord, our God.

psalm:19:gloria.latin: Ipsi obligáti sunt, et cecidérunt: * nos autem surréximus et erécti sumus.
psalm:19:gloria.english: They are bound, and have fallen: * but we are risen, and are set upright.

psalm:19:gloria.latin: Dómine, salvum fac regem: * et exáudi nos in die, qua invocavérimus te.
psalm:19:gloria.english: O Lord, save the king: * and hear us in the day that we shall call upon thee.

psalm:19:gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:19:gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:19:gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:19:gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:144(10-21):gloria.latin: Confiteántur tibi, Dómine, ómnia ópera tua: * et sancti tui benedícant tibi.
psalm:144(10-21):gloria.english: Let all thy works, O Lord, praise thee: * and let thy saints bless thee.

psalm:144(10-21):gloria.latin: Glóriam regni tui dicent: * et poténtiam tuam loquéntur:
psalm:144(10-21):gloria.english: They shall speak of the glory of thy kingdom: * and shall tell of thy power:

psalm:144(10-21):gloria.latin: Ut notam fáciant fíliis hóminum poténtiam tuam: * et glóriam magnificéntiæ regni tui.
psalm:144(10-21):gloria.english: To make thy might known to the sons of men: * and the glory of the magnificence of thy kingdom.

psalm:144(10-21):gloria.latin: Regnum tuum regnum ómnium sæculórum: * et dominátio tua in omni generatióne et generatiónem.
psalm:144(10-21):gloria.english: Thy kingdom is a kingdom of all ages: * and thy dominion endureth throughout all generations.

psalm:144(10-21):gloria.latin: Fidélis Dóminus in ómnibus verbis suis: * et sanctus in ómnibus opéribus suis.
psalm:144(10-21):gloria.english: The Lord is faithful in all his words: * and holy in all his works.

psalm:144(10-21):gloria.latin: Állevat Dóminus omnes qui córruunt: * et érigit omnes elísos.
psalm:144(10-21):gloria.english: The Lord lifteth up all that fall: * and setteth up all that are cast down.

psalm:144(10-21):gloria.latin: Óculi ómnium in te sperant, Dómine: * et tu das escam illórum in témpore opportúno.
psalm:144(10-21):gloria.english: The eyes of all hope in thee, O Lord: * and thou givest them meat in due season.

psalm:144(10-21):gloria.latin: Áperis tu manum tuam: * et imples omne ánimal benedictióne.
psalm:144(10-21):gloria.english: Thou openest thy hand, * and fillest with blessing every living creature.

psalm:144(10-21):gloria.latin: Justus Dóminus in ómnibus viis suis: * et sanctus in ómnibus opéribus suis.
psalm:144(10-21):gloria.english: The Lord is just in all his ways: * and holy in all his works.

psalm:144(10-21):gloria.latin: Prope est Dóminus ómnibus invocántibus eum: * ómnibus invocántibus eum in veritáte.
psalm:144(10-21):gloria.english: The Lord is nigh unto all them that call upon him: * to all that call upon him in truth.

psalm:144(10-21):gloria.latin: Voluntátem timéntium se fáciet: ‡ et deprecatiónem eórum exáudiet: * et salvos fáciet eos.
psalm:144(10-21):gloria.english: He will do the will of them that fear him: ‡ and he will hear their prayer, * and save them.

psalm:144(10-21):gloria.latin: Custódit Dóminus omnes diligéntes se: * et omnes peccatóres dispérdet.
psalm:144(10-21):gloria.english: The Lord keepeth all them that love him; * but all the wicked he will destroy.

psalm:144(10-21):gloria.latin: Laudatiónem Dómini loquétur os meum: * et benedícat omnis caro nómini sancto ejus in sǽculum, et in sǽculum sǽculi.
psalm:144(10-21):gloria.english: My mouth shall speak the praise of the Lord: * and let all flesh bless his holy name for ever; yea, for ever and ever.

psalm:144(10-21):gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:144(10-21):gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:144(10-21):gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:144(10-21):gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:145:gloria.latin: Lauda, ánima mea, Dóminum, † laudábo Dóminum in vita mea: * psallam Deo meo quámdiu fúero.
psalm:145:gloria.english: Praise the Lord, O my soul, † in my life I will praise the Lord: * I will sing to my God as long as I shall be.

psalm:145:gloria.latin: Nolíte confídere in princípibus: * (3) in fíliis hóminum, in quibus non est salus.
psalm:145:gloria.english: Put not your trust in princes: * (3) in the children of men, in whom there is no salvation.

psalm:145:gloria.latin: Exíbit spíritus ejus, et revertétur in terram suam: * in illa die períbunt omnes cogitatiónes eórum.
psalm:145:gloria.english: His spirit shall go forth, and he shall return into his earth: * in that day all their thoughts shall perish.

psalm:145:gloria.latin: Beátus, cujus Deus Jacob adjútor ejus, † spes ejus in Dómino, Deo ipsíus: * (6) qui fecit cælum et terram, mare, et ómnia, quæ in eis sunt.
psalm:145:gloria.english: Blessed is he who hath the God of Jacob for his helper, † whose hope is in the Lord his God: * (6) who made heaven and earth, the sea, and all things that are in them.

psalm:145:gloria.latin: Qui custódit veritátem in sǽculum, † facit judícium injúriam patiéntibus: * dat escam esuriéntibus.
psalm:145:gloria.english: Who keepeth truth for ever: † who executeth judgment for them that suffer wrong: * who giveth food to the hungry.

psalm:145:gloria.latin: Dóminus solvit compedítos: * (8a) Dóminus illúminat cæcos.
psalm:145:gloria.english: The Lord looseth them that are fettered: * (8a) the Lord enlighteneth the blind.

psalm:145:gloria.latin: Dóminus érigit elísos, * Dóminus díligit justos.
psalm:145:gloria.english: The Lord lifteth up them that are cast down: * the Lord loveth the just.

psalm:145:gloria.latin: Dóminus custódit ádvenas, † pupíllum et víduam suscípiet: * et vias peccatórum dispérdet.
psalm:145:gloria.english: The Lord keepeth the strangers, † he will support the fatherless and the widow: * and the ways of sinners he will destroy.

psalm:145:gloria.latin: Regnábit Dóminus in sǽcula, Deus tuus, Sion, * in generatiónem et generatiónem.
psalm:145:gloria.english: The Lord shall reign for ever: thy God, O Sion, * unto generation and generation.

psalm:145:gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:145:gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:145:gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:145:gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:146:gloria.latin: Laudáte Dóminum quóniam bonus est psalmus: * Deo nostro sit jucúnda, decóraque laudátio.
psalm:146:gloria.english: Praise ye the Lord, because psalm is good: * to our God be joyful and comely praise.

psalm:146:gloria.latin: Ædíficans Jerúsalem Dóminus: * dispersiónes Israélis congregábit.
psalm:146:gloria.english: The Lord buildeth up Jerusalem: * he will gather together the dispersed of Israel.

psalm:146:gloria.latin: Qui sanat contrítos corde: * et álligat contritiónes eórum.
psalm:146:gloria.english: Who healeth the broken of heart, * and bindeth up their bruises.

psalm:146:gloria.latin: Qui númerat multitúdinem stellárum: * et ómnibus eis nómina vocat.
psalm:146:gloria.english: Who telleth the number of the stars: * and calleth them all by their names.

psalm:146:gloria.latin: Magnus Dóminus noster, et magna virtus ejus: * et sapiéntiæ ejus non est númerus.
psalm:146:gloria.english: Great is our Lord, and great is his power: * and of his wisdom there is no number.

psalm:146:gloria.latin: Suscípiens mansuétos Dóminus: * humílians autem peccatóres usque ad terram.
psalm:146:gloria.english: The Lord lifteth up the meek, * and bringeth the wicked down even to the ground.

psalm:146:gloria.latin: Præcínite Dómino in confessióne: * psállite Deo nostro in cíthara.
psalm:146:gloria.english: Sing ye to the Lord with praise: * sing to our God upon the harp.

psalm:146:gloria.latin: Qui óperit cælum núbibus: * et parat terræ plúviam.
psalm:146:gloria.english: Who covereth the heaven with clouds, * and prepareth rain for the earth.

psalm:146:gloria.latin: Qui prodúcit in móntibus fænum: * et herbam servitúti hóminum.
psalm:146:gloria.english: Who maketh grass to grow on the mountains, * and herbs for the service of men.

psalm:146:gloria.latin: Qui dat juméntis escam ipsórum: * et pullis corvórum invocántibus eum.
psalm:146:gloria.english: Who giveth to beasts their food: * and to the young ravens that call upon him.

psalm:146:gloria.latin: Non in fortitúdine equi voluntátem habébit: * nec in tíbiis viri beneplácitum erit ei.
psalm:146:gloria.english: He shall not delight in the strength of the horse: * nor take pleasure in the legs of a man.

psalm:146:gloria.latin: Beneplácitum est Dómino super timéntes eum: * et in eis, qui sperant super misericórdia ejus.
psalm:146:gloria.english: The Lord taketh pleasure in them that fear him: * and in them that hope in his mercy.

psalm:146:gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:146:gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:146:gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:146:gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.

psalm:147:gloria.latin: Lauda, Jerúsalem, Dóminum: * lauda Deum tuum, Sion.
psalm:147:gloria.english: Praise the Lord, O Jerusalem: * praise thy God, O Sion.

psalm:147:gloria.latin: Quóniam confortávit seras portárum tuárum: * benedíxit fíliis tuis in te.
psalm:147:gloria.english: Because he hath strengthened the bolts of thy gates * he hath blessed thy children within thee.

psalm:147:gloria.latin: Qui pósuit fines tuos pacem: * et ádipe fruménti sátiat te.
psalm:147:gloria.english: Who hath placed peace in thy borders: * and filleth thee with the fat of corn.

psalm:147:gloria.latin: Qui emíttit elóquium suum terræ: * velóciter currit sermo ejus.
psalm:147:gloria.english: Who sendeth forth his speech to the earth: * his word runneth swiftly.

psalm:147:gloria.latin: Qui dat nivem sicut lanam: * nébulam sicut cínerem spargit.
psalm:147:gloria.english: Who giveth snow like wool: * scattereth mists like ashes.

psalm:147:gloria.latin: Mittit crystállum suam sicut buccéllas: * ante fáciem frígoris ejus quis sustinébit?
psalm:147:gloria.english: He sendeth his crystal like morsels: * who shall stand before the face of his cold?

psalm:147:gloria.latin: Emíttet verbum suum, et liquefáciet ea: * flabit spíritus ejus, et fluent aquæ.
psalm:147:gloria.english: He shall send out his word, and shall melt them: * his wind shall blow, and the waters shall run.

psalm:147:gloria.latin: Qui annúntiat verbum suum Jacob: * justítias, et judícia sua Israël.
psalm:147:gloria.english: Who declareth his word to Jacob: * his justices and his judgments to Israel.

psalm:147:gloria.latin: Non fecit táliter omni natióni: * et judícia sua non manifestávit eis.
psalm:147:gloria.english: He hath not done in like manner to every nation: * and his judgments he hath not made manifest to them.

psalm:147:gloria.latin: Glória Patri, et Fílio, * et Spirítui Sancto.
psalm:147:gloria.english: Glory be to the Father, and to the Son, * and to the Holy Ghost.

psalm:147:gloria.latin: Sicut erat in princípio, et nunc, et semper, * et in sǽcula sæculórum. Amen.
psalm:147:gloria.english: As it was in the beginning, is now, * and ever shall be, world without end. Amen.
